ar: و أرزِقْنا وَ اَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرّازِقين
latin: Aorziqna Wa Anta Khayer Al Razeqeen
en: And provide for us sustenance, and You are the Best of Providers

ar: اللَّهُم اِنّي اَسْألُكَ عِلماً نافِعاً و رِزْقاً  طيباً و عَمَلاً مُتَقَّبَّلاً
latin: Allahuma Ini Asaloka Ilmaan Nafiaa Wa Rizqaan Tayaebaa Wa Amalaan Motaqabelaa
en: O Allah. I ask You for knowledge that is of benefit, a good provision and deeds that will be accepted

nama: Dua for Getting a Job and More
ar: حَسْبُنا اللهُ و نِعْمَ الوَكيلُ
latin: Hasbona Allahu Wa Niama Al Wakeel
en: Allah is sufficient for us (me)

ar: رَبِّي اِنّي لِما اَنْزَلْتَ اِلَيّ مِن خَيْرٍ فَقيراً
latin: Rabi Ini Lema Anzalta Illay Min Khairein Faqeer
en: My Lord! I am needy of whatever good Thou sendest down for me

nama: Dua for Applying for Job or Interviewing
ar: رَبّي اَدْخِلني مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ و أخرِجْني مُخْرجَ صِدْقٍ و إجْعَلُ لي مِن لَدُنْكَ سلطاناً نَصيراً
latin: Rabbi Adkhalni Modkhalaa Sidqin Wa Akhrijni Mokhraja Sidqin WaAjaal Li Min Ladonka Sultaanaan Naseeraan (80)
en: My Lord! Cause me to come in with a firm incoming and to go out with a firm outgoing. And give me from Thy presence a sustaining Power

nama: Dua for Getting a Job & More
ar: حَسْبِيَ اللهُ  لا اِلَهَ الا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَلْتُ وَ هُوَ رَبُّ العَرْشِ العَظيم
latin: Hasbe Allahu La Illaha Illa Huwa Alayhi Tawakaltu Wa Huwa Rabu Al Arshi Al Atheem
en: Allah is sufficient for me, there is no god except Him. On Him I have relied and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne

nama: Dua for Getting a Job and Wealth
ar: اللّهُم اَكْفِني بِحلالِكَ عَن حرامِكَ وَ اَغْنِني بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّن سواك
latin: Allahum Akfenee Bi Halaalek An Haraamek Wa Aghnini Bi Fathlika Anman Sewaak
en: O Allah suffice me with that which is lawful against that which is prohibited and make me independent of all those besides You.

ar: اللَّهُم اِنِّي اَعوذُ بِكَ مِن مُنكَراتِ الاَخْلاقِ و الأَعْمالِ و الأهْواءِ
latin: Allahum Ini Aoutho Bika Men Monkarati Al Akhlaqi Wa Al Aamaali Wa Al Ahwaa
en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from undesirable manners, deeds, and aspirations

nama: Dua for Getting a Job and More
ar: رَبّنا اَتِنا في الدُنْيا حَسَنَةً و في الاَخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً و قِنا عَذابَ النَّارِ
latin: Rabana Aatina Fil Dunya Hasanah Wa Fil Akhirati Hasanah Wa Qina Athaab Al Naar
en: Our Lord! Give unto us in the world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and guard us from the doom of Fire

nama: Dua for Getting a Job & Success
ar: اللّهُم اجْعَلْنا  مِنَ المُفْلِحين
latin: Allahuma Ajalna Mena AlMofliheen
en: O Allah Make us among the successful people

ar: رَبِّ لا تَذَرْني فَردا وَ اَنْتَ خَيْر الوارِثين(89)سورة الانبياء
latin: Rabbi La tathirnee Fardaan Wa Anta Khayiru Al Waritheen (89)
en: Oh my Lord do not leave me without offspring. Surely, you are the best of inheritors

ar: و للهِ مُلكُ السَّماواتِ و الاَرْض و ما بَيْنَهُما يَخْلُقُ ما يَشاءُ و اللُّهُ على كُل شَئٍ قَدير(17)  سورة المائِدَة
latin: Wa Lillahi Mulko Al Samawatee Wa Alarde Wa Ma Baynahuma Yakhliqo Ma Ya Shaa Wa Allahu Ala Kul Shaain Qadeer (17)
en: To Allah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them. He creates what He wills. And Allah has power over all things.

nama: Dua using Allah's Name: Al Khaliq
ar: يا خَالِق
latin: Ya Khaliq
en: O Creator, O Maker

ar: اللّهُ يَعْلَمُ ما تَحْمِلُ كُلُّ اُنثى و ما تَغيضُ الارْحامُ و ما تَزْدادُ و كُلُّ شَئٍ عِنْدَهُ بِمقْدارٍ(8)  سورة الرعد
latin: Allahu Yaalamo Ma Tuhmelo Kulu Ontha Wa Ma Tagheedo Al Arhaamu Wa Ma Tazdad Wa Kulu Shain Indahu Bi Miqdaar (8)
en: Allah Knows what every female bears, and the lessening and growing of the womb. Everything with Him has a measure.

ar: رَبِّي هَبْ لي من لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَةً طَيِّبَةً اِنَّكَ سَميعُ الدُّعاء(38). سورة العمران
latin: Rabbi Hib Li Min Ladonka Thoriyatan Tayebah Innaka Sameeo Al Dua (38)
en: My Lord grant me from Thee good virtuous offspring of your bounty. Truly You are the Hearer of Prayer

ar: فقال ربّ اِنّي لِما اُنزِلتَ الىّ من خَيْر فَقير(24). سورة القصص
latin: Fa Qala Rabbi Inni Lima Anzilta Ellaya Men Khairin Faqeer (24)
en: My Lord! I am needy of whatever good Thou sendest down for me

ar: لا اِلَه الا اَنْتَ سُبْحانَك اِنّي كُنْتُ مِن الظالمين
latin: La Ilaha illa Anta Subhanak Ini Kunto Mena Al Thalemeen
en: There are none worthy of worship besides You. Glorified are You. Surely I am from the wrongdoers

ar: وَاصْبِرْ و ما صَبْرُكَ الا بالله ولا تَحزَن عَلَيْهِم و لا تَكُ في ضيقٍ مِمَّا يَمْكُرون اِنّ اللهَ مَعَ الذين اتَّقوا و الذين هُم مُحْسِنون
latin: Wa Asbir Wa Ma Sabroka Illa Billah Wa La Tahzan Aliehim Wa La Tako Fi Deegin Minma Yamkoroon, Inna Allaha Maa Allatheena Ataqoo Wa Allatheena Hom Mohseenoon
en: And be patient, for your patience is only by the help of Allah. And do not grieve over them, nor be in distress over what they conspire. Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.

nama: Recite Surat Al Rum for Marriage Disagreements:
ar: وَ مِن اَياتِهِ أَن خَلَقَ لَكُم مِن اَنْفُسِكُم اَزواجاً لِتَسْكُنوا  اِلَيْها و جَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَوَدَّةً وَ رَحْمَةً اِنَّ في ذَلِكَ لَآياتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرون (21). سورة الروم
latin: Wa Men Aayatihi An Khalaqa Lakum Men Anfusikom Azwaajaa Litaskuno Ilayha Wa Jaala Baynakom Mawadataan Wa Rahmah Ina Fi Thalika LeAyaat Liqaoumen Yatafakaroon (21)
en: And of His signs is this: He created for you helpmeets from yourselves that ye might find rest in them, and He ordained between you love and mercy. Lo! herein indeed are portents for folk who reflect

ar: سُبْحانَ الذي خَلَقَ الاَزواجَ كُلَّها مِمَّا تُنْبِت الاَرضُ ومِن اَنْفُسِهِم وَ مِمَّا لا يَعْلَمون(36)
latin: Subhaan Allathi Khalaqa Al Azwaaj Kulaha Mema Tunbeto Al Arede Wa Men Anfosihem Wa Mema La Yaalamoon (36)
en: Glory be to Him Who created all the sexual pairs, of that which the earth groweth, and of themselves, and of that which they know not

ar: بارَكَ الله لَكَ و بارَك عَلَيْكَ و جَمَعَ  بينكما في الخَيْر
latin: Baraka Allah Lak Wa Baraka Aliek Wa Jamaa Baynakum Fe Al Khair
en: May Allah bless you and send blessings upon you, and bring goodness between you.

ar: اللَّهُم اَلِّف بَيْنَ قلوبِنا وَ اَصْلِح ذاتَ بَيْنَنا وَ اَهْدِنا سُبُلَ السَّلام وَ نَجِّنا مِن الظُلُماتِ الى النور
latin: Allahuma Alef Bayna Qoloobina Wa Asleh Thata Baynana Wa Ahdena Subola Al Salaam Wa Najena Min Al Thulomaat Ila Al Noor
en: O Allah Reconcile (with love) between our hearts. And resolve our (broken) affairs, and guide us toward peace and the path of guidance, And take us out of the darkness toward the light (noor)

ar: اللَّهُم اِنَّك تَقْدُر وَ لا اَقْدُرُ وَ تَعْلَم و لا اَعْلَم و اَنْتَ عَلَّامَ الغُيوب فإن رَأيْتَ اَنَّ في فُلانَةٍ خَيْراً لي في ديني وَ دُنْيايّ وَ اَخِرَتي فَأقْدِرُها لي وَ اِن كانَ غَيْرُها خَيْراً مِنْها لي في ديني وَ اَخِرَتي فَأقْدِرها لي
latin: Allahum Innaka Taqder Wala Aqder Wa Taalem Wa La Aalem Wa Anta Alaam AlGhuyoob Faen Raayta Fi Fulanatin Khairaan Li Fi Deeny Wa Dunyaay Wa Akhiraty Fa Aqderuha Li Wa In Kana  Ghayruha Khairaan Minha Li Fi Deeny Wa Akheraty Fa Aqderha Li
en: O Allah, You have power (control) and I have no control and You know and I do not know, You know the condition of the Unseen. Thus if You see (deem fit) that this person (mention the name here) is good for me concerning my Deen, world and Akhirah (hereafter) then grant me this (make them accept) and if there is another person besides this one which is better for me concerning my Deen, Akhira then specify them for me.

ar: اللّهُم اِنِّي اُريد  أَن اَتَزَوّج فَقَدِّر لي مِن النِساء اَعفَهُنَّ فَرجاً اِحفَظْهُنَّ لي في نَفْسِها وَ اَوْسَعْهُنَّ لي رِزقاً وَ اَعَظَمَهُنَّ لي بَرَكَةٍ في  نفسي وَ مالي فَقَدِّر لي مِنها وَلَداً طَيِّباً تَجْعَلُهُ خَلَفاً صالِحاً في حياتي وَ بَعْدَ مَوْتي
latin: Allahum Ini Oureed An Atajawaaj Faqader Li Men Alnesaa Oafhuna Farajaan Wa Ahfithhunna Li Fi Nafsey Wa Aosaahuna Li Rizqaa Wa Aothamahuna Li Barakatin Fi Nafosiha Wa Maalee Faqaderlee Minha Waladaan Tayebaan Tajalohu Khalfaa Saalehaan Fi Hayaatee Wa Baada Maotee
en: Oh Allah I wish to get married so grant me the righteous one and grant me an offspring that will be righteous and will pray for me after I have deceased

nama: Dua to bring Husband & Wife closer
ar: اللَّهُم اِنّي اَسألُكَ حُبَّكَ وَ حُبَّ مَن يُحِبُّكَ  وَالعمَل الَّذِي يُبْلِغْني حُبَّك اللَّهُم اجعَل حُبَّك اَحَبَ اليّ مِن نَفْسي وَ أَهلي
latin: Allahum Ini Asaluka Hubak Wa Hubba Men Yuhibik WaalAmala  Allathi Yobleghny Hubbak, Allahum Ajaal Hubbak Ahaba Illay Min Nafsey Wa Ahly
en: Oh Allah I ask You for Your Love and the love of all those that love you Oh Allah embody Your Love in me and my family

ar: أرزِقْنا و أنت خير الرازِقين
latin: Orziqna wa anta Khair al Raziqeen
en: And provide for us sustenance and You are the Best of providers

ar: اللهُم انّي اَسألُكَ عِلماً نافِعاً و رِزْقاً طَيِّباً و عَمَلاً مُتَقَبِّلاً
latin: Allahumma Inni Asaluka Aelman Nafiaa Wa Rizqaan Tayeba Wa Amallan Mutaqabila
en: Oh Allah I ask You for Knowledge that is of benefit, a good provision and deeds that will be accepted

ar: اللهُم اَرزُقني ما لا وولدا و بارك لي في ما اَعطَيْتَني
latin: Allahumma Arzoqni Ma La Walada Wa Barik Li Fi Ma Aataytanee
en: Oh Allah Grant me wealth and children and bless what You give me

ar: اللهُم اني اَسألُكَ العَفو و العافِيَة في الدُنيا و الاَخِرَة اللهُم اني أسألُكَ العَفو و العافِيَة في ديني و دُنياي و أهلي و مالي اللهُم اَستُر عَوْراتي  و اَمِن رَوعاتي  اللهُم اَحفظني من بين يَدَي و من خَلفي و عن يميني و عن شِمالي ومِن  فَوْقي و اَعوذُ بِعَظَمتِكَ اَن اُغتال من تحتي
latin: Allahuma Ini Asaloka Al Afoo Wa Al Aafiyah Fi Al Dunya Wal Aakhirah, Allahuma Ini Asaluka Al Afoo Wa Al Aafiyah Fi Deenee Wa Dunyaya Wa Ahlee Wa Maalee, Allahuma Astor Aawratee Wa Aamen Rawaatee, Allahuma Ahfathnee Min Bayeni Yaday Wa Min Khalfee Wa Aan Yameenee Wa Aan Shemaalee Wa Min Fawqee Wa Aaouthoo Biathamatika An Oghtaal Min Tahtee.
en: Oh Allah I seek Your forgiveness and Your protection in this world and the next. Oh Allah I seek You forgiveness and Your protection in my religion, in my worldly affairs, in my family and in my wealth. Oh Allah conceal my secrets and preserve me from anguish. Oh Allah guard me from what is in front of me and behind me, from my left and from my right and from above me. I seek refuge in Your Greatness from being struck down from beneath me

ar: اللهُم اَكفِني بِحلالَك عن حَرامَك و اَغنني بفضلِك عَمَّن سِواك
latin: Allahuma Akfinee Behalaalek An Haraamek Wa Aghninnee Bifathlika Anman Sewaak
en: Oh Allah, give me enough, give me Your halal provision and save me from haram provision and do not make me needy of anyone except Yourself, by Your grace

ar: رَبَّنا اَتِنا في الدنيا حَسَنةُ و في الاخِرَةِ حَسَنة و قِنا عذاب النار
latin: Rabana Aatina Fi Aldunya Hasanah Wa Fi Al Akhira Hasanah Wa Qina Aathab AlNaar
en: Our Lord! Give unto us in the world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and guard us from the doom of Fire

nama: Dua for Guidance, Piety, Chastity & Wealth
ar: اللهُم اِنّي اَسألُكَ الهُدى و التُقى و العَفافَ  والغني
latin: Allahuma Ini Asaloka Al Huda Wa Altoqa Wa Al Aafafa Wal Ghina
en: Oh Allah I am praying (asking) to You for guidance, piety, chastity and wealth

nama: Dua to have a Good Business
ar: قُل هُوَ اللهُ اَحَد (1) اللهُ الصَمَد (2)   لم يَلِد و لم يولَد  (3) و لم يَكُن لهُ كُفُواً اَحَد  (4)
latin: Qol Huwa Allahu Ahad (1) Allahu Al Samad (2) Lam Yalid Wa Lam Youlad (3) Wa Lam Yakon Laho Kofoaan Ahad(4)
en: Say: He is Allah, the One(1) Allah, the eternally Besought of all(2) He begetteth not nor was begotten(3) And there is none comparable unto Him(4)

nama: Dua for Abundance in Sustenance & repayment of Debt
ar: الله لَطيف بِعِبادِهِ يرزُقُ مَن يَشاءُ و هُوَ القَوي العزيز
latin: Allahu Lateef Be Ibaadihi Yarzoqqo Men Yashaa Wa Huwa Al Qawee Al Aziz
en: Allah is gracious to His servants. He gives sustenance to whom He wills. And He is the strong, the All Mighty

ar: يا الله يا الله يا الله يارَبُّ ياربُّ يارَبُّ يا حَي يا قَيُّومُ يا ذا الجلالِ و الاِكرامِ أسألُكَ باسمِك العظيم الأعظَمِ أن تَرزُقني رِزقاً واسِعاً حلالاً طَيِّباً بِرَحمَتِكَ يا أرحَم الراحِمين
latin: Ya Allah Ya Allah Ya Allah Ya Rab Ya Rab Ya Rab Ya Hay Ya Qayoom Ya Tha Al Jalaali Wa Alikraam, As Alouka Bi Ismika Al Atheem Al Aatham An Tarzoqanee Rizqaan Wasiaan Halallan Tayebaa Bi Rahmatika Ya Arham Al Rahemeen.
en: Oh Allah my Lord, The Ever-Living, The Sustainer, The Self-Subsisting, Oh the Possessor of Glory and Honour, Lord of Majesty and Generosity, I ask you with Your Magnificent and Supreme names to grant me abundance of sustenance, wealth that is halal, Oh Most Beneficent and Most Merciful Grant me sustenance with your mercy

ar: لا تَدرِكَهُ الا بَصارُ و هُوَ يُدرِكُ الأبصارَ  وَ هُوَ اللطيف الخَبير
latin: La Tudrikhu Illa Basaar Wa Huwa Yadriko Al Absaar Wa Huwa Al Lateef Al Khabeer
en: Sight cannot perceive Him, And He perceives sight, He is the Subtle, the Well-Aware

ar: و إذا قلنا اَدخُلوا هَذِهِ القريةَ فكُلوا منها حَيثُ شِئتُم رَغَداً و  اَدخِلوا البابَ سُجَّداً  و قُولوا  حِطَّةٌ نَغفِر لكُم خَطاياكُم و سَنَزيدُ المُحسِنين
latin: Wa Ith Qolna Adkholo Hathihi Al Qarya Fa Kolo Minha Haytho Shetom Raghadan Wa Adkhilo Al Baba Sojodaa Wa Qooloo Hitaton Naghfir Lakom Khatayakom Wa Sanazeedu Al Mohseeneen
en: And (remember) when we said: Go into this town and eat bountifully from it (from its blessings) wherever you wish, and enter the gate in prostration and say:”Hitta’(we wish that our sins may be forgiven) and We shall forgive your sins (We shall change your sins into merits) and shall increase (the blessings) for the good doers (Muhsinun)

ar: اللهُم اَكثِر مالي ووَلَدي و بارِك لي فيما اَعطَيْتَني واَطلِ حَياتي على طاعَتِك و اُحسِن عَمَلي و اَغفِر لي
latin: Allahuma Akthir Malee Wa Walady Wa Barik Lee Feman Aataytanee Wa Atil Hayati Ala Taatik Wa Ahsin Aamalee Wa Aghfir Lee
en: Oh Allah increase my wealth and offspring and bless me in what You have given me and direct my life to Your obedience and rectify my actions and forgive me

ar: رَبنا عليكَ توكّلنا و إليكَ انَبْنا و إليكَ المصير
latin: Rabana Alayka Tawakalna Wa Ielayka Anbna Wa Ilayka AlMaseer
en: Oh Lord, on Thee do we rely and to Thee do we turn, and to Thee is the end of all journeys

ar: الحمدُلله الذي عرّفني نفسهُ و لم يتركني عميان القلبِ الحمدلله الذي جعلني من اُمَة ِمُحِمد صلى اللهُ عليه و اله الحمدُلله الذي جَعل رزقي في يديهِ و لم يَجعَل رزقي في اَيدي الناس الحَمدُلله الذي سَتر ذنوبي و عيوبي و لم يفضَحني بين الخلائق
latin: Al Hamdulillah Allathee Arafanee Nafsahu Wa Lam Yatrokanee Aamyanan Al Qalib, Al Hamdulillah Allathee Jaalanee Men Omati Mohamed Sal Allahu Alayhee Wa Aalihi, Alhamdulillah Allathee Jaala Rizqee Fee Yadeheeh Wa Lam Yaajal Rizqee Fee Aydee Al Naas, Alhamdulillah Allathee Sater Thonobee Wa Ouyobee Wa Lam Yafthahnee Bayna Al Akhlayq
en: All praise to Allah who made Himself known to me and did not make me blind-hearted. All praise to Allah who included me among the followers of Muhammed (peace be upon him). All praise to Allah who has ordained my sustenance to be in His own hands and not in the hands of human beings. All praise to Allah who has covered my sins and shortcomings and did not degrade me in the eyes of human beings.

nama: Dua to get rid of Debt
ar: اللهُم اَكفِني بحلالَك عن حرامَك و أغنِني بفَضلِكَ عمَّن سِواك
latin: Allahuma Akfinee Bi Halaalak An Haramak Wa Aghninee Bi Fathlika Aanman Sewaak
en: Oh Allah suffice me with that which is lawful against that which is prohibited and make me independent of all those besides You

ar: قال رب اِنّي لِما اُنزِلتَ الىّ من خَيْر فَقير
latin: Qala Rabi Inni Lima Anzalta Ilayya Min Khayrin Faqeer
en: Oh my Lord, Truly I am in need of whatever good You bestow on me.

ar: اللَّهُم اِنّي اَعوذُ بِكَ من غَلَبَة الدَيْن
latin: Allahum ma Ini Aaoutho Bika Min Ghalabat Al Dayn
en: Oh Allah, I seek refuge in You from the burden of Debt

ar: اللّهُم اَكْفِني بِحلالِك عَن حَرامِك و اَغنِني بِفَضلِكَ عَمَّن سِواك
latin: Allahum Akfinee Be Halaalaka Aan Haramak Wa Aghninii Bifathlika Amen Sewaak
en: Oh Allah Suffice me with that which is lawful against that which is prohibited and make me independent of all those besides You

nama: Recite From the Quran- Surat Al Imran to help with Debt
ar: قُل اللّهُمّ مالِك المُلك تؤتي المُلك مَن تَشاء و تَنْزَع المُلك مِمَّن تَشاء و تُعِزُّ مَن تَشاء و تُزِلُّ مَن تَشاء بِيَدِكَ الخَيْر اِنَّكَ على كُل شَئٍ قَدير(26) تولِجُ الليلَ في النَّهارِ و تولِج النَّهار في اللّيْل و تُخْرِج الحيّ مِن المَيِّت و تُخْرِج المَيِّت من الحَيّ و تَرزُق من تَشاءُ بِغَيْر حِسابٍ(27)
latin: Qol Allahuma Maalik Al Mulik Totee Al Mulk Min Tashaa Wa Tanzaa Al Mulka mmen Tashaa Wa Tuizoo Man Tashaa Wa Tuthilo Men Tashaa Biyadeka Al Khair Innaka Ala Kuli Shayen Qadeer (26). Tulij Allila Fi Al Nahaari Wa Tulij Al Nahaar Fi Al Lail, Wa Tukhrij AlHaya Mena Al Mayet Wa Tukhrij Al Mayet Mena Al Hay Wa Turzaq Men Tashaa Beghairi Hisaab. (27)
en: “O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honor whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand is (all) good. Indeed, You are over all things  competent (26). You cause the night to enter the day, and You cause the day to enter the night; and You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living. And You give provision to whom You will without account (27).”

nama: Dua For Exams and Stressful Times
ar: قَالَ رَبّي اشرح لي صَدري (25) و يَسِّر لي اَمري (26) و اُحللُ عُقدَةً من لِساني (27)يَفقَهوا قَوْلي(28)
latin: Qala Rabbi Ashrah Li Sadri (25) Wa Yaser Li Amry (26) Wa Ahlil Oqdatin Min Lisaani (27) Yafqahu Qawlee (28)
en: (Moses) said ‘My Lord, expand for me my chest (with assurance) (25) And ease for me my task (26) And untie the knot from my tongue (27) That they may understand my speech

ar: اللّهُم انفَعني بِما عَلَّمتَني و عَلِّمَني ما يَنفَعني اللّهُم اِنّي اَسألُكَ فَهِم النّبَيَيْن و حِفظ المُرسَلين والملائكة المقَرَّبين
latin: Allahum Anfaaney Bema Aalamtanee Wa Aalamanee Ma Yanfaaonee. Allahum Ini Asaluka Fehema Al Nabiyeen Wa Hefitha Almorsaleen Wal Malaika AlMuqarabeen
en: Oh Allah Make useful for me what you have taught me and teach me knowledge that will be useful to me. Oh Allah I ask you for the understanding of the Prophets and the memory of the Messengers and those nearest to You

ar: اللَّهُم لا سَهْلَ الا ما جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً و أَنتَ تَجْعَل الحُزن إذا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً
latin: Allahum La Sahla Illa Ma Jaaltahu Sahaa Wa Anta Tajalu Al Hazaana Ith Sheta Sahlaa
en: Oh Allah There is nothing easy except what You make easy, and You make the difficult easy if it be Your Will

nama: Dua for Success in Exam/ Interview
ar: اللهم إنّي اَسألُكَ خَيْرَ هذا اليَوْم  فتحه ونصره ونوره وبركته وهداه
latin: Allahum Ini Asaluka Khayra Hatha Al Yaoum Fathahu Wa Nasreh Wa Norahu Wa Barakatahu Wa Hudaah
en: Oh Allah, verily I ask you for all the goodness that this day brings and Your help and Your light and Your blessing and guidance

nama: Dua for Success in Exam/ Interview
ar: سُبْحانَك لا عِلْمَ لَنا إلا ما عَلَّمْتَنا إنّكَ أنْتَ العَليمُ الحَكيم
latin: Sobhanaka La Ailma Lana Illa Ma Alamtana Innaka Anata Al Aleemo Al Hakeem
en: Be glorified! We have no knowledge saving that which Thou hast taught us. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Knower, the Wise

nama: Dua using Allah's Name: Al Fattah
ar: يا فَتَّاحُ
latin: Ya Fataah
en: The Supreme Solver

nama: Dua for Success in Exam/ Interview
ar: فَصَبْرٌ جَميلٌ و اللّهُ المُسْتَعانُ على ما تَصِفون
latin: Fasabiron Jameel Wa Allahu Almostaan Ala Ma Tasefoon
en: So Patience is beautiful and Allah is the helper and guider for what you desire

ar: اللَّهُم اِنَّي اَعوذُ بِكَ من الهَمِّ و الحُزْنِ و أعوذُ بِكَ من العَجْز و الكَسَلِ و أعوذُ بِكَ من الجُبْنِ و البُخْلِ و اَعوذُ بِكَ من غَلَبَة الدَيْنِ و قَهْر الرِجال
latin: Allahuma Ini Aaoutho Bika Min Al Ham Wa Alhazan Wa Aaoutho Bika Min Al Ajaz Wa AlKasal, Wa Aoutho Bika Men Al Jubni Wa AlBoukhl, Wa Aoutho Bika Men Ghalabati Al Dayni Wa Qher Al Rijaal
en: Oh Allah I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being oppressed by men

ar: اللّهُم عَلَّمَنا ما يَنْفَعْنا و اَنْفَعَنا بِما  علمتنا و زِدْنا عِلْماً
latin: Allahuma Aalamana Ma Yanfaan Wa Anfaana Bima Alamtana Wa Zidna Ilmaa
en: Oh Allah Teach us that which benefits us and benefit us with that which You teach us and increase us in knowledge

ar: قَالَ رَبّي اشرح لي صَدري (25) و يَسِّر لي اَمري (26)
latin: Qala Rabbi Ashrah Li Sadri (25) Wa Yaser Li Amry (26)
en: Oh my Lord Open for me my chest (grant me self-confidence, contentment, and boldness);Ease my task

ar: اللَّهُم اَجْعَلني خَيْراً مِمَّا يَظُنون وَ أغفِر لي مالايَعْلَمون و لا  تؤاخذني بِما يَقولون
latin: Allahuma Ajalnee Khayran Mima Yathonoon Wa Aghfir Li Ma La Yaalamoon, Wa La Toukhaithnee Bema Yaqooloon
en: O Allah make me better than what they think of me and forgive me for what they do not know about me And do not take me to account for what they say about me

ar: فإن حَسْبِكَ الله هُوَ الذي اَيَّدَكَ بِنْصْرِهِ و بِالمؤمِنين (62)  سورة الاَنفال
latin: Fa Ina Hasbaka Allah Huwa Allathi Ayadaka Binasrihi Wa Bil Mooumineen (62)
en: And if they would deceive thee, then lo! Allah is Sufficient for thee. He it is Who supporteth thee with His help and with the believers

ar: رَبّي اَدْخِلني مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ و أخرِجْني مُخْرجَ صِدْقٍ و إجْعَلُ لي مِن لَدُنْكَ سلطاناً نَصيراً
latin: Rabbi Adkhilni Mudkhala Sidqaan Wa Akhrijni Mokhrajaa Sidqaan Wa Ajaal Li Min Ladonka Soltanan Naseera
en: My Lord! Cause me to come in with a firm incoming and to go out with a firm outgoing. And give me from Thy presence a sustaining Power

ar: اللَّهُم إنّي اَستوْدِعَكَ ما قَرأْتُ و ما حَفِظْتُ فَرُدُّهُ عَليّ عِندَ حاجَتي اِليْه اِنّكَ لي ما تَشاءُ قَدير و اَنْتَ حَسْبي و نِعْمَ الوَكيل
latin: Allahuma Ini Astaodaaka Ma Qarata Wa Ma Hafitht Farodohu Li Inda Hajatee Ilayhi, Innaka Ala Ma Tashao Qadeer Wa Anta Hasbee Wa Niama Al Wakeel
en: Oh Allah I have entrusted You with what I have read and what I have studies. Oh Allah bring it back to me when I am in need of it. Oh Allah You do what You wish

ar: رَبّي اِشرح لي صَدري و يسِّر لي اَمري
latin: Rabbi Ashrah Li Sadree Wa Yasir Li Amree
en: “O my Lord expand my breast (grant me contentment) and ease my task for me”.

ar: الله الله ربّي لا أُشرِكَ بِهِ شَيْئاً الله الله رَبِّي لا اُشرك به شَيْئاً
latin: Allah Allaha Rabbee Laa Oshrik bihi Shay’a, Allah Allaaha Rabbee laa ooshrik bihi Shay’a
en: “Allah, Allah is my Lord. I do not associate anything with Him. Allah, Allah is my Lord. I do not associate anything with him”.

ar: اللهُم استُر عَوْرَتي و اَمِن رَوْعَتي
latin: Allahum Astoir A’auratee Wa Aamin Rawoatee
en: “O Allah Conceal my faults and keep me safe from the things which I fear”.

ar: اللهُمَّ اني اَجعَلُكَ في نُحورِهِم وَ اَعوذُ بِكَ من شرورِهِم
latin: AllaHumma inni Ajalooka Fee Noohoorihim Wa A’aoothoobika Min Shooroorihim
en: “O Allah we put You in front of them (enemy) and we seek refuge in You from their evils”.

ar: لا حَول و لا قوة الا بالله العَلِيّ العَظيم
latin: La Hawla Wala Quwwata illah billahil Al Ali-yil Atheem
en: “There is no Power and no Strengh except with Allah”.

nama: Dua when feeling alarmed/ fear/ anxiety & unrest in sleep:
ar: اَعوذُ بِكلمات الله التامّاتِ من غضبه و عِقابهِ و شَر عِبادِه و من همزات الشيطان و اَن يَحضرون
latin: A’aotho Bikalimaati Allah Al Taamaati Min Ghathabhi Wa Eiqabh Wa Shar Eibadih Wa Min Hamazaati Al Shaytaani Wa An Yahdoroon
en: “I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from His anger and His punishment, from the evil of His slaves and from the suggestion of devils and from their presence”.

nama: Dua for Protection from Stress, Hunger, Disgrace, Injustice:
ar: اللهُم اني اعوذُ بِكَ من الفقرِ و الفاقّة والقلة و الذِلَّة و اعوذ بك من اَن اَظلِم اَوْ اُظلَم
latin: Allaahumma inni a’uthubika min al-faqri wal faaqah wal qillati wal-Thillah, wa a’uthubika min an athlima aw uthlam
en: “O Allah, I seek refuge in You from stress and hunger and humiliation and I seek refuge in You lest I abuse others or be abused”.

ar: رَبَّنا افرِغ علينا صَبراً و تَوَفِّنا مُسلمين
latin: Rabana Afrigh Alayena Sabraan Wa Tawafana moslimeen
en: Our Lord! Vouchsafe unto us steadfastness and make us die as men who have surrendered (unto Thee)

nama: Dua to Deal with Distress & Depression
ar: و ذا النون اِذا ذهب مُغاضِباً فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ عليهِ فَنادي في الظُلُمات اَنّ لا اله الا انت سَبحانَك اِنِّي كُنت من الظالمين
latin: Wa Dhun-Nun Itha Thahaba Moghadebaan Fa Than Ana Lan Naqdira Alaih Fanada Fi Altholomaat An La Illaha Illa Anta Subhanaka Inni Konto Mina Althalimeen
en: “And Dhun-Nun when he went (while)angry and thought that never We would restrict/straiten him. Then he called in the darkness(es) that, (There is) no god except You, Glory be You! Indeed I am of the wrongdoers”.

nama: Dua to Deal with Distress & Depression
ar: اللهُم رحمَتِك ارجو فلا تَكِلني  الي نفسي طرفة عين و اصلح لي شأني كُلَّهُ لا اله الا أنت
latin: Allahum Rahmatika Arjo Fala Takilni ila Nafsee Tarfit Ayen Wa Aslah Li Shaanii Kulahu La Illaha Illa Anta
en: “O Allah, I hope  for Your mercy. Do not leave me to myself even for the blinking of an eye (i.e a moment). Correct all of my affairs for me. There is none worthy of worship but You”.

nama: Dua for Rescue from Tough Situation
ar: يا حَيّ يا قَيّوم بِرَحمَتِك  استغيث
latin: Yaa Hayyu Yaa Qayyuum, Birahmatika Astagheeth
en: “O You, the Alive, the Eternal. By Your mercy I am pleading for rescue”.

ar: ربي اِشرَح لي صَدري و يَسِّر لي امري  وأحلل عُقْدَةَ مِن لِساني يفقهوا قَوْلي
latin: Rabbi Ashreh Lee Sadri Wa Yasir Li Amri Wa Ahlul Oqdatan min Lisaani Yafqahou Qawlie.
en: O my Lord, Open my heart, make my task easy for me and remove the knot from my tongue, so they may understand my speech

ar: الحَمدُلله
latin: Al Hamdullallah
en: All Praises and thanks are to Allah

ar: يَرحَمَكُم الله
latin: Yerhamukom Allah
en: May Allah have mercy upon you

ar: يَهديكُم الله و يَصْلَح بالَكُم
latin: Yehdeekom Allah Wa Yoslehu Balakom
en: May Allah guide you and set your affairs in order

ar: اللّهُم اِنّي اسألُكَ مِن فَضلِكَ
latin: Allahum Ini Asaluka Min Fadlek
en: Oh Allah, I ask You from Your favour

nama: Dua When Hearing a Dog Bark
ar: اَعوذُبالله من الشَيْطانِ الرجيم
latin: Aoudhu Billah Mina Al Shaytaan Al Rajeem
en: I seek protection in Allah from shaytan, the accursed one

ar: الحُمْدُلله الذي اَحْيانا بَعْدَ ما أماتَنا وَ اِلَيْهِ النُشور
latin: Alhamdullah Allathee Ahyaana Bada Ma Amatana Wa Ilayhee Al Noshoor
en: All praise is for Allah, who grace us life after having taken it from us, and unto Him is the Resurrection

ar: اللَّهُم بِسْمِكَ اَموت وَ اَحْيا
latin: Allahum Bismika Amoot Wa Ahya
en: O Allah, In Your name I live and die

ar: اللَّهُمَّ قِني عَذابَك يَوْم تُبْعَثُ عِبادَك
latin: Allahum Qenee Athabak Yauma Tobathoo Ibaadak
en: Oh Allah save me from Your punishment the day You resurrect Your slaves

nama: Dua When looking in the Mirror
ar: اللَّهُمَّ  كما حسنت خَلْقي فَحَسِّن خُلْقي
latin: Allahum Kama Hasanta Khalqee Fa Hasen Kholqee
en: Oh Allah (SWT) You have beautified my body, so do beautify my character

ar: اللَّهُمّ اِنّي اَعوذُ بِكَ مِن الخُبْث وَ الخَبائِث
latin: Allahum Ini Aoutho bika min Al Khobith Wal Khabaeth
en: Oh Allah (SWT) I seek Your protection from the male and female devils

ar: غُفْرانَك الحَمدُلله الذي اَذْهَبَ عَنِّي الاَذى وَ عافاني
latin: Ghofraneka Alhamdullah Allathee Athhaba Anee Al Atha Wa Afanee
en: I seek Your pardon, Praise be to Allah (SWT) who removed from me discomfort and gave me relief

ar: الحَمْدُلله الذي كساني هَذا وَرَزَقَنيهِ مِن غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنّي وَ لا قُوَّةٍ
latin: Alhamdullah Allathee Kasaanee Hatha Wa Razaqni Men Ghairy Hawlaan Mini Wa La Quwa
en: All praise belongs to Allah, the one who clothed me with this (cloth) and gave it to me without any power and ability from me

ar: الحَمدُلله الذي اَطْعَمَنا وَ سَقانا وَ كَفانا وَ آوانا فَكَم مِمَّن لا كافي لَهُ وَ لا مُئْوي
latin: Al Hamdullah Allathee Atamana Wa Saqana Wa Kafana Wa Awana Fakam Min Men La Kafee Lahu Wala Maowaa
en: Praise be to All who has fed me this food and provided it for me, without any strength or power on my part

ar: بِسْمِ الله وَ على بَرَكةِ الله
latin: Bismillah Wa Ala Barkati Allah
en: In the name of Allah (SWT) and with the blessings of Allah (SWT) I begin (eating)

ar: اللّهُم بارِك لَنا فيما رَزَقْتَنا وَ قِنا عَذابَ النار بِسْمِ الله
latin: Allahum Barek Lana Fima Razaqtana Wa Qena Athaab Al Naar Bismallah
en: Oh Allah bless (the food) You provided us and save us from the punishment of the fire in the name of Allah (SWT)

ar: أُعيذكما بِكَلِماتِ الله التامَّةِ مِن كُلِّ شَيْطانِ  وهامةٍ ومن كُل عَيْنٍ لامَّةٍ
latin: Aedukuma Be Kalemaat Allah Al Tamah Men Kul Shaytanin Wa Hamah Wa Men Kul Ayenin Lamah
en: I seek protection for you in the Perfect Words of Allah (SWT) from every devil and every beast and from every envious blameworthy eye

ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلاَةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
latin: Allahumma Rabba hadhihid-da`watit-tammah, was-solatil qa'imah, ati Muhammadan-l-wasilata wal-fadilah, wa-b`ath-hu maqaman mahmudan-il-ladhi wa`adtah
en: O Allah! Lord of this perfect call (perfect by not ascribing partners to You) and of the regular prayer which is going to be established, give Muhammad the right of intercession and illustriousness, and resurrect him to the best and the highest place in Paradise that You promised him (of).

ar: اللهم إني أسألك خيرها ، وخير مافيها ، وخير ما أرسلت به وأعوذ بك من شرها ، وشر مافيها ، وشر ما أرسلت به .
latin: Allahuma Ini Asaluka Khairaha Wa Khaira Ma Fiha Wa Khaira Ma orsalet Beh Wa Aoudthou Bika Min Shareha Wa Shari Ma Fiha Wa Shari Ma Orsalet Beh
en: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this wind, for the good of what it contains, and for the good of what is sent with it. I seek refuge in You from the evil of it, from the evil of what it contains, and from the evil that is sent with it.

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ اِنِّي اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيْحِ الدَّجَّالِ
latin: Allaahumma inni a’oodhu bika min ‘adhaab jahannam wa min ‘adhaab al-qabr wa min fitnat il-mahyaa wa’l-mamaat wa min sharri fitnat al-maseeh al-dajjaal”
en: O Allah I seek refuge in you from the punishment of hell, the torment of the grave, trial of living and dying, and from the evil trial of the Antichrist

nama: Beautiful Aya from Surah Al Noor
ar: اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأرْضِ مَثَلُ نُورِهِ كَمِشْكَاةٍ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌ الْمِصْبَاحُ فِي زُجَاجَةٍ الزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّيٌّ يُوقَدُ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ مُبَارَكَةٍ زَيْتُونَةٍ لا شَرْقِيَّةٍ وَلا غَرْبِيَّةٍ يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِيءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارٌ نُورٌ عَلَى نُورٍ يَهْدِي اللَّهُ لِنُورِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ الأمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ   [النور35] .
latin: Allahu nooru alssamawati waalardi mathalu noorihi kamishkatin feeha misbahun almisbahu fee zujajatin alzzujajatu kaannaha kawkabun durriyyun yooqadu min shajaratin mubarakatin zaytoonatin la sharqiyyatin wala gharbiyyatin yakadu zaytuha yudeeo walaw lam tamsashu narun noorun AAala noorin yahdee Allahu linoorihi man yashao wayadribu Allahu alamthala lilnnasi waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun
en: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The similitude of His light is as a niche wherein is a lamp. The lamp is in a glass. The glass is as it were a shining star. (This lamp is) kindled from a blessed tree, an olive neither of the East nor of the West, whose oil would almost glow forth (of itself) though no fire touched it. Light upon light. Allah guideth unto His light whom He will. And Allah speaketh to mankind in allegories, for Allah is Knower of all things

ar: سبحان الله سيؤتينا الله من فضله انا إلى الله راغبون. اللهم اني أسالك بأنك مالك الملك وانك على كل شي قدير وما تشاء من أمرا يكون أن تقول لأمنيتي كن ليكون عاجلا و تغير حالي لأفضل حال ربي إفتح لي برحمتك كل شئ وارزقني رزقا واسعا مباركا عاجلا يا كريم يارب
en: “Allah is sufficient for us! Allah will grant us out of His bounty, and so will His Messenger. To Allah ˹alone˺ we turn with hope.”

nama: Duas for Your Children from the Quran - Surat Al Omraan (38)
ar: (74)   رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
latin: Rabbana Hib Lana Men Ajwajina Wa Dhoriyatina Qorat Aiyon Wa Ajalna Lil Motaqeen Emaman
en: Our Lord, grant us delight in our spouses and our children and make us a good example for the righteous (74)

nama: Duas for Your Children from the Quran - Surat Al Forqan (74)
ar: رَبِّي هِب لي من لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَةً طَيِّبَةً اِنَّكَ سَميعُ الدُّعاء(38)
latin: Rabbi Heb Li Min Ladonka Thoriyatan Tayebah Innaka Sameeo Al Duaa
en: My Lord grant me from Thee good virtuous offspring of your bounty. Truly You are the Hearer of Prayer

nama: Duas for Your Children from the Quran - Surat Ibrahim(40)
ar: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي ۚ رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
latin: Rabbi Ajaalney Moqeema Al Salati Wa Men Dhoriyatey Rabbana WaTaqabal Duaa
en: My Lord, make me one who performs the prayers, and from my offspring. My Lord accept my supplication

nama: Duas for Your Children from the Quran - Surat Al Ahqaf (15)
ar: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي ۖ إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
latin: Rabbi Auzianey An Ashkora Neamateka Allati Anamta Alay Wa Ala Waliday Wa An Aamal Saalihaan Tardhah Wa Aslih Li Fi Dhoriyatey Ini Tobto Ilaik Wa Ini Min Al Moslimeen
en: My Lord enable me to appreciate the blessings You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to act with righteousness pleasing You. And improve my children for Me. I have sincerely repented to You, and I am of those who have surrendered

ar: اللَّهُمَّ بارِك لي فيهم ووفقَّهُم  لِطاعَتِكَ و ارزُقْني بِرَّهُم
latin: Allahuma Baarek Li Fihem Wa Wafiqhom Litaaetik Warzoqnee Berrahum
en: Oh Allah bless them and grant them success through your obedience and grant me their righteousness

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اشغَل قَلبَهُم بِحُبِّكَ و لِسانَهُم بِذِكْرِكَ، وَ بَدَنُهُم بِطاعَتِكَ
latin: Allahum Ashghel Qolobahum bihobik Wa Lisanahum Bi Thikrik Wa Badanahom Bi Taaatik
en: Oh Allah consume their hearts with Your love and their Tongues through You remembrance and their bodies with You obedience

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجعَل القُرآن العظيم ربيع قَلب اولادي و شفاء صَدرَهُم و نوراً لِبَصرهِم
latin: Allahum Ajaal Al Quraan Al Adheem Rabeea Qalba Awladee Wa Shefaa Sadrahum Wa Nooran Li Basarihim
en: Oh Allah make the Great- All Powerful Quran the spring of my childrens’ hearts’ and the cure to their chests and light to their sight

ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَسِّر اَمْرَهُم وَوَفِقَهم في حياتهم اللَّهُمّ اَمدَد في عُمْرِهم بالصِحَّة و العافِيَة في طاعَتِك و رِضاك
latin: Allahum Yaser Amrahom Wa Wafiqahom Fi Hayatihim Allahum Amdid Fi Omrahim Bel Sahati Wal Aafiyati Fi TaaAtek Wa Ridaak
en: Oh Allah please all their matters and help them succeed in their lives Oh Allah grant them long lives by good health and wellness in your obedience and satisfaction

ar: اللَّهُمَّ عافِهِم في بَدَنِهم ،اللَّهُمَّ عافِهِم في سَمْعِهِم ،اللَّهُمّ عافِهِم في بَصَرِهِم لا اِلَه الا اَنْتَ.
latin: Allahum Aafihim Fi Badanihim, Allahum Aafihim fi Samihim, Allahum Aafihim Fi Basarehim La Illaha Illa Anta
en: Oh Allah, help them in their selves (health etc), Oh Allah grant them good hearing, sight as there is no god by You

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِر ذَنْبَهُم ، وَ طَهِّر قَلبَهُم وَ حَصِّن فَرجَهُم
latin: Allahum Aghfer Thonbahom, Wa Taher Qoloobahom Wa Hasen Farjahom
en: Oh Allah forgive their sins and purify their hearts and protect them

ar: اللَّهُمّ يسير اَمرَهُم وَوفِقْهُم في حياتِهِم
latin: Allahum Yasir Amrahom Wa Wafiqahom Fi Hayatihim
en: Oh Allah make all their matters easy and help them succeed in their lives

ar: اللَّهُمّ حَبِّب اليهِم الايمان وَ زَيِّنَهُم في قَلبِهِم ،وَ كَرِّهِ اليهِم الكُفْر و الفُسوق و العِصيان و اجْعَلهم من الراشِدين
latin: Allahum Habib Alihim El Emaan Wa Zayeinho Fi Qalbihim, Wa Karreh Ilayhim Al Kofra Wa Al Fosoqa Wal Ousyaan Wa Ajalhum min Al Rashideen
en: Oh Allah grant them love to Your faith and Religion and adorn them in their hearts and make them hate this misdoings by allowing them to be righteous

ar: اللَّهُمّ اغْنِهِم بِالعِلمِ وَزَيِّنَهُم بِالحِلم و اَكرِمَهُم بالتَقْوى وَ جَمِّلهُم بالعافِيَة
latin: Allahum Aghnihim Bił Illem Wa Zayanahom Bil Hilem Wa Akrimhom Bil Taqwa Wa Jamilhom Bil Aafiya
en: Oh Allah enrich them with good knowledge and adorn them with Your piety and beautify them with wellness

ar: اللَّهُمّ انفَعْهُ بِما عَلَّمْتَه و عَلِّمْهُ ما يَنْفَعُه ،وَ زِدْنَهُ عِلْماً
latin: Allahum Anfiahu Bima Alamtah Wa Aalimahu ma Yanfaih Wa Zidhu Ilmaa
en: Oh Allah, benefit them with what You taught them and increase their knowledge

ar: اللَّهُمَّ ارزُق حُبُّكَ و حُب نَبيكَ مُحَمَّد صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ سَلَّم، وَ حُب كُل من يُحِبُّكَ و حُب عَمَل يُقَرِّبه الى حُبِّكَ
latin: Allahum Arzooqhu Hoobak Wa Hoob Nabeyaka Mohammed Sal Allahu Aliehi Wa Salem, Wa Hom Kula Men Yohebak Wa Hooba Kula Aamali Yaqrebahu Illa Hoobak
en: Oh Allah grant Your love and the love of Your Prophet Mohammed peace be upon him, and love of all those whom love You and love all the work that brings them closer to Your love

ar: اللَّهُمّ لا تَدَع لَه ذَنْباً الا غَفَرْتَهُ وَ لا هَمَّاً الا فَرَّجْتَهُ و لا دَيْناً الا قَضَيْتَهُ و لا حاجَة من حَوائِج الدُنْيا و الاَخِرَةِ الا قَضَيْتَها يا أرحَم الراحِمين
latin: Allahum La Tadeai Lahu Thanbaan Illa Ghafaertah Wa La Hamaan Illa Farajtah Wa La Daynaan Illa Qadaytah Wa La Hajatin Men Hawaij Al Donya Wal Akhirahti Ila Qadaytaha Ya Arham Al Rahemeen
en: Oh Allah, do not let him have a sin except that it is forgiven, and any bestowed sadness that is made easy and no debt unless its erased  and none of life’s obstacles unless it is granted O the Most Merciful

ar: اللَّهُمّ اكفِهِ بِحلالِكَ عَن حَرامِكَ و أغنِهِ بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّن سِواكَ
latin: Allahum Akfihe Bi Halaalika Aan Haramik Wa Aghnihi Bi Fadlika Amen Sewaak
en: O Allah suffice me with that which is lawful against that which is prohibited and make me independent of all those besides You

ar: اللَّهُمّ اَهْدِه لِأحسَن الاَخلاق لا يَهدي لِأحسَنِها الا اَنْتَ وَ اصْرِف عَنَّه سَيِّئَتِها لا يَصرِف عَنه سَيِّئَتِها الا اَنت
latin: Allahum Ahdehe Liahsaan Al Akhlaaq La Yahdee Li  AHasneha Ila Ant Wa Asref Anhu Sayiaatuha La Yasrefu Anha Sayiaatiha Illa Anta
en: Oh Allah grant them the best manners, You are the only One that is able to do this and help them rid of any misguidance and misdoings as You are the only One able to help them.

ar: اللَّهُمّ كما اَحسَنْت خَلْقَهُ فأحسن خُلُقِه
latin: Allahuma Kama Ahsanta Khalqahu Fa Asen Kholqah
en: Oh Allah as You have created the best creation, create him in the best form

ar: أُعيـذُكُمـا بِكَلِـماتِ اللهِ التّـامَّة، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْـطانٍ وَهـامَّة، وَمِنْ كُـلِّ عَـيْنٍ لامَّـة
latin: Ouethukumaa bikalimaatil-laahit-taammah min kulli shaytaanin wa haammah, wa min kulli 'aynin laammah
en: I seek protection for you in the Perfect Words of Allah from every devil and every beast, and from every envious blameworthy eye.

ar: الرَّحْمَنُ  الرَّحِيمُ  الْمَلِكُ  الْقُدُّوسُ  السَّلاَمُ  الْمُؤْمِنُ. الْمُهَيْمِنُ. الْعَزِيزُ. الْجَبَّارُ. الْمُتَكَبِّر. الْخَالِقُ
latin: AR-RAHMAAN. AR-RAHEEM. AL-MALIK. AL-QUDDUS. AS-SALAM. AL-MU’MIN. AL-MUHAYMIN. AL-AZIZ. AL-JABBAR. AL-MUTAKABBIR. AL-KHAALIQ
en: The Beneficent. The Merciful  The Eternal Lord.  The Most Sacred. The embodiment of Peace The Infuser of Faith. The Preserver of Safety. All Mighty. The Compeller, The Restorer. The Supreme, The Majestic. The Creator, The Maker

en: The Evolver. The Fashioner. The Great Forgiver. The All-Prevailing One. The Supreme Bestower. The Provider. The Supreme Solver. The All-Knowing. The Withholder. The Extender. The Reducer. The Exalter, The Elevator

en: The Honourer, The Bestower. The Dishonourer, The Humiliator. The All-Hearing. The All-Seeing. The Impartial Judge. The Utterly Just. The Subtle One, The Most Gentle. The All-Aware. The Most Forbearing. The Magnificent, The Supreme. The Great Forgiver. The Great Giver/Rewarder

ar: الْعَلِيُّ. الْكَبِيرُ. الْحَفِيظُ. المُقيِت. الْحسِيبُ. الْجَلِيلُ. الْكَرِيمُ. الرَّقِيبُ  ٱلْمُجِيبُ. الْوَاسِعُ  الْحَكِيمُ. الْوَدُودُ
latin: AL-‘ALEE. AL-KABEER. AL-HAFEEDH. AL-MUQEET. AL-HASEEB. AL-JALEEL. AL-KAREEM. AR-RAQEEB. AL-MUJEEB. AL-WAASI’. AL-HAKEEM. AL-WADUD.
en: The Most High, The Exalted. The Preserver, The All-Heedful and All-Protecting. The Preserver. The Sustainer. The Reckoner. The Majestic. The Most Generous, The Most Esteemed. The Watchful. The Responsive One. The All-Encompassing, the Boundless.  The All-Wise. The Most Loving

ar: الْمَجِيدُ. الْبَاعِثُ. الشَّهِيدُ. الْحَقُ. الْوَكِيلُ. الْقَوِيُ. الْمَتِينُ. الْوَلِيُّ. الْحَمِيدُ. الْمُحْصِي. الْمُبْدِئُ. ٱلْمُعِيدُ
latin: AL-MAJEED. AL-BA’ITH. ASH-SHAHEED. AL-HAQQ. AL-WAKEEL. AL-QAWIYY. AL-MATEEN. AL-WALIYY. AL-HAMEED. AL-MUHSEE. AL-MUBDI. AL-MUEED.
en: The Glorious, The Most Honorable. The Infuser of New Life. The All Observing Witnessing. The Absolute Truth. The Trustee, The Disposer of Affairs. The All-Strong. The Firm, The Steadfast. The Protecting Associatey. The Praiseworthy. The All-Enumerating, The Counter. The Originator, The Initiator. The Restorer, The Reinstater

ar: الْمُحْيِي. اَلْمُمِيتُ. الْحَيُّ. الْقَيُّومُ. الْوَاجِدُ. الْمَاجِدُ. الْواحِدُ. لاَحَدُ. الصَّمَدُ. الْقَادِرُ. الْمُقْتَدِرُ. الْمُقَدِّمُ.
latin: AL-MUHYI. AL-MUMEET. AL-HAYY. AL-QAYYOOM. AL-WAAJID. AL-MAAJID. AL-WAAHID. AL-AHAD. AS-SAMAD. AL-QADR. AL-MUQTADIR. AL-MUQADDIM.
en: The Giver of Life. The Inflicter of Death. The Ever-Living. The Sustainer, The Self-Subsisting. The Perceiver. The Illustrious, the Magnificent. The One. The Unique, The Only One. The Eternal, Satisfier of Needs. The Omnipotent One. The Powerful. The Expediter, The Promoter.

ar: الْمُؤَخِّرُ. الأوَّلُ. الآخِرُ. الظَّاهِرُ. الْبَاطِنُ. الْوَالِي. الْمُتَعَالِي. الْبَرُّ. التَّوَابُ. الْمُنْتَقِمُ. العَفُوُ. الرَّؤُوفُ
latin: AL-MU’AKHKHIR. AL-AWWAL. AL-AAKHIR. AZ-ZAAHIR. AL-BAATIN. AL-WAALI. AL-MUTA’ALI. AL-BARR. AT-TAWWAB. AL-MUNTAQIM. AL-‘AFUWW. AR-RA’OOF.
en: The Delayer  The First. The Last. The Manifest. The Hidden One, Knower of the Hidden. The Governor, The Patron. The Self Exalted. The Source of All Goodness. The Ever-Pardoning, The Relenting. The Avenger. The Pardoner. The Most Kind

ar: مَالِكُ ٱلْمُلْكُ. ذُوالْجَلاَلِ وَالإكْرَامِ. الْمُقْسِطُ. الْجَامِعُ. ٱلْغَنيُّ. ٱلْمُغْنِيُّ. اَلْمَانِعُ. الضَّارَ. النَّافِعُ. النُّورُ.
latin: MAALIK-UL-MULK. DHUL-JALAALI WAL-IKRAAM. AL-MUQSIT. AL-JAAMI’. AL-GHANIYY. AL-MUGHNI. AL-MANI’. AD-DHARR. AN-NAFI’. AN-NUR.
en: Master of the Kingdom, Owner of the Dominion. Possessor of Glory and Honour, Lord of Majesty and Generosity. The Just One. The Gatherer, the Uniter. The Self-Sufficient, The Wealthy. The Enricher. The Withholder. The Distresser. The Propitious, the Benefactor. The Light, The Illuminator.

ar: الْهَادِي. الْبَدِيعُ. اَلْبَاقِي. الْوَارِثُ. الرَّشِيدُ. الصَّبُورُ.
latin: AL-HAADI. AL-BADEE’. AL-BAAQI. AL-WAARITH. AR-RASHEED. AS-SABOOR.
en: The Guide. The Incomparable Originator. The Everlasting. The Inheritor, The Heir. The Guide, Infallible Teacher. The Forbearing, The Patient.

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اَمْدِد في عُمر اُمّي بالصِحَّة و العافِيَة في طاعَتِكَ و رِضاك
latin: Allahuma Amdid Fi Omri Ommy Bil Sahati Wal Aafeeyati Fi Taatik Wa Ridaak
en: O Allah extend  my mothers life with health and wellness in your obidience and satisfaction

ar: اللهُمَّ ارزُق اُمّي الصِحَّة و العافِيَة
latin: Allahum Arziq Ommy Al Sahata Wal Afeeyah
en: Oh Allah grant my mother good health and wellness

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلَها مِنَ الذاكِرينَ لَكَ و الشاكِرينَ لَك
latin: Allahum Ajaalha Mena Al Thakeereena Lak Wal Shakeereena Lak
en: O Allah Make her from those that remember You and are always thankful to You

ar: اللَّهُمَّ لا تَجْعَل لها ذَنْباً اِلا غَفَرْتُه و لا هَمَّاً اِلّا فَرَّجْتُه ,اللَّهُمَّ و لا تَجعَل لَها حاجَة عِند اَحَد غَيْرِكَ
latin: Allahuma La Tajaal Laha Thanbaan Illa Ghafartah Wa La Hama Illa Farajtah, Allahuma Wa La Tajaal Laha Hajaten Inda Ahaadin Ghayrek
en: Oh Allah, Please forgive her sins, and  do not bestow sadness unless You have made it easy with Your mercy, O Allah do not make anything for her with anyone else but You.

ar: اللَّهُمَّ مُصرف القُلوب صَرِّف قَلْبَها على طاعَتِكَ
latin: Allahuma Mosrifo Al Qoloob Sarif Qalbaha Ala Taaatik
en: Oh Allah, the One that clears our hearts, clear her heart and guide it to Your obidience

ar: اللَّهُمَّ ارحَم اُمِّي بالقُرآن و اجْعَلَهُ لها نوراً و هُدىً و رَحْمَةً
latin: Allahuma Arhim Ommy Bil Quran Wa Ajaalahu Laha Nooraan Wa Huda Wa Rahmah
en: O Allah have mercy on my mother with the Quran and make it for her a source of light, guidance, and mercy

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَل القُرآنَ العَظيم ربيع قَلبَها و شِفاء صَدرَها و نوراً لِبَصَرِها
latin: Allahuma Ajaal Al Quran Al Atheema Rabeeaa Qalbaha Wa Shefaa Sadriha Wa Nooran LiBasariha
en: O Allah make the great Quran the spring of her heart and heal her chest and light for her sight

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اشْغِل قَلْبَها بُحُبِّكَ و لِسانَها بِذِكْرِكَ وَ بَدَنَها بِطاعَتِكَ
latin: Allahuma Ashghil Qalbaha Bihubik Wa Lisaaniha Bi Thikrik Wa Badanaha Bitaatik
en: O Allah fill her heart with love for You and her tongue with remembrance to You and her body to Your obedience

ar: رَبِّ اِغْفِر لي و لِوالِدَيّ و لِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتي مؤمِناً وَ للمؤمِنينَ و المؤمِنات
latin: Rabbi Aghfir Li Wa Li Waliday Wa Leman Dakhala Baytee Muminaan Wa Lil Mumeneen Wal Mumenaat
en: O Allah forgive me, my parents and all those that have entered my home of all believers

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغفِر لَها و ارْحَمَها و اهدها و عافها و ارزُقها و اجبرها و ارفعها
latin: Allahum Aghfir Laha Wa Arhimha Wa Ahdeha Wa Aafeha Wa Arzoqaha Wa Ajbirha Wa Arfaaha
en: O Allah forgive her and have mercy on her and give her calmness, and heal her, and grant her good health and wealth and always give her uplifting force

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغفِر لَها ذَنْبَها كُلَّهُ ، دقة و جلة و اَوِّلهُ و اَخِرْهُ و علانِيَّتُه و سِرُّه
latin: Allahum Aghfer laha thanbaha kullah Deqahu Wa Jollah Wa Awelahu Wa Akhirah Wa Alaneyatahu Wa Sirah
en: O Allah please forgive all her guilt and sins

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِر لَها ذَنْبَها ووسَّع لها في دارِها و بارِك لَها في رِزْقِها
latin: Allahuma Aghfer laha Thanbaha Wa waseaa Laha Fi Dalriha Wa Barik Laha Fi Rizqiha
en: O Allah Forgive her sins and expand her in her home and bless her in her livelihood

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِها بِحلالِك عن حَرامِك و اعِنْها بِفَضْلِك عَمَّن سِواك
latin: Allahum Akfeha Bi Halalika Aan Haraamik Wa Aghniha Bifadlika Aamen Sewaak
en: Oh Allah wrap her with Your Halal rather than the Haram and help rely on You

ar: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُق اُمِّي الجَنَّة و ماقَرُبَ اِلَيْها مِن قَوْل وَ عَمَل و باعِد بَيْنَها و بَيْن النار و ما قَرُب اِليها  مِن قَوْل و عَمَل
latin: Allahum Arziq Omy Al Jannata Wa Ma Qaraba Ilayha Min Qawellin Wa Aamal Wa Baed Baynaha Wa Bayna Al Naar Wa Ma Qaraba Ilayha Min Qawellin Wa Aamal
en: Oh Allah grant my mother Heaven and whatever is near to it in her words and actions and keep her away from hellfire

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدي اُمِّي فَيْمَن هَدَيْت و عافِها فيمَن عافَيْت
latin: Allahuma Ahdey Omy Fiman Hadayt Wa Aafeha Fiman Aafeyt
en: Oh Allah reward my mother like those you have rewarded and relieve her from any grief

ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَفِّق اُمِّي لِهُداك و اجْعَل عَمَلَها في رِضاك
latin: Allahum Wafiq Omy Lehudaak Wa Ajaal Aamalaha Fi Redaak
en: Oh Allah grant my mother success and guidance and make her doing please to you

ar: اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّل تَوْبَتَها وَ اَجِب دَعْوَتَها
latin: Allahum Taqabel Tawbataha Wa Ajeb Daawataha
en: Oh Allah accept her repentance and accept all her duas (prayers)

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اَعِنّي عَلى بِرَّها حَتى تَرضى عَنّي
latin: Allahum Aeinny Ala Berraha Hatta Tardaa Anney
en: Oh Allah help me be a good, righteous and obedient child until she is pleased with me

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَل لَها في قَلْبَها نوراً في لِسانِها نوراً وَ في سَمْعِها نوراً  و في بَصَرِها نوراً وَ مِن تَحتِها نوراً وَ عَن يَمينها نوراً، عَن شِمالِها نوراً وَ مِن بَيْنَ يَدَيْها نوراً وَ مِن خَلفَها نوراً
latin: Allahum Ajaal laha Fi Qolobiha Noor Wa Fi Lisaaniha Noor Wa Fi Samiha Noor Wa Fi Basariha Noor Wa Men Tahtiha Noor Wa Aan Yameeniha Noor Wa An Shemaaliha Noor Wa Men Bayn Yadayha Noor Wa Men Khalfiha Noor
en: Oh Allah grant light in her heart, light her speech, light her hearing, light in her sight, give her light from her right and left and light between her hands as well as surround her with light all around her

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَل اَوْقاتَها بِذِكرِكَ مَعْمورَة
latin: Allahum Ajaal Awqatiha Bithikrika Maamoora
en: Oh Allah allow her time to be spent with Your remembrance

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اِنّي اَسْتَوْدِعَك اَثْمَن ما عِنْدي وَ أقرَبْها اِلى قَلبي. اللَّهُمَّ اِحْفَظ لي اُمّي وَ اَنْتَ خَيْرُ الحافِظين
latin: Allahum Ini Astaudaouka Athman Ma Indiy Wa Aqrabha Illa Qalbee. Allahum Ihfadh Li Omy Wa Anta Khairul Hafedeen
en: Oh Allah I give You the most precious thing to me to protect and watch over. Oh Allah protect my mother as you are the best of all Protectors

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اسْعِد قَلب اُمّي و اشرَح صَدْرَها و اَرِح قَلبَها و اَبْعِد عَنها كُل ما يُحْزِنُها وَ أَطِل عُمْرَها
latin: Allahum Asaad Qalba Omey Wa Ashreh Sadraha Wa Areh Qalbaha Wa Abid Anha Kula Ma Yohzinha Wa Atil Omraha
en: Oh Allah grant my mother happiness and grant her ease in her chest and do not allow any sadness bestow her and prolong her life

ar: اللَّهُمَّ ابْعِد عَنْها المَرَض و ارْزُقهْا طولة العُمْر في طاعَتِك
latin: Allahum Abid Anha Al Mared Wa Arziqha Tolet Al Omer Fi Taetik
en: Oh Allah do not bestow sickness on my mother and grant her a long life in your obedience

ar: أَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ. اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاواتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
latin: Aouthu Billahi Min Al Shaytaan Alrajeem Allahu laaa ilaaha illaa huwal haiyul qai-yoom laa taakhuzuhoo sinatunw wa laa nawm; lahoo maa fissamaawaati wa maa fil ard man zallazee yashfa’u indahooo illaa be iznih ya’lamu maa baina aideehim wa maa khalfahum wa laa yuheetoona beshai ‘immin ‘ilmihee illa be maa sha  wasi’a kursiyyuhus samaa waati wal arda wa la ya’ooduho hifzuhumaa wa huwal aliyyul ‘azeem
en: Allah! There is no deity save Him, the Alive, the Eternal. Neither slumber nor sleep overtaketh Him. Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Who is he that intercedeth with Him save by His leave? He knoweth that which is in front of them and that which is behind them, while they encompass nothing of His knowledge save what He will. His throne includeth the heavens and the earth, and He is never weary of preserving them. He is the Sublime, the Tremendous

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ)1(ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ)2(لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ)3. وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَد)4
latin: Bismillah Al Rahman Al Raheem, Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad (1)Allahhu-Assamad(2) Lam Yalid Wa Lam Yoolad (3) Wa Lam YaKon Lahoo Kufuwan Ahad(4)
en: In the name of Allahh, The Entirely Merciful, The especially Merciful, Say ‘He is Allah (who is) One (1) Allah The Eternal Refuge (2) He neither begets nor is born(3) Nor is there to Him any equivalent (4)

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ)1(مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ)2 وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ3. وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ)4 وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ5
latin: Bismillah Al Rahman Al Raheem, Qul A’ootho Bi Rabbil Falaq(1) Min Sharri Ma Khalaq(2) Wa Min Sharri Ghaasiqin Itha Waqab(3) Wa Min Sharrin-Naffaathati Fil Uqad (4)Wa Min Sharri Haasidin Itha Hasad(5)
en: In the name of Allah, The Entirely Merciful, The Especially Merciful, Say I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak(1)From the evil of that which He created (2) And from the evil of darkness when it settles (3) And from the evil of blowers in knots (4)And from the evil of an envier when he envies(5)

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ1 مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ2 إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ3. مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ4 ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ5 مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ6
latin: Bismillah Al Rahman Al Raheen, Qul Autho Birab Al Nas(1) Malik Al Nas(2) Illahi Al Nas(3)Min Sharril Waswaasil Khannaas(4)Allathee Yuwaswisu Fee Sudoorin Naas(5) Mena Al Jinnati Wal Naas(6)
en: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, Say I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind(1)The Sovereign of mankind(2)The God of mankind(3)From the evil of the retreating whisperer(4)Who whispers (evil) into the breasts of mankind(5)From among the jinn and mankind(6)

ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ للهِ وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، ربِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَومِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَومِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ، وَسُوءِ الكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
latin: Asbahnaa wa 'asbahal-mulku lillaah walhamdu lillaah, laa 'ilaaha 'illaAllaah wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulk wa lahul-hamd wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer. Rabbi 'as'aluka khayra maa fee haathal-yawm wa khayra maa ba'dah wa 'a'oothu bika min sharri maa fee haathal-yawm wa sharri maa ba'dah, Rabbi 'a'oothu bika minal-kasal, wa soo'il-kibari, Rabbi 'a'oothu bika min 'athaabin fin-naari wa 'athaabin fil-qabri.
en: We have entered a new day and with it all dominion is Allah's. Praise is to Allah. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. To Allah belongs the dominion, and to Him is the praise and He is Able to do all things. My Lord, I ask You for the goodness of this day and of the days that come after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and of the days that come after it.  My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and helpless old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hell-fire  and from the punishment of the grave.

ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
latin: Allaahumma bika 'asbahnaa, wa bika 'amsaynaa, wa bika nahyaa, wa bika namoot wa 'ilaykan-nushoor
en: O Allah , by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and and by You we die, and to You is the Final Return.

ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لّا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِر لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
latin: Allaahumma 'Anta Rabbee laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta, khalaqtanee wa 'anaa 'abduk, wa 'anaa 'alaa 'ahdika wa wa'dika mas-tata't, 'a'oothu bika min sharri maa sana't, 'aboo'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa 'aboo'u bithanbee faghfir lee fa'innahu laa yaghfiruth-thunooba 'illaa 'Anta.
en: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is none worthy of worship but You. You created me and I am your slave. I keep Your covenant, and my pledge to You so far as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I admit to Your blessings upon me, and I admit to my misdeeds. Forgive me, for there is none who may forgive sins but You.

ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
latin: Allaahumma 'innee 'asbahtu 'ush-hiduk wa 'ush-hidu hamalata 'arshik, wa malaa'ikataka wajamee'a khalqik, 'annaka 'Antallaah laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta wahdaka laa shareeka lak, wa 'anna Muhammadan 'abduka wa Rasooluk
en: O Allah , I have entered a new morning  and call upon You and upon the bearers of Your Throne , upon Your angels and all creation to bear witness that surely You are Allah , there is none worthy of worship but You alone , You have no partners, and that Muhammad is Your slave and Your Messenger .

ar: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
latin: Allaahumma maa 'asbaha bee min ni'amatin 'aw bi'ahadin min khalqik faminka wahdaka laa shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr
en: O Allah , whatever blessing has been received by me or anyone of Your creation is from You alone , You have no partner . All praise is for you and thanks is to You.

ar: اللّهُـمَّ عافِـني في بَدَنـي ، اللّهُـمَّ عافِـني في سَمْـعي ، اللّهُـمَّ عافِـني في بَصَـري  لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْـتَ   اللّهُـمَّ إِنّـي أَعـوذُبِكَ مِنَ الْكُـفر ، وَالفَـقْر ، وَأَعـوذُبِكَ مِنْ عَذابِ القَـبْر ، لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْـتَ
latin: Allaahumma 'aafinee fee badanee, Allaahumma 'aafinee fee sam'ee, Allaahumma 'aafinee fee basaree, laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Ant Allaahumma 'innee 'a'oothu bika minal-kufri, walfaqr, wa 'a'oothu bika min 'athaabil-qabr, laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Ant
en: O Allah, make me healthy in my body. O Allah, preserve for me my hearing. O Allah, preserve for me my sight. There is none worthy of worship but You .   O Allah , I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave . There is none worthy of worship but You.

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ لرِّجَالِ
latin: Allahumma inni a-uthu bika minal-hammi wal-hazn, wa a-uthu bika minal-ajzi wal-kasal, wa a-uthu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa a-uthu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijal.
en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, I seek refuge in You from impotence and laziness, I seek refuge in you from cowardice and miserliness, and I seek refuge in you from overpowering debt and the subduing of men.

ar: حَسْبِيَ اللهُ لَآ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
latin: Hasbiyallaahu laa 'ilaaha 'illaa Huwa 'alayhi tawakkalt wa Huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adheem
en: Allah is sufficient for me . There is none worthy of worship but Him . I have placed my trust in Him, He is Lord of the Majestic Throne

ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْللِي، وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
latin: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'alukal-'afwa wal'aafiyah fid-dunyaa wal'aakhirah, Allaahumma 'innee 'as'alukal-'afwah wal'aafiyah fee deenee wa dunyaaya wa 'ahlee, wa maalee , Allaahum-mastur 'awraatee, wa 'aamin raw'aatee, Allaahum-mahfadhnee min bayni yadayya, wa min khalfee, wa 'an yameenee, wa 'an shimaalee, wa min fawqee, wa 'a'oothu bi'adhamatika 'an 'ughtaala min tahtee
en: Allah, I seek Your forgiveness and Your protection in this world and the next. O Allah, I seek Your forgiveness and Your protection in my religion, in my worldly affairs, in my family and in my wealth. O Allah, conceal my secrets and preserve me from anguish. O Allah, guard me from what is in front of me and behind me, from my right, and from my left, and from above me. I seek refuge in Your Greatness from being struck down from beneath me

ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّماوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
latin: Allaahumma 'Aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahaada faatiras-samaawaati wal'ard, Rabba kulli shay'i wa maleekah, 'ash-hadu 'an laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Ant, 'a'oothu bika min sharri nafsee, wa min sharrish-shaytaani wa shirkih, wa 'an 'aqtarifa 'alaa nafsee soo'an, 'aw 'ajurrahu 'ilaa Muslimin
en: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the evident , Maker of the heavens and the earth , Lord of everything and its Possessor , I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You . I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his helpers . (I seek refuge in You) from bringing evil upon my soul and from harming any Muslim.

ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
latin: Bismillaahil-lathee laa yadhurru ma'as-mihi shay'u fil-'ardhi wa laa fis-samaa'i wa Huwas-Samee 'ul- 'Aleem
en: In the Name of Allah, Who with His Name nothing can cause harm in the earth nor in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing

ar: رَضِيتُ باللهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَى اللهُ عَلِيهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيَّاً
latin: Radheetu billaahi Rabba, wa bil-'Islaami deena, wa bi-Muhammadin (sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallama) Nabiyya
en: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion and with Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) as my Prophet

ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
latin: Yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoom birahmatika 'astagheeth 'aslih lee sha'nee kullahu wa laa takilnee 'ilaa nafsee tarfata 'ayein
en: O Ever Living One, O Eternal One, by Your mercy I call on You to set right all my affairs. Do not place me in charge of my soul even for the blinking of an eye (i.e. a moment)

ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ ، اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ  فَتْحَهُ وَنَصْرَهُ وَنُوْرَهُ وَبَرَكَتَهُ وَهُدَاهُ وَأَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيْهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْد
latin: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥa-l-mulku li-llāhi Rabbi-l-ʿālamīn, Allāhumma innī as’aluka khayra hātha-l-yawm, fatḥahū wa naṣrahū wa nūrahū wa barakatahū wa hudāh, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fīhi wa sharri mā baʿdah.
en: We have entered the morning and at this very time the whole kingdom belongs to Allah, Lord of the Worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of this day: its victory, its help, its light, and its blessings and guidance. I seek Your protection from the evil that is in it and from the evil that follows it.

ar: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَى اللهُ عَلِيهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفَاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
latin: Asbahnaa 'alaa fitratil-'Islaam wa 'alaa kalimatil-'ikhlaas, wa 'alaa deeni Nabiyyinaa Muhammadin (sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallem), wa 'alaa millati 'abeenaa 'Ibraaheema, haneefan Musliman wa maa kaana minal-mushrikeen.
en: We have entered a new day upon the natural religion of Islam, the word of sincere devotion, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him), and the faith of our father Ibrahim. He was upright (in worshipping Allah), and a Muslim. He was not of those who worship others besides Allah.

ar: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
latin: Laa 'ilaaha 'illallaah wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer
en: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise and He is Able to do all things .

nama: Morning Dua/ Athkar (Recite One Hundred Times)
ar: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
latin: Subhaanallaahi wa bihamdih
en: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him

ar: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
latin: Subhaanallaahi wa bihamdih: 'Adada khalqih, wa ridhaa nafsih, wa zinata 'arshih wa midaada kalimaatih.
en: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him, by the multitude of His creation, by His Pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the extent of His Words.

ar: اللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً، وَرِزقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
latin: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'aluka 'ilman naafi'a, wa rizqan tayyiba, wa 'amalan mutaqabbala
en: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that is of benefit , a good provision , and deeds that will be accepted

nama: Morning Dua/ Athkar (Recite One Hundred Times)
ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
latin: Astaghfirullaaha wa 'atoobu 'ilayh
en: I seek the forgiveness of Allah and repent to Him

ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
latin: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'alaa nabiyyinaa Muhammad
en: Oh Allah, we ask you for peace and blessings upon our prophet Muhammad   Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Who recites blessings upon me 10 times in the morning and 10 times in the evening will obtain my intercession on the Day of Resurrection." At-Tabrani reported this Hadith

ar: أَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ. اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاواتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
latin: Allahu laaa ilaaha illaa huwal haiyul qai-yoom laa taakhuzuhoo sinatunw wa laa nawm; lahoo maa fissamaawaati wa maa fil ard man zallazee yashfa’u indahooo illaa be iznih ya’lamu maa baina aideehim wa maa khalfahum wa laa yuheetoona beshai ‘immin ‘ilmihee illa be maa sha  wasi’a kursiyyuhus samaa waati wal arda wa la ya’ooduho hifzuhumaa wa huwal aliyyul ‘azeem
en: Allah! There is no deity save Him, the Alive, the Eternal. Neither slumber nor sleep overtaketh Him. Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Who is he that intercedeth with Him save by His leave? He knoweth that which is in front of them and that which is behind them, while they encompass nothing of His knowledge save what He will. His throne includeth the heavens and the earth, and He is never weary of preserving them. He is the Sublime, the Tremendous

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ)1(ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ)2(لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ)3. وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَد)4
latin: Bismillah Al Rahman Al Raheem, Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad (1)Allahhu-Assamad(2) Lam Yalid Wa Lam Yoolad (3) Wa Lam YaKon Lahoo Kufuwan Ahad(4)
en: In the name of Allahh, The Entirely Merciful, The especially Merciful, Say ‘He is Allah (who is) One (1) Allah The Eternal Refuge (2) He neither begets nor is born(3) Nor is there to Him any equivalent (4)

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ)1(مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ)2 وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ3. وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ)4 وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ5
latin: Bismillah Al Rahman Al Raheem, Qul A’ootho Bi Rabbil Falaq(1) Min Sharri Ma Khalaq(2) Wa Min Sharri Ghaasiqin Itha Waqab(3) Wa Min Sharrin-Naffaathati Fil Uqad (4)Wa Min Sharri Haasidin Itha Hasad(5)
en: In the name of Allah, The Entirely Merciful, The Especially Merciful, Say I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak(1)From the evil of that which He created (2) And from the evil of darkness when it settles (3) And from the evil of blowers in knots (4)And from the evil of an envier when he envies(5)

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ1 مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ2 إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ3. مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ4 ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ5 مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ6
latin: Bismillah Al Rahman Al Raheen, Qul Autho Birab Al Nas(1) Malik Al Nas(2) Illahi Al Nas(3)Min Sharril Waswaasil Khannaas(4)Allathee Yuwaswisu Fee Sudoorin Naas(5) Mena Al Jinnati Wal Naas(6)
en: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, Say I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind(1)The Sovereign of mankind(2)The God of mankind(3)From the evil of the retreating whisperer(4)Who whispers (evil) into the breasts of mankind(5)From among the jinn and mankind(6)

ar: أَمْسَيْنَا و امسى الْمُلْكُ للهِ وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، ربِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَهُ الليلة وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَهُ الليلة. وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ، وَسُوءِ الكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
latin: Amsaynaa wa 'amsal-mulku lillaahi walhamdu lillaah, laa 'ilaaha 'illallaaha wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer. Rabbi 'as'aluka khayra maa fee haathihi-allayla wa khayra maa ba'daha wa 'a'oothu bika min sharri maa fee haathihi-allaila wa sharri maa ba'daha, Rabbi 'a'oothu bika minal-kasali, wa soo'il-kibar, Rabbi 'a'oothu bika min 'athaabin fin-naari wa 'athaabin fil-qabr.
en: We have entered a new evening and with it all dominion is Allah's. Praise is to Allah. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. To Allah belongs the dominion, and to Him is the praise and He is Able to do all things. My Lord, I ask You for the goodness of this evening and of the evenings that come after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this evening and of the evenings that come after it.  My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and helpless old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of Hell-fire  and from the punishment of the grave.

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوْتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيْرُ
latin: Allāhumma bika amsaynā wa bika aṣbaḥnā wa bika naḥyā wa bika namūtu wa ilayka-l-maṣīr.
en: O Allah, by You we have entered the evening and by You we enter upon the morning. By You, we live and we die, and to You is the resurrection/return.

ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لّا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِر لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
latin: Allaahumma 'Anta Rabbee laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Ant, khalaqtanee wa 'anaa 'abduk, wa 'anaa 'alaa 'ahdika wa wa'dika mas-tata't, 'a'oothu bika min sharri maa sana't, 'aboo'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa 'aboo'u bithanbee faghfir lee fa'innahu laa yaghfiruth-thunooba 'illaa 'Anta.
en: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is none worthy of worship but You. You created me and I am your slave. I keep Your covenant, and my pledge to You so far as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I admit to Your blessings upon me, and I admit to my misdeeds. Forgive me, for there is none who may forgive sins but You

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَمْسَيْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ ، وَجَمِيْعَ خَلْقِكَ ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ ، لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُوْلُكَ
latin: Allāhumma innī amsaytu ush-hiduk, wa ush-hidu ḥamlata ʿarshik, wa malā’ikatika, wa jamī’a khalqik, annaka Anta-llāhu lā ilāha illā Anta waḥdaka, lā sharīka lak, wa an-na Muḥammadan ʿabduka wa rasūluk.
en: O Allah, I have entered the evening and call upon You, the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels and all creation, to bear witness that surely You are Allah. There is no god but You Alone. You have no partners, and that Muhammad (peace be upon him) is Your slave and Your Messenger.

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَىٰ بِيْ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ ، فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
latin: Allāhumma mā amsā bī min niʿmatin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqik, fa-minka waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, fa laka-l-ḥamdu wa laka-sh-shukr.
en: O Allah, all the favours that I or anyone from Your creation has received in the evening, are from You Alone. You have no partner. To You Alone belong all praise and all thanks.

ar: اللّهُـمَّ عافِـني في بَدَنـي ، اللّهُـمَّ عافِـني في سَمْـعي ، اللّهُـمَّ عافِـني في بَصَـري  لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْـتَ   اللّهُـمَّ إِنّـي أَعـوذُبِكَ مِنَ الْكُـفر ، وَالفَـقْر ، وَأَعـوذُبِكَ مِنْ عَذابِ القَـبْر ، لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْـتَ
latin: Allaahumma 'aafinee fee badanee, Allaahumma 'aafinee fee sam'ee, Allaahumma 'aafinee fee basaree, laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Ant Allaahumma 'innee 'a'oothu bika minal-kufri, walfaqr, wa 'a'oothu bika min 'athaabil-qabr, laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Ant
en: O Allah, make me healthy in my body. O Allah, preserve for me my hearing. O Allah, preserve for me my sight. There is none worthy of worship but You .   O Allah , I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave . There is none worthy of worship but You.

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ ، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ لرِّجَالِ
latin: Allahumma inni a-uthu bika minal-hammi wal-huzn, wa a-uthu bika minal-ajzi wal-kasal, wa a-uthu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa a-udhu bika min galabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijal.
en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, I seek refuge in You from impotence and laziness, I seek refuge in you from cowardice and miserliness, and I seek refuge in you from overpowering debt and the subduing of men.

ar: حَسْبِيَ اللهُ لَآ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
latin: Hasbiyallaahu laa 'ilaaha 'illaa Huwa 'alayhi tawakkalt wa Huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adheem
en: Allah is sufficient for me . There is none worthy of worship but Him . I have placed my trust in Him, He is Lord of the Majestic Throne

ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْللِي، وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
latin: Allaahumma 'innee 'as'alukal-'afwa wal'aafiyah fid-dunyaa wal'aakhirah, Allaahumma 'innee 'as'alukal-'afwa wal'aafiyah fee deenee wa dunyaaya wa 'ahlee, wa maalee , Allaahum-mastur 'awraatee, wa 'aamin raw'aatee, Allaahum-mahfadhnee min bayni yadayya, wa min khalfee, wa 'an yameenee, wa 'an shimaalee, wa min fawqee, wa 'a'oothu bi'adhamatika 'an 'ughtaala min tahtee
en: Allah, I seek Your forgiveness and Your protection in this world and the next. O Allah, I seek Your forgiveness and Your protection in my religion, in my worldly affairs, in my family and in my wealth. O Allah, conceal my secrets and preserve me from anguish. O Allah, guard me from what is in front of me and behind me, from my right, and from my left, and from above me. I seek refuge in Your Greatness from being struck down from beneath me

ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّماوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
latin: Allaahumma 'Aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahaadah faatiras-samaawaati wal'ard, Rabba kulli shay'in wa maleekah, 'ash-hadu 'an laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Ant, 'a'oothu bika min sharri nafsee, wa min sharrish-shaytaani wa shirkih, wa 'an 'aqtarifa 'alaa nafsee soo'an, 'aw 'ajurrahu 'ilaa Muslimin
en: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the evident , Maker of the heavens and the earth , Lord of everything and its Possessor , I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You . I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his helpers . (I seek refuge in You) from bringing evil upon my soul and from harming any Muslim.

ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
latin: Bismillaahil-lathee laa yadhurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-'ardi wa laa fis-samaa'i wa Huwas-Samee 'ul- 'Aleem
en: In the Name of Allah, Who with His Name nothing can cause harm in the earth nor in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

ar: رَضِيتُ باللهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَى اللهُ عَلِيهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيَّاً
latin: Radheetu billaahi Rabba, wa bil-'Islaami deena, wa bi-Muhammadin (sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallama) Nabiyya
en: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion and with Muhammad (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) as my Prophet

ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
latin: Yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoom birahmatika 'astagheeth 'aslih lee sha'nee kullahu wa laa takilnee 'ilaa nafsee tarfata 'aynin
en: O Ever Living One, O Eternal One, by Your mercy I call on You to set right all my affairs. Do not place me in charge of my soul even for the blinking of an eye (i.e. a moment)

ar: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ ، اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هـٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ  فَتْحَهَا وَنَصْرَهَا وَنُوْرَهـَا وَبَرَكَتَهَا وَهُدَاهـَا وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيْهَا وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
latin: Amsaynā wa amsa-l-mulku li-llāhi Rabbi-l-ʿālamīn, Allāhumma innī as’aluka khayra hādhihi-l-laylah, fatḥahā wa naṣrahā wa nūrahā wa barakatahā wa hudāhā, wa aʿūthu bika min sharri mā fīhā wa sharri mā baʿdahā.
en: We have entered the evening and at this very time the whole kingdom belongs to Allah, Lord of the Worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of this day/night: its victory, its help, its light, and its blessings and guidance. I seek Your protection from the evil that is in it and from the evil that follows it.

ar: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَىٰ فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ ، وَعَلَىٰ كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ ، وَعَلَىٰ دِيْنِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ  وَعَلَىٰ مِلَّةِ أَبِيْنَا إِبْرَاهِيْمَ حَنِيْفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ المُشْرِكِيْنَ
latin: Amsaynā ʿalā fiṭrati-l-islām, wa ʿalā kalimati-l-ikhlāṣ, wa ʿalā dīni Nabiyyinā Muḥammad wa ʿalā millati abīnā Ibrāhīma ḥanīfam-muslima, wa mā kāna mina-l-mushrikīn.
en: We have entered the evening upon the natural religion of Islam, the word of pure faith (i.e. Shahādah), the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and upon the way of our father Ibrāhīm, who turned away from all that is false, having surrendered  to Allah, and he was not of the polytheists.

ar: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
latin: Laa 'ilaaha 'illallaah wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulk wa lahul-hamd, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer
