en: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise and He is Able to do all things .

ar: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
latin: Subhaanallaahi wa bihamdih
en: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him

ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
latin: A'othu bikalimaatil-laahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaq
en: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created

ar: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
latin: Subhaanallaahi wa bihamdih 'Adada khalqih, wa ridhaa nafsih, wa zinata 'arshih wa midaada kalimaatih
en: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him, by the multitude of His creation, by His Pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the extent of His Words

ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
latin: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'alaa nabiyyinaa Muhammad
en: Oh Allah, we ask you for peace and blessings upon our prophet Muhammad The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Who recites blessings upon me 10 times in the morning and 10 times in the evening will obtain my intercession on the Day of Resurrection." At-Tabrani reported this Hadith

ar: الحمدُلله رب العالمين ،لا اله الا الله وحده لا شريك له ، و لَهُ المُلك و لَهُ الحَمد بِيَدِهِ الخَيْر  و هُوَ على كل شَئٍ قَدير لهُ الاسماء الحُسْنى يُسَبِّح لَهُ ما في السَماواتِ و الاَرْض و هُوَ العَزيز الحكيم  اللهُمّ صَلِّ وَ سَلِّم في كُل لَحظَةٍ اَبَداً عدد مَعلوماتِك على سَيِّدِنا مُحَمَّد و الِهِ وَ صَحبِهِ و على سائِر الانبِياء و الصالِحين الى يَوْمِ الدين
latin: Alhamdullah Rab Al Alameen, La Ilaha Illa Allah Wahdahu La Shareeka Lah, Lahu Al Mulk Wa Lahu Al Hamed Beyadihe Al Khair Wa Huwa Ala Kul Shayin Qadeer Lahu Al Asmaa ul Husna Yosabihu Lahu Ma Fi Al Samawaati Wal Alred Wahuwa  Al Aziz-ul Hakeem, Allahuma Sallee Wa Salem Fi Kul Lahthatin Abdaa Adaada Maaloomaateka Ala Sayedina Muhammedin Wa Alihi Wa Sahbeh Wa Ala Saer Al Anbeeyai Wal Saleheena Illa Yaum Al Deen
en: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds, there is no god but Allah alone, He has no partner, and to Him belongs the sovereignty , and to Him belongs the goodness in His hand, and He has power over all things, to Him belong the Most Beautiful Names. All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Him, the All-Wise, the Mighty, the Earth, the All-Wise. Oh Allah praise be to our Prophet Muhammed in every minute and his companions until the Day of Judgment.

nama: Dua Using Powerful Names of Allah(SWT)
ar: اللهُمّ اِنّا نَسألُكَ بِأسمائِكَ الحُسنى و كَلِماتِكَ التامّات ما عَلَّمَنا مِنها  و مالَم نَعلَم .. اَن تَغْفر لَنا و لِأحبابَنا اَبَداً و للمُسلِمين كُل ذَنْب ، و تَستَر لَنا كُل عَيْب وَتَكشِف عَنَّا كُل كَرْب و تَصْرِف و تَرْفَع عَنَّا كُل بلاء و تعافينا مِن كُل مِحْنَة وَ فِتْنَة و شِدَّة في الدارَيْن ، تَقْضي لَنا كُل حاجَةٍ فيهما ..يا مَن هُوَ الله الذي  لا اله الا هُوَ ، يا عالِم الغَيْبِ و الشِهادَة سُبحانُكَ لا اله الا اَنْتَ يا ذا الجلالِ و الاِكرام .. اَسألُكَ بِإسمِكَ الاَعلى الأعَز الأجَل الاَكرَم، يا ذا الجلال و الاكرام ، و المواهِب العِظام
latin: Allahuma Inna Nasaluka Bi Asmika Al Husna Wa Kalimatika Al Taamaat, Ma Aleemna Minha Wa Ma Lem Naalem .. An Taghfer Lana Wa Li Ahbabena Abadaa, Wa Lil  Muslimeena Kul Thanib Wa Tastora Lana Kulla Ayeb Wa Takshif Anna Kulla Karb Wa Tasref Wa Tarfaa Annaa Kula Bala Wa Tuaafeena Min Kul Mehnatin Wa Fitnah Wa Shiddatin Fi Al Daarayn, Wa Taqdee Lana Kula Hajatin Feeha, Ya Men Huwa Allah Allathee La Illaha Allah Illa Huw, Ya Aalem Alghayeb Wal Shahadati, Subhanaka, La Illaha Illa Ant, Yathal Jalaali Wal Ikraam Asaluka Bismika AlAlaa Al Aazz AlaJal Alikraam Ya Thal Jalaali Wal Ikraam Wal Mawaheb Al Ithaam.
en: Oh Allah we ask you with all Your Almighty beautiful names and all your perfect words that you have taught us and the words (as well as the words we do not know) To please forgive us and our loved one and all the Muslims from all our misguidances and sins, we ask you Allah to cover up all our defects and give us easy with distress and hardship. Oh Allah life our afflictions and allow us to recover from every ordeal…With the power of your names The Possessor of Glory and Honor, Lord of Majesty and Generosity help us and ease our pain.

ar: اللَّهُمّ يا غَفّار ... اغْفِر  ذُنوبَنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Ghafaru Agfer Thunobana
en: Oh Allah The Great Forgiver… forgive my sins

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Razaq
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا رَزّاق ... وَسَّع ارزاقَنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Razaaqu Waseaa Arzaqana
en: Oh Allah The Provider… provide us with ultimate health, wealth and sustenance

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Aleem
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا عَليم...  بالعِلم نورِ قلوبِنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Aleemu Bel Ealemi Nauer Qoloobana
en: Oh Allah The All Knowing of every knowledge, grant us light in our hearts

ar: اللَّهُمّ يا وَكيل ... تَوَكّلنا عَلَيْك فاكْفِنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Wakeelu… Tawakalna Aleika Fakfinaa
en: Oh Allah The Thustee, The Disposer of Affairs… We trust in You

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Momeet
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا مُميت... قَدِّر مَوْتَنا على التَوْحيد و الاِسْلام
latin: Allahuma Ya Momeetu…Qadr Mawtana Ala Altwaheedi Wal ESalaam
en: Oh Allah The Inflicter of Death, Grant us a death of Oneness and Peace

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Wajid
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا واجِد... اَنْتَ الغَني فأغْنِنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Waajida… Anta Al Ghaniu Fa Ighnina
en: Oh Allah The Perceiver…You are the Wealthy so grant us wealth

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Qawey
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا قَوي ... قَوِّي عَزْمَنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Qaweeu… Qawee Aazmana
en: Oh Allah The All-Strong give us strength in ourselves and everything we do

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Raqeeb
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا رَقيب ... اعف عَنَّا و عافِنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Raaqeebu… Oafoo Aana Wa Aafena
en: Oh Allah The Watchful… Pardon us from our misdoings

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Mugeeb
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا مُجيب ... يَسِّر اُمورَنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Mujeebu… Yasser Oumoorana
en: Oh Allah The Responsive One…Ease all our affairs

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Nafeaa
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا نافِع ... انْفَعْنا بِـأنوار دينِنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Nafeaau… Anfeanaa Bianwaari Deeneena
en: Oh Allah The Propitious, The Benefactor…Give us the benefit and the light from our religion

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Mohee
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا مُحيي...  بِذِكْرِكَ اَحْينا
latin: Allahuma Ya Mohee… Bthickrika Ahyina
en: Oh Allah The Giver of Life…Grant us Your love through Your remembrance

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Sameea
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا سَميع... اسمَع دُعائَنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Sameeu … Esameea Dua-ana
en: Oh Allah The All-Hearer… Listen and grant us our Duas

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Baseer
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا بَصير ... بَصِّرْنا بِعيوبِنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Baseeru… Baserna Bi Ouyobina
en: Oh Allah The All-Seeing…allow us to see our misdoings/ misdeeds

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Raouf
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا رؤوف ...  اَرأَف بِنا و بِإخواتِنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Raoufu… Oaruf Bena Wa Biekhwanina
en: Oh Allah The Mosy Kind… Be kind to us and our sisters

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Wahed
ar: اللّهُمّ يا واحِد ... فَرِّج كَرْبَنا وَ غَمَّنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Wahedu… Farej Karbana Wa Ghamana
en: Oh Allah The One…relief us from our anguish and distress

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Manea
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا مانِع...  اِمْنَع كُل كَرب يُهِمَّنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Manea Amnea Kul Karbi Yohimena
en: Oh Allah The  Withholder… withhold every hardship we face

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Mumin
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا مؤمِن ... ثَبِّت اِيمانَنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Muminu… Thabit Emannana
en: Oh Allah The Infuser of Faith…Protect and strengthen our faith

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Jaleel
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا جَليل ... اَنْتَ ملاذَنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Jaleelu… Anta Melathana
en: Oh Allah The Majestic…You are our sanctuary

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Ghaniyy
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا غَني .. اِغْنِنا عَن غَيْرِكَ
latin: Allahuma Ya Ghaniyu… Aghnena En Ghayrik
en: Oh Allah The self-sufficient, The Wealthy…Do not allow us to rely and suffice on anyone but You

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Qaher
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا قَهَّار ... اقهَر من ظَلَمَنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Qaharu Aqher Men Thalamana
en: Oh Allah The All Prevailing One… Prevail us from the ones that have mistreated us

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Waasi
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا واسِع... وَسَّع لَنا العِلم وَ العَطا
latin: Allahuma Ya Waasiu... Wassi Lana Al Eilma Wal Aata
en: Oh Allah The All-Encompassing, The Boundless, increase our knowledge and our generosity

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Awel Al Akhir
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا اَوَّل يا آخِر ... اَنْتَ في الكُل حَسْبُنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Awaalu Ya Aakhir… Anta fil Kuli Hasbona
en: Oh Allah The First and The Last… You are everything to us and we rely soley on You

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Rahmaan
ar: اللَّهُمّ يا رَحْمَنُ اَغِثْني
latin: Allahuma Ya Rahmanu Aghithny
en: Oh The most Gracious help me

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Noor
ar: يا نور السَّماوات و الأرض اجْعَل في وَجْهي نوراً و في لِساني نوراً و في قَلْبي نوراً وَ عَن يَميني نوراً وَ عَن شِمالي نوراً اللَّهُم اجْعَل لي نوراً أمْشي بِهِ بَيْنَ الناس
latin: Ya Noor Al Samawaati Wal Arred Ajaal Fi Wajhi Noor Wa Fi Lisaani Noor Wa Fi Qalbi Nooraa Wa Aen Yameeni Nooraa Wa Aen Shimaali Noora, Allahum Ajaal Li Noora Amshi Behi Bayna Al Naas
en: Oh Allah The Light of the earth and skies, lighten up my face, my tongue, and my heart. Oh Allah put light on my right and my left and give me light that brightens me up when I’m around people

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Haadi
ar: اللَّهُم يا هادي اَهْدِنا لِأَحسَن الاخلاق فلا يُهْدي لِأحسَنْها اِلا أَنْت
latin: Allahuma Ya Haadi Ihdena Li Ahsan Al Akhlaaq Fala Yahdey Li Ahsaanha Illa Ant
en: Oh Allah the Guider, guide me to the best manners as You are the only one that Guides

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Samaad
ar: اللَّهُم يا صَمَد يا مَن يَقْضي حَوائِج الناس اَقْضي حوائِجنا و حَقَّق أُمانينا و فَرِّج كروباتِنا
latin: Allahuma Ya Samaad Ya Men Taqdey Hawaaij Al Naas Eaqdey Hawaijana Wa Haqiq Amaanina Wa Farij Korobatina
en: Oh Allah, The Eternal, Satisfier of Needs, The One that grants everyone of their needs. Grant us our wishes and ease our hardships

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Qader Al Moqtader
ar: يا الله يا قادِر يا قَدير يا مُقْتَدِر اَرِني عَجائِب قُدْرَتِكَ فيما أَتَمَنَّى
latin: Ya Allah Ya Qadr Ya Qadeer Ya Moqtadr Arenee Aajaaiba Qodratika Fima Atmena
en: Oh Allah, The Omnipotent One, The Powerful show me your miracles in what I wish for

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Affoo
ar: اللَّهُم يا عَفُوْ اعفْ عَنَّا و عافِنا  في الدُّنْيا وَ الاَخِرَة
latin: Allahuma Ya Aafoo Aafoo Anna Wa Aafena Fil Dunya Wal Akhirah
en: Oh Allah, The Pardoner, pardon us in this life and the hereafter

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Qabed Al Baasit
ar: يا قابِض يا باسِط اِقْبِض عَنِّي كُلَّ شَرٍّ وَ مَعْصِيَةٍ وَ أَبْسِط لي مِن كُلَّ خَيْرٍ وَ أُمْنِيَّةٍ  اَقْبِض عَنِّي ساعات الأَلَمِ  وَ اَبْسِط لي ساعات الفَرَحِ. اقْبِض عَنِّي أَصْحابّ السوءِ وَ أَبْسِط لي صُحْبَة الخَيْر وَ اَقْبِض عَنَّي الكَرْب وَ الهَم و الغَم و اَبْسِط لي الأَمَل و البِشر
latin: Ya Qabed Ya Baset Aqbid Anni Kul Sharin Wa Maaseyah Wa Absit Li Min Kul Khairin Wa Omniyah. Aqbid Anni Saat Al Allem Wa Abset Li Saat Al Farah Aqbid  Anni Asshaab Ansooi Wa Abset Li Sohbeta Al Khair Wa Aqbid Anni Al Karba wal Ham Wal Gham Wa Abset Li Al Amal Wal Beshr
en: Oh Allah The Withholder, The Extender, keep all evil and hardships away from me and increase all goodness and blessings. Oh Allah all withhold all hours of misery and extend hours of happiness for me and keep away from me the immoral friends and bless me with noble friends. Oh Allah withhold the sadness from me and grant me enthusiasm and hope

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Qareeb Al Arahmaan Al Raheem
ar: أسْألُكَ بِإسْمِكَ القَريب أن تُقَرِّبْنا لَك وَ تُحَبِّبْنا في طاعَتِك وَ تُقَرِّب بَيْنَنا وَ بَيْنَ الصالِحين مِن عِبادِكَ يا أَرْحَم الراحِمين
latin: Asaluka Bi Ismeka Al Qareeb An Toqaribna Lak Wa Tohabibna Fi Taaitika Wa Toqareb Baynana Wa Bayna Al Saaleheena Min Ibaadek Ya Arhama Al Rahemeen
en: Oh Allah I ask you with Your name that is Near to allow us to get close to You and allow us to love and worship You, and allow us to get close to your righteous worshipers oh most Merciful and most Beneficent

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Wadood
ar: يا وَدود اَجْعَل في قَلْبي حُبَّاً وَوِدَّاً عَظيماً لَك وَ اَكْتِبْني مِمَّن تَوَدَّهُم مِن عِبادِكَ وَ اجْعَلْني وَدوداً لِخَلْقِكَ حَتّى تُحِبُّني النَّاس
latin: Ya Wadood Ajaal Fi Qalbi Hobaan Wa Weddan Adheeman Lak Wa Aktobney Meman Taweddahom Min Ibadik Wa Ajaalni Wadoodan Li Khalqik Hata Tohibbaney Al Naas
en: Oh Allah the Most Loving place endless love and admiration in my heart for You and record me as the ones that love You from your servants (worshipers) Oh Allah allow me to have love and tenderness towards others to others love me

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Wakeel
ar: يا ْوَكِيلُ  يا رَب اجْعَلْني مِن المُتَوَكِّلينَ عَلَيْكَ في حَياتي كُلَّها ولا تَكِلْني الى نَفْسي طَرفَة عَيْنٍ و لا اَقَلَّ مِنْها تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَيْكَ فلا تَتْرُكْني يا وَكيلي
latin: Ya Wakeel Ya Rab Ajalnee Min Al Motawakeleen Alika Fi Hayati Koliha Wa La Takilney illa Nafsey Tarfeta Aiyn Wa La Iqala Minha Tawakalto Alika Fala Tatrokni Ya Wakeeley
en: Oh Allah, The Trustee, The Disposer of Affairs I am solely depending on You for all my life affairs. Do not leave me to myself even for the blinking of an eye (i.e a moment) as I am have whole-heartedly relying on You as You are my Trustee

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Walee
ar: يا وَلِيّ تَوَل أَمْري تَوَلَّني بِرَحْمَتِكَ تُوَلَّني بِهِدايَتِكَ تَوَلَّني حَتى يَمْلَئْني الأَمانُ مِن الدُّنْيا و الآخِرَة  فأنْتَ القائِل(ألَّا اِن اَوْلِياءَ الله لا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِم وَ لا هُم يَحْزَنون) سورة يونِس (62)
latin: Ya Walee Tawala Amri Tawaleney Bi Rahmatik Tawaleney Behedayatik Tawaleney Hata Yamlauney Al Amaana Min Al Donya Wal Akhirah FaAnta Al Qael "Alla Ina Auleyaa Allahi La Khaofan Aliehim Wala Hom Yahzanoon"(62)
en: Oh Allah The Protecting One , The Governor of everything, I am solely trusting all my affairs to You through Your mercy and Your guidance until I reach ultimate contentment and security in this life and hereafter as You have said in surat Younis ‘Unquestionably, [for] the allies of Allah there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve(62)’surat Yunus

nama: Dua Using Allah's Name Al Jabaar
ar: يا جَبَّار اِجْبُر بِخاطِري .. اِجْبُر حالي .. اَجْبُر اِنْكِساري بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ.. اِجْبُر أَلَمي وَهَمِّي وَ حُزْني
latin: Ya Jabaar Ejbor Bikhatiri Ijbor Haaley Ejber Inkisaarey Bayna Yadayik Ejbor Alamey Wa Hammey Wa Huzney
en: Oh Allah, The Compeller, The Restorer, restore me and all affairs, restore anything that is broken in me by healing me and all my pains, sadness and concerns

nama: Dua For Fear of Something Bad Happening
ar: اللّهُمّ اسْتُرْنا فَوْقَ الاَرْض وَ تَحْتَ الاَرْض وَ يَوْم العَرْض
latin: Allahuma Asturna Faoqa Al Arred Wa Tahta Al Arred Wa Yaouma Al Arred
en: Oh Allah protect us whilst we are on earth, under the soil and the day of judgement

ar: اللَّهُمّ اِنّا نَجْعَلُكَ في نُحورِهِم وَ نَعوذُ بِكَ مِن شُرورِهم
latin: Allahum Ina Najalouka Fi Nohorihim Wa Naouthou Bika Min Shoroorihim
en: Oh Allah, We (I) ask You to face them and seek Your protection against their evil

ar: رَبِّ اَعوذُ بِكَ مِن هَمَزاتِ الشياطين وَ اَعوذُ بِكَ رَبَّ اَن يَحْضرون
latin: Rabbi Aothou Bika Men Hazamati Al Shayteen Wa Aouthou Bika Rabbi An Yahtheroon
en: My Lord, I seek refuge with You from the whisperings of the Shayateen (devils). My Lord lest they should come near me (Surah Al Mominum Aya 97-98)

ar: اللَّهُمّ باعِد بَيْني وَ بَيْنَ خطايايّ كَما باعَدْتَ بَيْنَ المَشْرِق و المَغْرِب ، اللَّهُمّ اغْسِلْني من خَطايايّ بالماءِ وَالثَلْج وَ البَرْد
latin: Allahum Baaid Baynee Wa Beyna Khataayaa Kama Baidta Beyna Al Moshriqi Wal Maghrib, Allahum Aghsilney Min Khataaya Bil Maai Wal Thaliji Wal Barrid
en: Oh Allah separate me from my sins as you have separated the East from the West, Oh Allah wash away my sins with water, ice and frost

nama: Dua to Seek Protection from Bad
ar: اللَّهُمّ اِنّي اَعوذُ بِك مِن مُنْكَراتِ الاَخْلاقِ وَ الاعْمالِ و الاَهْواءِ
latin: Allahum Ini Aothou Bika Men Monkaraati Al Akhlaaqi Wal Aamaali Wal Aahwaa
en: Oh Allah, I seek refuge in You from reprehensible manners, deeds and whims

nama: Dua to Seek Protection from Bad
ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَحْمَنِ الرّحيم   تَبَّت يَدا اَبي لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ (1). ما أَغْنى عَنْهُ مالُه وَ ما كَسَب (2) سَيَصْلى ناراً ذاتَ لَهَب (3) وَ اَمْرأَتَه حَمَّالَةَ الحَطَب (4) في جيدِها حَبْلٌ مِن مَسَد(5)
latin: Bismellah Al Rahman Al Raheem. Tabat Yada Abee Lahab Wa Tab(1) Ma Aghna Anhu Maalahu Wa Ma Kasab(2) Sayasla Naran Thata Lahab(3) Wam- mraatahu Hamaalat Al Hataab(4) Fi Jeediha Haabilun Min Masaad (5)
en: In the name of God, the Gracious, the Merciful. Condemned are the hands of Abee Lahab, and he is condemned(1) His wealth did not avail him, nor did what he acquired (2) He will burn in a Flaming Fire (3) And his wife – the firewood carrier(4)Around her neck is a rope of thorns(5)

nama: Dua for Protection from All Evil
ar: بِسْمِ الله الذي لا يُضَر مَعَ اِسْمهُ شَئٌ في الاَرْضِ و لا في السّماءِ وَ هُوَ السَميعُ العَليم
latin: BisMellah Allathee La Yadoro Maa Ismehe Shaeain Fi Al Arred Wa La Fi Al Samaai Wa Huwa Al Sameea Al Aleem
en: In the Name of Allah (SWT) with Whose Name there is protection against every kind of harm in the earth or in the heaven, and He is the All Hearing and All Knowing

nama: Dua Asking to do Good things, Shun the Bad
ar: اللَّهُمّ اِنّي أسألُكَ فِعْلَ الخَيْراتِ وَ تَرْك المُنْكَراتِ وَ حُبَّ المساكين ، وَ اِذا أرَدْتَ بِعِبادِكَ فِتْنَةً فاقْبِضْني اليْكَ غَيْر مَفْتون
latin: Allahum Ini Asaluka Feaala Al Khayrat Wa Tirek Al Monkaraat Wa Hub Al Masaakeen Wa Itha Ardta Biebaadeka Fetnten Faaqbidnee Ilayka Ghaira Maftoon
en: Oh Allah, I beg You to make me do good things, shun reprehensible things and love the helpless. If You plan to afflict Your slaves with faith trails, I beg You to make me die without affliction

nama: Dua to Seek Protection from Bad
ar: اللَّهُمّ اِنّي اَعوذُ بِكَ مِن شَرِّ ما صَنَعْت
latin: Allahuma Ini Aouthou Bika Min Shari Ma Saneaat
en: Oh Allah I seek refuge in YOU from what bad I have done

ar: اللَّهُمّ صَلِّي على مُحَمَّد و على آلِ مُحَمّد كَما صَلَّيْتَ على اِبْراهيم اِنَّكَ حَميدٌ مَجيد اللّهُمّ بارِك على مُحَمّد  وَ على آل مُحَمَّد كَما بارَكْتَ على اِبْراهيم و على آلِ ابراهيم اِنَّكَ حَميدٌ مَجيدٌ
latin: Allahum Sallee Ala Muhammadin Wa Ala Aale Muhammad Kama Salayta Alaa Ibraheem Innaka Hameedon Majeed Allahum Barek Ala Muhammadin Wa Ala Aale Muhammadin Kama Barekta Ala Ibraheema Wa Ala Ale Ibraheem Innaka Hameedon Majeed
en: Oh Allah send Your mercy on Muhammad and his posterity as You send Your mercy on Ibraheem and his posterity, You are the Most Praised, The Most Gracious, Oh Allah send Your Blessings on Muhammad and his posterity as You send Your Blessings on Ibraheem and his posterity. You are the Most Praised, the Most Glorious

ar: حَسْبُنا الله وَ نِعْمَ الوَكيل . نِعْمَ المَوْلى و نِعْمَ النَصير
latin: Hasbuna Allahu Wa Nemala Wakeel Nemal Maula Wa Nemanal Naseer
en: Allah (Alone) is Sufficient for us, and He is the Best Disposer of affairs (for us) what an Excellent Lord and what an Excellent Helper

ar: اللَّهُمّ اِنَّكَ عَفُوْ كَريم تُحِبُّ العَفْو فاعفو عَنّا
latin: Allahum Innaka Aafouun Kareem Tohebo Al Afooa Fa Aafoo Aanna
en: Oh Allah, You are the Forgiver, You love to forgive so forgive me

ar: رَبِّ اغْفِر لي وَ اَرْحَمني وَ تُب عَلَيّ
latin: Rabbi Aghfir Li Wa Arhamnee Wa Tob Allay
en: Oh Allah forgive me, have mercy upon me and accept my repentance

ar: رَبِّ اِنِّىْٓ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ اَنْ اَسْـــَٔـلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِيْ بِه عِلْمٌ ۭ وَاِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِيْ وَتَرْحَمْنِيْٓ اَكُنْ مِّنَ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ
latin: Rabbi Inneee A-o’od’u Bika An As-alaka Maa Laysa Lee Bihee I’lm Wa Illaa Taghfirlee Wa Tarh’amneee Akum Minal Khaasireen
en: O my Lord! I seek refuge with You from asking You that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have Mercy on me, I would indeed be one of the losers.

ar: لَّا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
latin: La illaha illa Anta Subhanak, inni kuntu min adh-dhalimeen
en: There is no God but You; Glory be to You, Truly I have been one of the wrongdoers

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَاجْبُرْنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَارْفَعْنِي
latin: Allaahum-maghfir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, wajburnee, wa ‘aafinee, warzuqnee, warfa’nee
en: O Allah forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, support me, protect me, provide for me and elevate me.

ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَّا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِر لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
latin: Allahumma anta rabbee la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtanee wa-ana AAabduk, wa-ana AAala AAahdika wawaAAdika mas-tataAAt, aAAoothu bika min sharri ma sanaAAt, aboo-o laka biniAAmatika AAalay, wa-aboo-o bithanbee, faghfir lee fa-innahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant.
en: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You, You created me and I am Your servant and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can, I take refuge in You from the evil of which I have committed. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sin except You.

ar: اللهمَّ إنِّي أَعوذُ بِكَ مِن جَهْدِ الْبَلَاءِ، وَدَرْكِ الشَّقَاءِ، وَسُوءِ الْقَضَاءِ، وَشَمَاتَةِ الْأعْدَاءِ
latin: Allahum Ini Aoutho Bika Men Jahd Al Balaa Wa Darke Al Sheqaa Wa Sooi Al Qadaai Wa Shamaatatil Aadaa
en: Oh Allah, I seek refuge in You from the distress of trial, from the lowest level of misery, from the perversity of fate, and from the malicious rejoicing of enemies

ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
latin: Rabana Aatina Men Ladunka Rahmatin Wa Hayea Lana Min Amrina Rashdaa
en: Our Lord! Give us mercy from Thy presence, and shape for us right conduct in our plight

ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي، وأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيها مَعَاشِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيها مَعَادِي، واجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرِ، وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرِّ
latin: Allahum Asleh Li Deeney Allathee Huwa Ismatu Amree Wa Asleh Li Donyay Allatee Fiha Maashee Wa Asleh Li Aakhiratee Allatee Fiha Maadee Wa Ajal Al Hayaata Ziyadata Li Fi Kul Khair Wa Ajal Al Maouta Raha Li Min Kul Shar
en: O Allah, make my religion easy for me by virtue of which my affairs are protected, set right for me my world where my life exists, make good for me my Hereafter which is my resort to which I have to return, and make my life prone to perform all types of good, and make death a comfort for me from every evil.

nama: Beautiful Salwaat-Darood Prophet Mohammed (peace be upon him)
ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ علَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
latin: Allahumma salli `ala Muhammadin, wa `ala aali Muhammadin, kama sallayta `ala aali Ibrahima, innaka Hamidum Majid. Allahumma barik `ala Muhammadin, wa `ala aali Muhammadin, kama barakta `ala aali Ibrahima, innaka Hamidum Majid   Sending abundant blessings (salawat) and peace (salam) upon the Prophet (peace be upon him) is a way to show our gratitude towards him (peace be upon him). It is a demonstration of a believer’s love and veneration for the Prophet (peace be upon him), and it is also one of the most beneficial supplications that a person can make.
en:
O Allah, exalt the mention of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as you exalted the family of Ibrahim. You are Praised and Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You blessed the family of Ibrahim. You are Praised and Glorious.
 In the Qur’an, Allah Most High says that He sends blessings upon the Prophet (peace be upon him) and then orders the believers to send their blessings and salutations upon the Prophet (peace be upon him). Allah says: ndeed, Allah showers His blessings upon the Prophet, and His angels pray for him. O’ believers! Invoke Allah’s blessings upon him, and salute him with worthy greetings of peace.

[Qur’an, 33:56]

ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبِّ النّاس اَذْهَب البأسِ و أَشْفِ اَنْتَ الشافي لا شِفاءَ اِلّا شِفاؤكَ شِفاءً لا يُغادِر سَقَماً
latin: Allahumma Rabaal Naas Adthib Al Baas Wa Ashfee, Anta Al Shafee La Shifaai Illa Shifaauk Shifaain La Yoghader Saqamaa
en: Oh Allah, Lord of mankind, do away with my suffering. Heal me as You are the only Healer and there is no cure except that of Yours, it is that which leaves no ailment behind

ar: اللَّهُم رَحْمَتَكَ اَرْجو فَلا تَكِلْني اِلى نَفْسي طَرْفَة عَيْنٍ وَ أَصْلِح لي شَأني كُلَّهُ لا اِلَهَ اِلّا اَنْت
latin: Allahumma Rahmataka Arjoo Fala Takilney Illa Nafsee Taarfet Aain Wa Asleh Li Shainee Kullahu La Illaha Illa Ant
en: Oh Allah Greant me health in my body. O Allah Grant me good hearing. Oh Allah Grant me good eyesight. There is no God but You.

ar: وَ اِذا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفينِ (80) (سورة الشُعَراء)
latin: Wa Itha Maredto Fahuwa Yashfeen (80) Surat Ash Shuara
en: And when I get sick, Surely He (Allah SWT) will heal me

nama: Dua for Good Health, Conduct and Success
ar: اللَهُم اِنِّي أَسْألُكَ صِحَةً  في اِيمانٍ و اِيماناً في حُسْنِ خُلقٍ و نَجاحاً يَتَّبِعْهُ فَلاحٌ وَ رَحْمَةً مِنْكَ و عافِيَةً وَ مَغْفِرَةً مِنْكَ وَرِضْواناً
latin: Allahumma Inni Asaluka Sehatin Fi Emaan Wa Eemaanan Fi Huseni Kholoq Wa Najaahen Yattbiohu Falaah Wa Rahmatin Minka Wa Aafiyah Wa Mghfiratan Minka Wa Ridwana
en: Oh Allah, I beg You to grant me health with faith, faith with good conduct, success followed by further success, mercy and healing and Your forgiveness and Your Satisfaction

ar: اللَّهُم أَغْفِر لي وَ اِرْحَمْني وَ اِهْدِني وَ اِرْزُقْني
latin: Allahuma Aghfer Lee Wa Arhamnee Wa Ahdinney Wa Arzoqnee
en: Oh Allah Forgive me, and have mercy on me. Guide me and grant me provision (good health).

ar: بِسْمِ الله اَعوذُ بِالله وَ قُدْرَتِهِ مِن شَرِّ ما أَجِد وَ اُحَاذرُ
latin: Bismillah, Aoutho Billahi Wa Qadratihi Min Shari Ma Ajedu Wa Ouhathir
en: With the name of Allah, I seek refuge with Allah and his omnipotence from evil of what I feel and that which I am wary of.

ar: اللَّهُم اِنِّي اَعوذُ بِكَ مِن الجُنونِ وَ الجُذامِ وَ البَرَصِ وَ سَيئِ الأَسْقامِ
latin: Allahumma Ini Aoutho Bika Min Al Jonoon Wal Jodtham Wal Barasi Wa Sayie Al Asqaam
en: Oh Allah I seek Your refuge from insanity, mutilation, leprosy and from all serious illnesses.

ar: لَقَد كُنْتَ في غَفْلَةٍ مِن هَذا فَكَشَفْنا عَنْكَ غِطاءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ اليَوْم حَديدٌ(22)( سورة قاف)
latin: Laqad Konta Fi Ghaflatin Min Hatha Fakashafna Aanka Ghitaaika Fabasaroka Al Yaouma Hadeed (22) (Surat Qaaf)
en: Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day

ar: الَّلهُم عافِني في بَدَني اللَّهُم عافِني في سَمْعي اللَّهُم عافِني في بَصَري لا اِلَهَ اِلّا اَنْت
latin: Allaahumma 'aafinee fee badanee, Allaahumma 'aafinee fee sam'ee, Allaahumma 'aafinee fee basaree, laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Ant
en: O Allah, make me healthy in my body. O Allah, preserve for me my hearing. O Allah, preserve for me my sight. There is none worthy of worship but You .

ar: يَشْفِ صُدورَ قَوْمٍ مؤمِنينَ (14)
latin: Washfi Sodoora Qaum Al Mumeneen
en: And God shall heal the chests of the believers ((14) Surat Al Tawba)

ar: وَ شِفاءٌ لِما في الصُدورِ(57) (سورة يونِس)
latin: Wa Shifaau Lema Fil Sodoor
en: Healing for (the deseases) in your hearts (57) (surat Yunus)

ar: يَخْرُجُ مِن بُطونِها شَرابٌ مُخْتَلِفٌ اَلْوانُهُ  فيهِ شِفاءٌ للنَّاسِ(69)(سورة النَحل)
latin: Yokhrej Men Botoneha Sharabun Mokhtalafon Alwanah Fehee Shifaaun Lilnaas
en: There comes from within the bodies of the bee a drink of varying colors wherein is healing for mankind (69)(surat Al Nahl)

ar: وَ نُنَزِّلُ مِن القُرآنِ ما هُوَ شِفاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلمؤمِنينَ(82)(سورة النَجْم)
latin: Wa Nonazilu Mina Al Qurani Ma Huwa Shifaau Wa Rahmato Lil Muminneen
en: And we sent down in the Quran such things that have healing and mercy for believers (Surat Najm)(82)

ar: وَ اِذا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفينِ (80) (سورة الشُعَراء)
latin: Wa Itha Marato Fahuwa Yashfeen
en: And when I am ill it is God that cures me  (80) (surat Shuara)

ar: قُل هُوَ لِلذينَ آمَنوا هُدى وَ شِفاءٌ (44) سورة (فُصِلَت)
latin: Qul Huwa Lil Latheena Aamano Huda Wa Shifaa
en: And declare (O Mohammed) that (the Quran) is guidance and healings for the believers (44) (surat Fussilat)

nama: To Relief tooth Ache/ Body Ache
ar: قُل هُوَ الذي اَنْشأَكُم  وَجَعَلَ لَكُمَ السَّمْعَ وَ الأَبْصارَ وَ الأَفْئِدَة قَليلاً ما تَشْكُرون(23)(سورة المُلْك)
latin: Qul Huwa Allathi Anshaekom Wa Jaala Lakom Al Sam’a Wal Absaara Wal Afidah Qaleelan Ma Tashkoroon (23) Surat Al Mulk
en: Say it is He who produced you and made for you the hearing and the vision and the organs. But rarely do you give thanks.

ar: الذينَ ءَامَنوا وَ تَطْمَئِّنُ قُلوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ الله أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ  تَطْمَئِنُ القُلوب(27)(سورة الرَعْد)
latin: Allatheena Aamanu Wa Tatmainna Qolobohom Bi Thiker Allah Illa Bi Thikir Allah Tatmaen Al Qoloob (28) Surat Ar Ra’d
en: Those who believe and whose hearts find comfort in the remembrance of God. Surely it is in the remembrance of God that hearts find comfort(28) Surat Al Ra'd

ar: وَبِالحَقِّ اَنْزَلْناهُ وَ بِالحَقِّ  نَزَّلْ  ما أَرْسَلْناكَ اِلّا مُبَشِّراً وَ نَذيراً (105)(سورة الاِسْراء)
latin: Wa Bil Haqei Anzalnahu Wa Bil Haqei Nazal Wa Maa Ar Salnaaka Mobasheran Wa Natheera (105) Surat Isra
en: With the truth We sent it down and with the truth it descended. We sent you only as a bearer of good news and a warner (105) Surat Isra

ar: لا فيها غَوْلٌ وَ لا هَم  عَنْها يَنْزِفونَ(47)(سورة الصافات)
latin: La Fiha Ghaulon Wa La Hom Aenha  Yonzafoon(47) Surat As Saffat
en: Never Polluted and never intoxicating (47)  Surat Al Saffat

nama: For kidney stone or urination problems
ar: ربنا الله الذي في السماء تقدس اسمك، أمرك في السماء والأرض، كما رحمتك في السماء فاجعل رحمتك في الأرض، اغفر لنا حوبنا وخطايانا أنت رب الطيبين، أنزل رحمة من رحمتك وشفاء من شفائك على هذا الوجع فيبرأ
latin: Rabunna Allah Allathee Fi Al Samai Toqades Ismok Amroka Fi Al Samai Wal Ard Kama Rahmatoka Fi Al Sama Fa Ajaal Rahmatuka Fi Al Ard Ighfir lana Hawbana Wa Khatayana Anta Rab Al Tayebeen Anzil Rahmatan Min Rahmatika Wa Shefaan Min Shefik Ala Hatha Al Wajaa' Fa Yabraa'
en: "Our Lord is Allah who is in the skies (worthy of worship). Your name is Pure. Your authority is prevalent in the sky and earth, just as Your Mercy is in the sky thus lower it on earth as well and forgive our sins and errors. You are the Lord of the pure ones thus descend upon this pain a cure (relief) from Your reliefs/cures and descend a Mercy from amongst Your Mercies on this pain.

ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
latin: La Illaha Illa Anta Sobhanak Inney Konto Mina Al Thalemeen
en: "There is none worthy of worship besides You O Allah, You are pure, I have oppressed my soul".

ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
latin: La Illaha Illa Allah Wal Allahu Akbar La Illaha Illa Allahu Wahdahu La Ilaha Illa Allahu Wa Wahdahu La Shareeka Lahu La Illaha Illa Allah Lahu Al Mulku Wal ahu Al Hamdu La Illaha Illa Allah Wa La Hawla Wa La Qowata Illa Billah
en: There in none worthy of worship besides Allah, He is the greatest. There is none worthy of worship besides Allah, He is all by Himself. There is none worthy of worship besides Allah. He has no partner with Him. His is the Kingdom and all Praise. He is the one to grant us the ability to save ourselves from sinning and to do good

nama: Dua when setting out on a Journey
ar: بِسْمِ الله تَوَّكَلْتُ عَلى اللَّه لا حَوْل وَ لا قُوَّةَ اِلّا بِالله
latin: Bismillahi Tawak Kaltu Al Laah La Hawla Wala Quwwata Illa Billah
en: In the name of Allah, I put my trust in Allah, there is no power and no strength except with Allah

nama: Dua As you Begin Your Travel
ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحيم اللَّهُ اَكْبَر. سُبْحانَ الذي  سَخَّرَ لَنا هَذا وَ ما كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنين وَ اِنَّا اِلى رَبَّنا لَمُنْقَلِبون
latin: Bismillah Al Rahman Al Raheem. Allahu Akbar. Subhaana Al Lathee Sakhara Lana Hatha Wa Ma Kona Lahu Moqreneen Wa Inna Illa Rabena La Monqaleboon.
en: In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful. Allah is the Greatest. Removed from imperfection is the One who has made this subservient to us, for we have no power to subjugate it, and certainly to our Lord shall we return.

nama: Dua As you Begin Your Travel
ar: اللَّهُ اَكْبَر اللَّهُ اَكْبَر اللَّهُ اَكْبَر اللَّهُم اِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ في سَفَرَنا هَذا البِر و التَقْوَى وَ مِن العَمَلِ ما تَرْضى اللَّهُم هَوِّن عَلَيْنا سَفَرَنا هَذا وَ اَطْو عَنَّا بُعْدُهُ اللَّهُم اَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ في السَفَر و الخَليفَةُ في الأَهْل اللَّهُم اِنِّي اَعوذُ بِكَ مِن وعُثاءِ السَّفَر وَ كآبَةِ المَنْظَر وَ سوءَ المُنْقَلَب في المال وَ الأَهْل والولد
latin: Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar, Allahum Inna Nasaluka fi Safarina Hatha Al Bira Wal Taqwa Wa Min Al Amaali Matorda. Allahum Hawen Aleina Safarana Hatha Wa Atawee Anna Boudh. Allahum Anta Al Saheb Fi Al Safari Wal Khalefah Fi Al Ahel. Allahum Inni Aoutho Bika Min Wathai Al Safer Wa Kaabeti Al Monther Wa Sooui Al Monqaleb Fil Maali Wal Aheli Wal Walad
en: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, we ask You for safety and strenghin this journey of ours and we ask You for deeds that please You. Oh Allah, facilitate our journey and let us cover its distance quickly. Oh Allah You are the Companion on the journey and The Successor over the family. Oh Allah I take refuge with You from difficulties of travel from having a change of hearts and being in a bad predicament, and I take refuge in You from an ill fated outcome with wealth and family.

ar: رَبّي اَنْزِلْني مُنْزَلاً مُبارَكاً وَ اَنْتَ خَيْرُ المُنْزِلين
latin: Rabbi Anzilney Monzalaan Mubarakaan Wa Anta Khair Al Monzeleen.
en: My Lord, allow me to land at a blessed landing place as You are the Best to accommodate

nama: Dua when Entering new Town/ City
ar: اللَّهُم بارِك لَنا فيها اللَّهُم  اَرْزِقْنا جَناها وَحَبِّبْنا اِلى اَهْلِها وَ حَبِّب صالِحي اَهْلَها اِلَيْنا
latin: Allahum Barek Lana Fiha. Allahum Arzoqna Janaha Wa Habibna Ila Ahleha Wa Habib Salehi Ahleha Ilayna.
en: Oh Allah grant us blessings/ barakat in this place. Oh Allah (SWT) Give us of its produce and make us like by its people and make us like the good people of this place.

nama: Dua when Stopping (Layover) along the way
ar: اَعوذُ بِكَلِماتِ اللَّهِ التّاماتِ مِن شَرِّ ما خَلَق
latin: Aoutho Bi Kalemaati Allah Al Taamaati Min Shari Ma Khalaq
en: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from any evil He has created.

ar: رَبّي اَدْخِلني مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ و أخرِجْني مُخْرجَ صِدْقٍ و إجْعَلُ لي مِن لَدُنْكَ سُلطاناً نَصيراً
latin: Rabbi Adkhilni Mudkhala Sidqin Wa Akhrijni Mokhrajaa Sidqin Wa Ajaal Li Min Ladonka Soltanan Naseeraa
en: My Lord! Cause me to come in with a firm incoming and to go out with a firm outgoing. And give me from Thy presence a sustaining Power

nama: Dua of the Traveller when leaving his/her Residence
ar: اِسْتَوْدَعَكُمُ اللَّه  الذي لا تُضيعُ وَدائِعُهُ
latin: Astawdi’Ukum Allah Allathee La Tadhee’u Wadaa’I’uhu
en: I Leave you in the care of Allah as nothing is lost that is in His care

ar: اللَّهُ اَكْبَر اللَّهُ اَكْبَر اللَّهُ اَكْبَر  لا اِلَهَ اِلا اللَّه وَحْدَهُ لا شَريكَ لَهُ لَهُ المُلْكُ وَ لَهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلى كُل شَئٍّ قَدير.  آيبون تائِبون عابِدون ساجدون لِرَبَّنا حامِدون  صَدَقَ اللهُ وَعْدَهُ وَ نَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَهَزَمَ الأَحْزابَ وَحْدَهُ
latin: Allahu Akbar (x3) La Ilaha Illa Allah Wahdahu La Shareeka Lah Lahu Al Mulk Wa Lahu Al Hamd Wa Huwa Alla Kulli Shayin Qadeer. Ayiboon Taaiboon Aaibidoon  Sajidoon Li Rabina Hamedun Sadaqa Allahu Waadah Wa Nasara Aabdah Wa Hazama Al Ahzaab Wadah.
en: Allah is the Greatest, None has the right to be worshipping but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things. We return repentant to our Lord, worshipping our Lord, and praising our Lord. He fulfilled His promise, He aided His slave, and He alone defeated the Confederates.

ar: اللَّهُمّ اِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يا الله بِأنَّكَ الواحِدُ الأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الذي لَم يَلِد و لَم يولَد وَ لَم يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفَواً أَحَد أَن تَغْفِرَ لي ذُنوبي اِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفور الرَّحيم
latin: Allahuma Inni Asaluka Ya Allah Bi Annaka Al Wahedu Al Ahhed Al Samad Allathi Lam Yalid Wa Lam Yolad Wa Lam Yakon Lahu Kofoaan Ahhad An Taghfir Lee Thonoobee Innaka Anta Al Ghfoor Al Raheem
en: Oh Allah I am asking you oh Allah The One that is The One, The Self-Sufficient Master, Whom all creatures need, He neither eats nor drinks. He begets not, nor was He begotten. And there is none co-equal or comparable unto Him. To Forgive me of all my sins as You are the most Forgiving most Merciful

ar: اللهم مالك الملك تؤتي الملك من تشاء وتنزع الملك ممن تشاء وتعز من تشاء وتذل من تشاء بيدك الخير إنك علي كل شئ قدير تولج الليل في النهار وتولج النهار في الليل وتخرج الحي من الميت وتخرج الميت من الحي وترزق من تشاء بغير حساب رحمان الدنيا والاخرة ورحيمهما تعطي من تشاء منهما .
latin: Allahum Maalik Al Mulik Tootee Al Mulk Min Tashaa Wa Tanzia Al Mulk Minman Tashaa Wa Toiz Men Tashaa Wa Tothel Men Tasha Beyadika Al Khair Innaka Ala Kul Shayen Qadeer Toulij Al Layl Fi Al Nahaar Wa Tulij Al Nahaar Fi Allayli Wa Tokhrij Al Hay Min Al Mayet Wa Tokhrij Al Mayet Men Al Hay Wa Torziq Men Tashaa Beghairi Hesaab Rahman Al Dunya Wal Akhirata WaRaheemahuma Toaatee Men Tashaa Minhuma
en: O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honor whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand is [all] good. Indeed, You are over all things competent. You make the night to enter into the day, and You make the day to enter into the night (i.e. increase and decrease in the hours of the night and the day during winter and summer), You bring the living out of the dead, and You.  bring the dead out of the living. And You give wealth and sustenance to whom You will. You (SWT) are the worlds most merciful and can give to whom ever you please in abundance

ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِي الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي به
latin: Allâhumma inni astakhiruka bi ilmika wa astaqdiruka biqudratik wa as’aluka min fadlikal-atheim, fa innaka taqdir walâ aqdir wa ta’lamu walâ a’lam wa anta allamul ghuyub. Allâhumma in kunta ta’lamu anna hâdhal amra khayrun li fi dini wa ma-ashi wa aqibati amri faqdir-hu li wa yassir-hu li thumma barik li fih wa in kunta ta’lamu anna hâdhal amra sharrun li fi dini wa maâshi wa aqibati amri fasrifhu anni wasrifni anh waqdir liyal-khayra haythu kâna thumma ardini beh.
en: O Allah, verily I seek the better [of either choice] from You, by Your knowledge, and I seek ability from You, by Your power, and I ask You from Your immense bounty. For indeed You have power, and I am powerless; You have knowledge and I know not; You are the Knower of the unseen realms. O Allah, if You know that this matter is good for me with regard to my religion, my livelihood and the end of my affair then decree it for me, facilitate it for me, and grant me blessing in it. And if You know that this matter is not good for me with regard to my religion, my livelihood and the end of my affair then turn it away from me and me from it; and decree for me better than it, wherever it may be, and make me content with it.”

nama: Dua for the month of Ramadan
ar: اللهم سلمني لرمضان وسلم رمضان لي وسلمه لي متقبلا
latin: Allahuma salimni liramadan wasalim Ramadan lee wasalimoho lee mutaqabila
en: Oh Allah Allow me to Enter Ramadan in the best way and accept Ramadan from me

ar:
الله أكبر ، اللهم أهله علينا بالأمن والإيمان، وبالسلامة 
والإسلام ، والتوفيق لما تحب ربنا وترضى ، ربنا وربك الله
latin: Allahu Akbar, Allahuma ahilahu Alayna bil amini wal iman, wa Bi Al salamati wal Islam, wal tawfeeqa lima tuhibu rabina wa tarda, rabuna wa Rabuka Allah
en: Allah is the most great. O Allah, bring us the new moon with security and Faith, with peace and in Islam, and in harmony with what our Lord loves and what pleases him. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.

ar: وبصوم غد نويت من شهر رمضان
latin: Wa bisawmi ghadin nawayta min Shaheri Ramadan
en: I intend to keep the fast tomorrow in the month of Ramadan

ar: اللهم إني لك صمت وبك آمنت وعليك توكلت وعلى رزقك أفطرت
latin: Allahuma Ini laka sumt wabika aamant wa alayka tawakalt wa ala rizqika aftart
en: O Allah! I fasted for you and I believe in you and I put my trust in you and I break my fast with your sustenance

ar: اأفطر عندكم الصائمون ،وأكل طعامكم الأبرار ، وصلت عليكم الملائكة
latin: Aftara indakum alsaimoon, wa akala taamakum alabrar, wa salat alaykum almalaikah
en: With you, those who are fasting have broken their fast, you have fed those who are righteous, and the angels recite their prayers upon you.

ar: إني صائم ، إني صائم
latin: Inni saaaim, Inni saaaim
en: I am fasting. I am fasting

ar: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من عذاب جهنم ، ومن عذاب القبر ، ومن فتنة . المحيا والممات ، ومن شر فتنة المسيح الدجال .
latin: Allahuma inni aothu bika min athab jahanam, wa min athabi alqabar, wa min fitnat almahya walmamat, wa min shar fitnat almaseeh aldajal
en: O Allah! I seek refuge in you from the affliction of the torment of hell fire, from the affliction of the torment in the grave, from trial of life and death and from the evil of the affliction of Al-Maseesh Ad-Dajjal

ar: اللهم أعز السلام والمسلمين
latin: Allahuma aiz alislam walmuslimeen
en: Oh Allah protect and give privillage to Islam and all Muslim

ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَ قِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
latin: Rabbana atina fid dunyaa hasana wa fil aakhirati hasana wa qina athab alnar
en: Our Lord, give us in this world good and in the Hereafter good and protect us from punishment of the hell fire

ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
latin: Rabbanaa Innaka Ra‘oofon Raheem
en: Our Lord! Thou art Full of Pity, Merciful

ar: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
latin: Rabbanaa taqabbal minna innaka antas Samee‘ul Aleem
en: Our lord, accept from us. Indeed you are the Hearing and the Knowing

ar: رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَ بَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَ أَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ
latin: Rabbanaf-tah  baynana wa baina qawmina bil haqq wa anta khairul fatiheen
en: Our Lord, decide between us and our people in the truth, and You are the best of those who give decision

ar: رَبَّنَا وَ لَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَ اعْفُ عَنَّا وَ اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَ ارْحَمْنَا أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ“
latin: Rabbana wa laa tuhammilnaa ma la taaqata lanaa beh waoufo ana. Waghfir lana warhamnaa anta mawlaana fansurna alal qawmil kaafireen
en: Our Lord! Impose not on us that which we have not the strength to bear! Pardon us, absolve us and have mercy on us, Thou, our Protector, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk

ar: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَ تَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
latin: Rabbanaa afrigh ’alaina sabran wa tawaffana muslimeen
en: Our Lord! Vouchsafe unto us steadfastness and make us die as men who have surrendered (unto Thee)

ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَ لِوَالِدَيَّ وَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
latin: Rabbanna ughfir lee wa liwaalidaiya wa lilmu‘mineena yawma yaqoomul hisaab
en: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and believers on the day when the account is cast

ar: رَبَّنَا وَ لَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا
latin: Rabbana wa laa tahmil alainaa isran kamaa hamaltahoo alal latheena min qablinaa
en: Our Lord! Lay not on us such a burden as thou didst lay on those before us!

ar: رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَ ءَاخِرِنَا وَ ءَايَةً مِّنكَ  وَ ٱرْزُقْنَا وَ أَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ"
latin: Rabbanaa anzil alainaa maa‘idat minas samaa‘i takoonu lanaa edal li awalina wa akhirinaa wa aayatam minka warzuqna wa anta khairur raziqeen
en: Oh Allah send down for us a table from heaven to be festival for us for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from You and provide for us You are the Best of providers

ar: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَ ذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَ اجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
latin: Rabbana hab lanaa min azwaajina wa thurriyatina qurata ayunin waj alaana lilmuttaqeena imamaa
en: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil)

ar: رَبَّنَا لا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَ هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ“
latin: Rabbana la tuzigh quloobana baaeda ith hadaitana wa hab lanaa mil ladunka rahmah innaka antal wahhaab
en: Our Lord! Cause not our hearts to stray after Thou hast guided us, and bestow upon us mercy from Thy Presence. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Bestower

ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَ لِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَ لَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا“
latin: Rabbanaa agfir lanaa wa li ikhwaani nal latheena sabqoona bil eemaan wa la tajil fee quloobina ghillalil latheena amanoo
en: Our Lord! Forgive us and our brethren who were before us in the faith, and place not in our hearts any rancour toward those who believe.

ar: رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَ كَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَ تَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
latin: Rabbana faghfir lanaa thunoobana wa kaffir Anna saiyiaatina wa tawaffanaa maal abraar
en: Our Lord! Therefor forgive us our sins, and remit from us our evil deeds, and make us die the death of the righteous

ar: رَبَّنَآ ءَتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَ هَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
latin: Rabbanna aatina min ladunka rahmah wa haiya lanaa min amrinaa rashadaa
en: Our Lord! Give us mercy from Thy presence, and shape for us right conduct in our plight

ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَ إِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَ ثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَ انصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
latin: Rabbanna aghfir lana thunoobanaa wa israafanaa fee amrinaa wa thabbit aqdaamanaa wansurna alal qawmil kaafireen
en: Our Lord! forgive us for our sins and wasted efforts, make our foothold sure, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk

ar: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَ تَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
latin: Rabb ijalnee muqeema assalaati wa min thurriyaatee Rabbana wa taqabbal duaa
en: My Lord make me an establisher of prayer and from my descendants My Lord accept my supplications

ar: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
latin: Rabbana maa khalaqta hatha baatilan subhaanaka faqina athaab annaar
en: Our Lord you did not create this aimlessly exalted are You then protect us from the punishment of the hell

ar: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَنْ يَطْغَى
latin: Rabbanaa innana nakhaafu ai yafruta alainaa aw ai yatghaa
en: Our Lord indeed we are afraid that he will hasten against us or that he will transgress

ar: رَبَّنَا وَ ءَاَتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَ لَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
latin: Rabanna wa aatina ma wa attanaa alaa rusulika wa laa tukhzinaa yawmal qiyaamah innaka la tukjliful meeaad
en: Our Lord! And give us that which Thou hast promised to us by Thy messengers. Confound us not upon the Day of Resurrection. Lo! Thou breakest not the tryst

ar: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
latin: Rabbanna aamanna faktubnaa maash shaahideen
en: Our Lord, we believe. Inscribe us as among the witnesses

ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
latin: Rabbana innaka jaami unnaasi li yawmil laa raiba feeh inna allah laa yukhliful meeaad
en: Our Lord! Lo! it is Thou Who gatherest mankind together to a Day of which there is no doubt. Lo! Allah faileth not to keep the tryst

ar: رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
latin: Rabbana La ghafurun shakoor
en: Our Lord is forgiving and appreciative

ar: رَبَّنَا وَ أَدۡخِلۡهُمۡ جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٍ ٱلَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمۡ وَ مَن صَلَحَ مِنۡ ءَابَآئِهِمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ  وَ قِهِمُ ٱلسَّيِّ‍َٔاتِ وَ مَن تَقِ ٱلسَّيِّ‍َٔاتِ يَوۡمَئِذٖ فَقَدۡ رَحِمۡتَهُۥ وَ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ"
latin: Rabbana wa adhkhilhum jannati adin alati wa‘attahum wa man salaha min aba‘ihim wa azwajihim wa thuriyyatihim infaka antal azizul hakim Waqihimus saiyiat wa man taqis saiyiat yawmaithin faqad rahimatehu wa dhalika al fawzul atheem
en: Our Lord admit them to the gardens of  Eternity which You have promised them and the righteous among their parents and their spouses and their offspring. You are indeed the Almighty the Most Wise. And Shield them from the evil deeds. Whomever You shield from the evil deeds on the Day, You have had mercy on him. This is the supreme achievement.

ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَآ ءَاَمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَ قِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
latin: Rabbannaa inanaa amanna faghfir lana thunoobana wa qinaa athaab alnaar
en: Our Lord! Lo! we believe. So forgive us our sins and guard us from the punishment of Fire

ar: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَ ارْحَمْنَا وَ أَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
latin: Rabbanna aamana faghfir lanaa warhamnaa wa anta khairur raahimeen
en: Our Lord! We believe, therefor forgive us and have mercy on us for Thou art Best of all who show mercy

ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَ مَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ
latin: Rabbanna innaka man tudkhil il naara faqad akhzaitah wa maa lilthaalimeena min ansaar
en: Our Lord! Whom Thou causest to enter the Fire: him indeed Thou hast confounded. For evil-doers there will be no helpers

ar: رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا
latin: Rabbanaa innanaa samiinaa munaadiyai yunaadee lil eemaani an aamino bi rabbikum fa aamannaa
en: Our Lord! Lo! we have heard a crier calling unto Faith: "Believe ye in your Lord!" So we believed.

ar: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا .. إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَ مُقَامًا“
latin: Rabbana asrif annaa athaaba jahannam inn athaabahaa kaana  gharaamaa Innahaa saaat mustaqarra wa muqaamaa
en: Our Lord avert from us the punishment of hell Indeed its punishment is over adhering indeed it is evil as a settlement and residence

ar: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا بِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ وَ ٱتَّبَعْنَا ٱلرَّسُولَ فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّٰهِدِينَ
latin: Rabbana aamanaa bima anzalta wattabaana arrasool faktubnaa maash shaahideen
en: Our Lord we have believed in what you revealed and have followed the messengers so register us among the witnesses

ar: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَ عِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا وَ اتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَ قِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ“
latin: Rabbanna wasiata kulla shayin  rahmatanw wa ilman faghfir lillatheena taaboo wattabaoo sabeelaka wa  qihim athaabal jaheem
en: Our Lord! Thou comprehendest all things in mercy and knowledge, therefor forgive those who repent and follow Thy way. Ward off from them the punishment of hell

ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ .. وَ نَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ“
latin: Rabbanna la tajilna fitnatan lilqawmi althaalimeen wa najjina bi rahmatika minal qawmil kaafireen
en: Our Lord make us not trial for the wrongdoing people  And save us by you mercy from the disbelieving people

ar: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ“
latin: Rabbanna thalamnaa anfusanaa wa illam taghfir lala wa tarhamnaa lanakoonanna minal  khaasireen
en: Our Lord we have wrong ourselves and if you do not forgive us and have mercy upon us we surely be among the losers

ar: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَ ثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَ انصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ“
latin: Rabbana affrigh alainaa sabran wa thabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa alal qawmil kaafireen
en: Our Lord! Bestow on us endurance, make our foothold sure, and give us help against the disbelieving folk

ar: "رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا“
latin: Rabbana laa tu aakhithnaaa in naseenaa aw akhtaanaa
en: Our Lord! Condemn us not if we forget, or miss the mark!

ar: رَبَّنَا وَ اجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَ أَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَ تُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ“
latin: Rabbana wajalnaa muslimaini laka wa min thurriyyatinaa ummatam muslimatal lak wa arinaa manaasikanaa wa tub alainaa innaka antat tawaabur raheem
en: Our Lord and make us muslims to you and from our decendants a muslim nation to you and show us our rites and accept out repentance indeed you are the accepting of repentance the merciful -

ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
latin: Rabbannaa la tajalnaa maal qawmith thaalimeen
en: Our Lord! Place us not with the wrong-doing folk

ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِي وَ مَا نُعْلِنُ وَ مَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِن شَيْءٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَ لَا فِي السَّمَاءِ"
latin: Rabbanaa innaka taalamu maa nukhfee wa maa nulin wa maa yakhfaa alal laahi min shaiin fil ardi wa laa fis samaa
en: Our Lord! Lo! Thou knowest that which we hide and that which we proclaim. Nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah

ar: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَ اغْفِرْ لَنَا إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
latin: Rabbanaa atmim lanaa nooranaa waghfir lana innaka alaa kulli shayin qadeer
en: Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us! Lo! Thou art Able to do all things

ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَ اغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ“
latin: Rabbana la tajalnaa fitnatal lilatheena kafaroo waghfir lanaa rabbanaa innaka antal azeezul hakeem
en: Our Lord make us not torment for the disbelievers and forgive us our lord indeed it is you who is exalted in might the wise

ar: رَّبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَ إِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَ إِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
latin: Rabbannaa alika tawakkalna wa ilaika anabnaa wa ilaikal maseer
en: Our Lord! In Thee we put our trust, and unto Thee we turn repentant, and unto Thee is the journeying

ar: Arabic Recitation
en: Sheikh Reciting Powerful Dua

ar: English Recitation
en: Sheikh Mufti Mink

ar: اللهم إن كانت هذه ليلة القدر فإقسم لى فيها خير ما قسمت، وإختم لى فى قضائك خير مما ختمت، وإختم لى بالسعادة فيمن ختمت. اللهم إجعل إسمى وذريتي فى هذه الليلة فى السعداء، وروحي مع الشهداء، وإحسانى فى عليين، وإساءتى مغفورة
latin: Allahum In Kanet Hathehi Laylatu Al Qadr Fa Aqsem Li Fiha Khaira Ma Qasamet Wa Akhtem Li Fi Qadaika Khairan Mema Khatemt Wa Akhtem Li Bil Saadati Fimen Khatemt. Allahum Ajaal Ismee Wa Thoriyatee Fi Hathehi Al Laylati Fi Al Souaddaa Wa Roohee Maa Al Shohadaa Wa Aihsaanee Fi Ileen Wa Aisaaitee Maghfoorah
en: Oh Allah if this night is Laylat Al Qadr, Please grant me all its goodness and allow my endings to be happy. Oh Allah allow my name as well as my family's name on this powerful night to be of those that are happy, rewarded highly and forgiven

ar: اللهم إفتح لى الليلة باب كل خير فتحته لأحد من خلقك وأوليائك وأهل طاعتك ولا تسده عنى، وأرزقنى رزقا تغيثنى به من رزقك الطيب الحلال. اللهم ما قسمت فى هذه الليلة المباركة من خير وعافية وصحة وسلامة وسعة رزق فإجعل لى منه نصيبا، وما أنزلت فيها من سوء وبلاء وشر وفتنة فإصرفه عنى وعن جميع المسلمين
latin: Allahum Aftah Li Allaylata Baab Kul Khair Fatahtahu Li Ahed Min Khalqika Wa Awleyaeka Wa Ahel Taatik Wa La Tasidahu Annee Wa Arzoqnee Rizqaan Toghnenee Beh Min Rizqika Al Tayeba Al Hallal. Allahuma Ma Qasamta Fi Hathehe Al Laylatil Mobaarakati Min Khair Wa Aafeeyah Wa Saahatin Wa Salaamatin Waseaati Rizqin Faajaal Lee Minhu Naseebaa Wa Ma Anzalta Fiha Min Sooi Wa Balaai Wa Shaarin Wa Fitnatin Fa Assrefhu Annee Wa An Jameea Al Muslemeen
en: Oh Allah on this blessed evening open the doors for me for all that is good as you have done in the past for all your righteous salves and prophets. Oh Allah bestow upon me lots of provisions and success that which is halal and do not need to depend on anyone. Oh Allah allow me to be of those people you named to have happiness, good health, blessings, peace and lots of wealth/provisions, And if you have me written as those to have any pain, suffering or bad occurrence then please Allah keep it away from me and do not bestow it on me or any muslim

ar: اللهم ما كان فيها من ذكر وشكر فتقبله منى وأحسن قبوله، وما كان من تفريط وتقصير وتضييع فتجاوز عنى بسعة رحمتك يا أرحم الرحمين.  اللهم تغمدنى فيها بسابغ كرمك، وإجعلنى فيها من أوليائك وإجعلها لى خيرا من ألف شهر مع عظيم الأجر وكريم الذخر. اللهم لا تصرفنى من هذه الليلة إلا بذنب مغفور، وسعى مشكور، وعمل متقبل مبرور، وتجارة لن تبور، وشفاء لما فى الصدور، وتوبة خالصة لوجهك الكريم
latin: Allahuma Ma Kaana Feeha Min Thikirin Wa Shokerin Fa Taqabelhu Minnee Wa Ahsen Qoboolah Wa Ma Kana Min Tafreeti Wa Taqseeri Wa Tadeein Fa Tajaawaz Annee Bi Seaten Rahmetik Ya Arham Al Rahemeen. Allahum Taghamadanee Fiha Bisabegh Karamek Wa Ajaalnee Fiha Min Awleyaeka Wa Ajaalha Li Khaira Min Alfi Shaher Maa Athemi Al Ajer Wa Kareem Al dakhir. Allahuma La Tasrefnee Min Hathehi Al Laylati Illa Bithanben Meghfoor Wa Saaee Mashkoor Wa Aamalin Motaqabelin Mabroor Wa Tijaarten Lan Taboor Wa Shefaaun Lema Fi Al Sodoor Wa Tawbatin Khalisaetin Lewajhika Al Kareem
en: Oh Allah as we perfom our rememberance, supplication, and gratitude on this night of decree, accept it from us and grant it the highest reward. Our Lord, condemn us not if we forget or fall into error oh You are Entirely Merciful . Oh All Mighty Kind and Generous allow this night of power to be better than a thousand nights for me and all the muslims and reward us all its powerful blessings. Oh Allah do not allow this night of decree to pass with You forgiving me and rewarding me, granting me ease and comfort, accepted repentance to You All Mighty.

ar: اللهم إجعلنى وأهلى وذريتى والمسلمين جميعا فيها من عتقائك من جهنم وطلقائك من النار.  اللهم إجعلنى فى هذه الليلة ممن نظرت إليه فرحمته وسمعت دعاءه فأجبته.  اللهم أسالك فى ليلة القدر وأسرارها وأنوارها وبركاتها أن تتقبل ما دعوتك به وأن تقضى حاجتى يا أرحم الرحمين
latin: Allahum Ajaalnee Wa Ahlee Wa Thoreyatee Wal Moslemeena Jameeaan Feeha Min Otaqaika Min Jahanem Wa Tolqaika Min Al Naar. Allahuma Ajaalnee Fi Hathehee Al Laylah Minman Natharta Ilayhee Fa Rahimtah Wa Sameata Duaahu Fa Ajebtah. Allahuma Asaluka Fi Laylati Al Qadr Wa Asrariha Wa Anwooriha Wa Barakatiha An Tataqabal Ma Daautueka Beh Wa An Taqdee Hajaatee Ya Arham Al Rahemeen
en: Oh Allah save me and all my family and all muslims from the torture of hell fire. Oh Allah decree this powerful night for us to be amongst those you see and have mercy on them and accepted Duas. Oh Allah I ask you with the power of the night of decree and all its powers, blessings and light to accept all I have asked for oh most Merciful most Generous

ar: اللهم لا تدع لنا يا ربنا في هذه الليلة العظيمة ذنبا إلا غفرته، ولا مريضا إلا شفيته، ولا ميتا إلا رحمته، ولا دعاء إلا إستجبته، ولا تائبا إلا قبلته، ولا عاريا إلا كسوته، ولا فقيرا إلا أغنيته، ولا مؤمنا إلا ثبته، ولا مؤمنا إلا ثبته، ولا مؤمنا إلا ثبته، ولا طالبا إلا وفقته، ولا عاصيا إلا هديته، ولا مظلوما إلا نصرته، ولا عدوا إلا أخذته، ولا عدوا إلا أهلكته، ولا حاجة من حوائج الدنيا والآخرة هي لك فيها رضا ولنا فيها صلاح إلا قضيتها ويسرتها برحمتك يا أرحم الراحمين، يا أرحم الراحمين، يا أرحم الراحمين ، يا أرحم الراحمين
latin: Allahum La Tadea Lana Ya Rabbana Fi Hathehee Al Laylatan Al Atheema Thanbaan  Illa Ghafartah Wa La Mareedan Illa Shafaytah Wa La Mayetan Illa Rahemtah Wa La Duaain Illa Istajabtah Wa La Taibaan Illa Qabiltah Wa La Areeyan Illa Kasaotah Wa La Faqeeran Illa Aghnaytah Wa La Moumenaan Illa Thabatah Wa La Moumenan Illa Thabatah Wa La Moumenaan Illa Thabatah Wa La Talebaan Illa Wafaqtah Wa La Aaseeyan Illa Hadaytah Wa La Mathloomaan Illa Nasartah Wa La Adoowan Illa Akhathtah Wa La Aduwaan Illa Ahlaktah Wa La Haajaten Min Hawaaij Al Dunya Wal Aakhirah Heya Lak Fiha Redaan Wa Lana Fiha Salaah Illa Qadaytaha Wa Yasertaha Birahmatika Ya Arham Al Raahemeen Ya Alram Al Raahemeen Ya Arhem Al Raahemeen
en: Oh Allah do not allow this Night of Decree to pass without You forgiving all our sins, healing all those that are sick, having mercy on those that have passed before us and accepting all what we ask for. Oh all accept all those that have repented, grant success to all students, guidance to all sinners, victory to suffering victims, end to all tyrants, and accepted duas that please You oh Most Merciful

ar: يا قاضى الحاجات، يا قاضى الحاجات، يا قاضى الحاجات يا مجيب الدعوات. اللهم يا فارج الهم، يا كاشف الهم، يا مجيب دعوة المضطرين لا يخفى عليك شيء من أمرنا، نسألك يا ربنا مسألة المساكين، ونبتهل إليك يا ربنا إبتهال الخاضع المذنب الذليل. اللهم ندعوك دعاء من خضعت لك رقبته، وذل لك جسمه، ورغم لك أنفه وفاضت لك عيناه، يا من يجيب المضطر إذا دعاه، يا من يجيب المضطر إذا دعاه، يا من يجيب المضطر إذا دعاه، ويكشف السوء عمن ناداه
latin: Ya Qaadee Al Hajaat Ya Qadee Al Hajaat Ya Qaadee Al Hajaat Ya Mojeeb Al Daawaat Allahuma Ya Farej Al Hemi Ya Kashif Al Hem Ya Mojeeb Daawet Almodatareen La Yakhfa Aleika Shayeaun Min Amrina Nasaluka Ya Rabbana Masalet Al Masakeen Wa Nabtahelu Ilayka Ya Rabbana Ibtihaal Al Khaadea Al Mothneb Al Thaleel. Allahuma Nadoukha duaa Min Khadaiet Laka Raqabtu Wa Thalala Laka Jismahu Wa Raghima Laka Anfah Wa Faadaat Laka Yainah Ya Men Yojeeb Al Modtar Itha Daah Ya Men Yojeeb Al Modtar Itha Daah Ya Men Yojeeb Al Modtar Itha Daah Wa Yakshif Al Sooia Aanmen Nadaah
en: Oh Fulfiller of All needs, fulfil my needs and all my duas. Oh Allah the Resolver of all issues, overcome my sadness and misery. You are the One that answers All those needs and prayers. O Allah, to You we lovingly submit; and in You we believe; and upon You do we rely.

ar: يا ربنا إجعل خير أعمارنا آخرها، وخير أعمالنا خواتيمها، وخير أيامنا يوم أن نلقاك، وإغننا بفضلك عمن سواك.  اللهم أرزقنا شفاعتة سيدنا محمد عليه أفضل الصلاة والسلام، وأوردنا حوضه، وأسقنا من يده الشريفة شربة هنيئة لا نظمأ بعدها أبدا
latin: Ya Rabbana Ajaal Khaira Aamaarina Akheraha Wa Khaira Aamaalena Khawatimeha Wa Khaira Ayamina Yaum An Nalqaak Wa Aghnina Bifadlika Aamen Seewaak. Allahuma Arzoqna Shafaata Sayedena Mohammedan Alihee Afdel Al Salaati Wal Sallam Wa Auridna Haoudah Wa Asqina Min Yadehi Al Shareefati Shorbatan Haneyatan La Nathmaoi Baadaha Aabada
en: O Allah, allow us to pass away with sound faith, and in a state in which You are pleased with us and O Allah, bestow on us the gift of seeing Your Noble Countenance and make me independent of all those besides You. Oh Allah suffice us with the blessing of our beloved Prophet Mohammed (peace be upon him) and allow us to drink from his hands

ar: اللهم كما آمنا به ولم نره فلا تفرق بيننا وبينه حتى تدخلنا مدخله.  اللهم أجزه عنا خير ما جزيت به نبيا عن قومه، ورسولا عن أمته، برحمتك يا أرحم الراحمين. اللهم كما بلغتنا رمضان، نسألك يا الله أن تجعلنا ممن وفق لقيام ليلة القدر، وأن تجعلنا ممن وفق لقيام ليلة القدر، وأن تجعلنا ممن وفق لقيام ليلة القدر. اللهم أرزقنا خيرها، وعفوها، وكرمها وفضلها، يا الله، يا الله، يا الله. ربي إني طرقت بابك فإفتح لي أبواب سمواتك، وأجرني من عظيم بلائك
latin: Allahuma Kama Aamana Behe Wa Lem Narah Fala Tofarqu Baynana Wa Baynahu Hata Tadkhilna Modkhalah. Allahum Ijizihi Anna Khaira Ma Jazayta Bihe Nabeena Aan Qaumih Wa Rasoulan Aan Ommateh Bi Rahmatika Ya Arham Al Rahemeen. Allahum Kama Balaghtana Ramadaan Nasaluka Ya Allah An Tajaluna Minman Waqofa Leqeyaami Laylet Al Qadr Wa Tajaluna Minman Woqifa Leqeyaami Layletil Qadr Tajalana Minman Waqafa Leqeyaam Layletil Qadr. Allahum Arzoqna Khairaha Wa Afwaha Wa Karamaha Wa Fadlaha Ya Allah Ya Allah Ya Allah. Rabbi Innee Taraqtu Babik Fa Aftah Lee Abwaaba Samawatik Wa Ajernee Min Atheem Balaaik
en: Oh Allah as we believed in Him(Prophet Mohammed PBUH) without seeing Him, do not separate us and allow us to enter His entrance (Jannah).  Oh Allah as you have given us to chance to be present in Ramadan, grant us the reward for Laylat Al Qadr (Night of Decree). Oh Allah grant us all its blessings and forgive us. Oh Allah I plee for all the goodness and guidance from You.

nama: Dua Khatem Al Quran / Completion of  Holy Quran
ar: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْنِي بالقُرْءَانِ وَاجْعَلهُ لِي إِمَاماً وَنُوراً وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً اللَّهُمَّ ذَكِّرْنِي مِنْهُ مَانَسِيتُ وَعَلِّمْنِي مِنْهُ مَاجَهِلْتُ وَارْزُقْنِي تِلاَوَتَهُ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَأَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ وَاجْعَلْهُ لِي حُجَّةً يَارَبَّ العَالَمِينَ
latin: Allahum Arhamnee Bil Quran Wa Ajaalhu Li Imaama Wa Nooran Wa Hudaa Wa Rahmah Allahum Thakernee Minhu Ma Nosiyt Wa Allemnee Minhu Ma Jahelt Wa Arzoqnee Telaawatahu Anaae Allay Wa Atraaf Al Nahaar Wa Ajaalhu Li Hujaten Ya Rab Al Aalameen
en: Oh Allah bestow mercy on me through the Quran and allow it to be a guide, light and mercy. Oh Allah allow me to remember from it what I have forgotten, teach me what I do not know and grant me its recital during the night and day.

nama: Dua Khatem Al Quran / Completion of  Holy Quran
ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي، وَاجْعَلِ الحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ وَاجْعَلِ المَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرّ
latin: Allahum Asleh Li Deenee Allathee Huwa Ismatu Amry Wa Asleh Li Dunyaaya Allatee Feehaa Maashee Wa Asleh Le Aakheratee Allatee Feeha Meaadee Wa Aajal Al Hayata Zeyadatan Lee Fi Kul Khair Wa Ajaal Al Mouta Rahatan Lee Men Kul Shaar
en: O Allah, rectify for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs, and rectify for me the affairs of this world wherein is my sustenance, and rectify for me my Hereafter to which is my return, and make life for me an increase for every good, and make death a relief for me from every evil.

nama: Dua Khatem Al Quran / Completion of  Holy Quran
ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ المَسْأَلةِ وَخَيْرَ الدُّعَاءِ وَخَيْرَ النَّجَاحِ وَخَيْرَ العِلْمِ وَخَيْرَ العَمَلِ وَخَيْرَ الثَّوَابِ وَخَيْرَ الحَيَاةِ وَخيْرَ المَمَاتِ وَثَبِّتْنِي وَثَقِّلْ مَوَازِينِي وَحَقِّقْ إِيمَانِي وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتِي وَتَقَبَّلْ صَلاَتِي وَاغْفِرْ خَطِيئَاتِي وَأَسْأَلُكَ العُلَا مِنَ الجَنَّةِ
latin: Allahuma Innee Asalouka Khairal Moasallah Wa Khairal Duaa Wa Khaira Al Najaah Wa Khaira Al Illemi Wa Khaira Al Aamal Wa Khaira Al Thawaabi Wa Khair Al Hayati Wa Khaira Al Mamaat Wa Thabetnee Wa Thaqel Mawazeenee Wa Haqiq Emaanee Wa Arfaa Darajaatee Wa Taqabel Salaatee Wa Aghfer Khateaatee Wa Asalouka Al Oulaa Min Al Jannah
en: Oh Allah I ask you for the good of all matters, the goodness of all duas, the best success, the best knowledge, best life and best ending. Oh Allah make my good deeds scale heavy, grant my wishes, elevate me, accept my prayers and forgive my mistakes and I ask You the highest ranks of Jannah (heaven)

nama: Dua Khatem Al Quran / Completion of  Holy Quran
ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مُوجِبَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَعَزَائِمِ مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَالسَّلاَمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ إِثْمٍ وَالغَنِيمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ بِرٍّ وَالفَوْزَ بِالجَنَّةِ وَالنَّجَاةَ مِنَ النَّارِ
latin: Allahuma Innee Asalouka Mojebaat Rahmatik Wa Aazaaema Maghferatik Walsalaamata Min Kuli Ithem Wal Ghaneemata Min Kul Ber Wal Fouza Bil Jannah Wal Najaata Mina Al Naar
en: Oh Allah I beg You for that which incites Your Mercy and the means of Your forgiveness, safety from every sin, the benefit from every good deed, success in attaining Jannah (heaven) and deliverance from fire

nama: Dua Khatem Al Quran / Completion of  Holy Quran
ar: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَدَعْ لَنَا ذَنْبًا إِلَّا غَفَرْتَهُ وَلَا هَمَّا إِلَّا فَرَّجْتَهُ وَلَا دَيْنًا إِلَّا قَضَيْتَهُ وَلَا حَاجَةً مِنْ حَوَائِجِ الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ إِلَّا قَضَيْتَهَا يَاأَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
latin: Allahuma La Tadea Lana Thanbaan Illa Ghafartah Wa La Haamen Illa Farajtah Wa La Daynaan Illa Qadaytahu Wa La Haajatan Men Hawaeji Al Dunya Wal Akhirah Illa Qadaytaha Ya Arhem Al Rahemeen
en: Oh Allah I ask You not to leave any sin of mine but You forgive it, or any distress but You relieve it, or any need that is pleasing to You but You meet it or anything from this world or the afterlife you grant me oh Most Merciful

nama: Dua Khatem Al Quran / Completion of  Holy Quran
ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ الأَخْيَارِ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمًا كَثِيراً
latin: Rabbana Aatena Fil Dunya Hasanatan Wa Fil Akhirati Hasanatan Wa Qenna Athaaba Al Naar Wa Sallee Allahuma Wa Salem Ala Sayedina Wa Nabeena Mohammed Wa Ala Allhe Wa Ashaabehee AlaKhayaar Wa Salem Tasleemaan Katheera
en: Our Lord, grant us the good things in this world and the good things in the next life and save us from the punishment of the Fire. And send lots of Peace and Blessings on our Beloved Prophet Mohammed and his companions

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اَمْدِد في عُمر ابي بالصِحَّة و العافِيَة في طاعَتِكَ و رِضاك
latin: Allahuma Amdid Fi Omri Abbi Bil Sahati Wal Aafeeyah Fi Taatika Wa Ridaak
en: O Allah extend  my fathers life with health and wellness in your obidience and satisfaction

ar: اللهُمَّ ارزُق ابي الصِحَّة و العافِيَة
latin: Allahuma Arziq Abbi Al Sahati Wal Afeeyah
en: Oh Allah grant my father good health and wellness

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلَه مِنَ الذاكِرينَ لَكَ و الشاكِرينَ لَك
latin: Allahuma Ajaalhu Mena Al Thakeereena Lak Wal Shakeereena Lak
en: O Allah Make him from those that remember You and are always thankful to You

ar: اللَّهُمَّ لا تَجْعَل له ذَنْباً اِلا غَفَرْتُه و لا هَمَّاً اِلّا فَرَّجْتُه ,اللَّهُمَّ و لا تَجعَل لَه حاجَة عِند اَحَد غَيْرِكَ
latin: Allahuma La Tajaal Lahu Thanbaan Illa Ghafartah Wa La Hamman Illa Farajtah, Allahuma Wa La Tajaal Lahu Hajaten Inda Ahaadin Ghayrek
en: Oh Allah, Please forgive his sins, and do not bestow sadness unless You have made it easy with Your mercy, O Allah do not make anything for him with anyone else but You.

ar: اللَّهُمَّ مُصرف القُلوب صَرِّف قَلْبَه على طاعَتِكَ
latin: Allahuma Mosrifa Al Qoloob Sarif Qalbahu Ala Taaatik
en: Oh Allah, the One that clears our hearts, clear his heart and guide it to Your obidience

ar: اللَّهُمَّ  ارحَم ابي بالقُرآن و اجْعَلَهُ لها نوراً و هُدىً و رَحْمَةً
latin: Allahuma Arhim Abbi Bil Quran Wa Ajaalahu Lahu Nooraan Wa Hudan Wa Rahmah
en: O Allah have mercy on my father with the Quran and make it for him a source of light, guidance, and mercy

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَل القُرآنَ العَظيم ربيع قَلبَه و شِفاء صَدرَه و نوراً لِبَصَرِه
latin: Allahuma Ajaal Al Quran Al Atheema Rabeeaa Qalbeh Wa Shefaa Sadrah Wa Nooran LiBasarih
en: O Allah make the great Quran the spring and essence of his heart and heal his chest and light for his sight

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اشْغِل قَلْبَه بُحُبِّكَ و لِسانَه بِذِكْرِكَ وَ بَدَنَه بِطاعَتِكَ
latin: Allahuma Ashghil Qalbahu Bihubek Wa Lisaanahu Bi Thikrek Wa Bedanahu Bitaatek
en: O Allah fill his heart with love for You and his tongue with remembrance to You and his body to Your obedience

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِر لَه ذَنْبَه ووسَّع له في دارِه و بارِك لَه في رِزْقِه
latin: Allahuma Aghfer lahu Thanbah Wa waseaa Lahu Fi Darih Wa Barik Lahu Fi Rizqeh
en: O Allah Forgive his sins and expand his sustenance in his home and bless him in his livelihood

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِه بِحلالِك عن حَرامِك و اغنه بِفَضْلِك عَمَّن سِواك
latin: Allahuma Akfehe Bi Halalika Aan Haraamik Wa Aghninhe Befadlika Aamen Sewaak
en: Oh Allah wrap him with Your Halal rather than the Haram and help only to rely on You

ar: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُق ابي الجَنَّة و ماقَرُبَ اِلَيْها مِن قَوْل وَ عَمَل و باعِد بَيْنَه و بَيْن النار و ما قَرُب اِليها  مِن قَوْل و عَمَل
latin: Allahum Arziq Abbi Al Jannata Wa Ma Qaraba Ilayhe Min Qawellin Wa Aamal Wa Baed Baynahu Wa Bayna Al Naar Wa Ma Qaraba Ilayha Min Qawellin Wa Aamal
en: Oh Allah grant my father Heaven and whatever is near to it in his words and actions and keep him away from hellfire

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدي ابي فَيْمَن هَدَيْت و عافِه فيمَن عافَيْت
latin: Allahuma Ahdey Abbi Fiman Hadayt Wa Aafehe Fiman Aafeyt
en: Oh Allah reward my father like those you have rewarded and relieve him from any grief

ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَفِّق ابي لِهُداك و اجْعَل عَمَلَه في رِضاك
latin: Allahum Wafiq Abbi Lehudaak Wa Ajaal Aamalahu Fi Redaak
en: Oh Allah grant my father success and guidance and make him do what pleases you

ar: اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّل تَوْبَتَه وَ اَجِب دَعْوَتَه
latin: Allahuma Taqabel Tawbatah Wa Ajeb Daawatah
en: Oh Allah accept his repentance and accept all his duas (prayers)

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اَعِنّي عَلى بِرَّه حَتى يرضى عَنّي
latin: Allahuma Aeinny Ala Berrahu Hatta Yardaa Anney
en: Oh Allah help me be a good, righteous and obedient child until he is pleased with me

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَل لَه في قَلْبَه نوراً في لِسانِه نوراً وَ في سَمْعِه نوراً  و في بَصَرِه نوراً وَ مِن تَحتِه نوراً وَ عَن يَمينه نوراً، عَن شِمالِه نوراً وَ مِن بَيْنَ يَدَيْه نوراً وَ مِن خَلفَه نوراً
latin: Allahuma Ajaal lahu Fi Qalbihe Noora Wa Fi Lisaanihe Noora Wa Fi Samihe Noora Wa Fi Basarihe Nooran Wa Men Tahtihe Noora Wa Aan Yameenihe Noora Wa An Shemaalihe Noora Wa Men Bayn Yadayhe Nooran Wa Men Khalfihe Noora
en: Oh Allah grant light in his heart, light his speech, light his hearing, light in his sight, give his light from his right and left and light between his hands as well as surround his with light all around him

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اِنّي اَسْتَوْدِعَك اَثْمَن ما عِنْدي وَ أقرَبْها اِلى قَلبي. اللَّهُمَّ اِحْفَظ لي ابي وَ اَنْتَ خَيْرُ الحافِظين
latin: Allahum Ini AIstaudaouka Athman Me Indiy Wa Aqrabohu Illa Qalbee. Allahuma Ihfadh Li Abbi Wa Anta Khairul Hafedeen
en: Oh Allah I give You the most precious thing to me to protect and watch over. Oh Allah protect my father as you are the best of all Protectors

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اسْعِد قَلب ابي و اشرَح صَدْرَه و اَرِح قَلبَه و اَبْعِد عَنه كُل ما يُحْزِنُه وَ أَطِل عُمْرَه
latin: Allahum Asaad Qalba Abbi Wa Ashreh Sadrah Wa Areh Qalbah Wa Abid Anhu Kula Ma Yohzinhu Wa Atil Omrah
en: Oh Allah grant my father happiness and grant him ease in his chest and do not allow any sadness to bestow him and prolong his life

ar: اللَّهُمَّ ابْعِد عَنْه المَرَض و ارْزُقهْ طولة العُمْر في طاعَتِك
latin: Allahuma Abid Anhu Al Mared Wa Arziqhu Tollal Al Omer Fi Taetik
en: Oh Allah do not bestow sickness on my father and grant him a long life in your obedience

ar: اللَّهُمّ انّا نَحْمِدُكَ و نَستعينَك و نستهديك و نستغفرك و نتوب اليكَ و نَثْني عليكَ الخَيْرَ كُله نشكُرُكَ و لا نَكفُر بكَ و نَتْرُك مَن يَهْجُرُكَ اللَّهُمّ اِيّاكَ نَعْبُد  و لَكَ نُصَلِّي و نَسْجُد و اِلَيْكَ نَسْعى و نَحْمِد نَرْجو رَحمَتَكَ و نَخْشى عذابَك اللَّهُمّ لَكَ الحَمْد كُله و الشُكر كُله و اِليْكَ يَرْجَع الاَمْرُ كُلُّه علانِيَّتَه و سِرُّه  فأهْل أَنْتَ أن تُحْمَد و أهل أنْتَ أن تُعْبَد و أنْتَ على كُل شَئٍ قَدير اللَّهُمّ لَكَ الحَمْد حتى تَرْضى و لَكَ الحَمْد اِذا رَضَيْت وَ لَكَ الحَمْد كاللذينَ قالوا خَيْراً مِمّا نَقول و لَكَ الحَمْد كالذي تَقول وَ لَكَ الحَمْد على كُل حال اللَّهُمّ لَكَ الحَمد أَنْتَ نورُ السَّماواتِ و الأَرْضِ و أنْتَ بِكُلِّ شَئٍ عَليم
latin: Allahuma Inna Nahmaduka Wa Nastainuka Wa Nastahdeka Wa Nastaghfiruk Wa Natobu Illayk Wa Nothnee Alieka Al Khaira Kulah Nashkurika Wa La Nakfuru Bik Wa Natruku Min Yahjurik Allahuma Ayaaka Nabud Wa Laka Nusalley Wa Nasjud Wa Illaka Nasaa Wa Nahmed Narjoo Rahmataka Wa Nakhsha Athabak Allahuma Laka Al Hamd Kullah Wal Shukeru Kulluh Wa Illayka Yorjaa Alameri Kulloh Alaneyatahu Wa Sirrah Fahellun Anta An 'Tohmed Wa Ahel Anta Alla Kullu Shayin Qadeer Allahuma Laka AlHamid Hata Tarda Walaka Alhamd Kalatheena Qaaoloo Khairan Minma Naqool Walaka Alhamdu Kallathee Taqool Walaka Alhamdu Ala Kul Haal Allahuma Laka Alhamd Anta Nooru Alsamawaatee Wal Arrd Wa Anta Bikuli Shayin Aleem
en: Oh Allah we thank You and we ask you for help, guidance and forgiveness. My blessings are all due to You so we Thank You and not disobey You. Oh Allah we will not worship other than You, we pray to You and prostrate to You and All Gratitude is to You and Praise You alone. We plead for Your Mercy and fear your punishments. Oh Allah all thanks to You until you see us worthy and Always Thank You and Praise You for everything in our lives. Oh Allah Gratitude to the one that is the light of the skies and earth and you are the All knowing.

ar: الحَمْدُلله رَبِّ العالمين خَلَقَ اللَّوْح و القَلَم وَخَلَقَ الخَلْقَ  مِن عَدَم و دَبِّر الأَرْزاق و الآجال بالمَقادير و حُكْم  و جَمِّل اللَّيْلَ بالنُجومِ في الظُلُم
latin: Al Hamd Allahi Rabbi Al Alameen Khaliq Al Lawh Walqalem Wa Khaleqa Al Khaleq Min Adem Wa Dabera Al Arzaaqa Wal Ajaal Bil Maqadeer Wa Hakema Wa Jamala Allayla Fil Thulaam
en: Praise be to God, Lord of the Worlds. The creator of the preserved Tablet and Pen And Created humans from clay and Provided everything for them with reason and justice. Allah has beautified the dark nights with shining stars

ar: الحَمْدُلله رَبِّ العالَمين ... رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي ۖ إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
latin: Al Hamed Allahi Rab Al Alameen Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'mataka allatee anAAamta AAalay waAAalawalidayy waan aAAmala saliha tardah waaslih lee fee thurriyyatee innee tubtuilayk wa innee mina almuslimeen
en: My Lord! Arouse me that I may give thanks for the favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and that I may do right acceptable unto Thee. And be gracious unto me in the matter of my seed. Lo! I have turned unto Thee repentant, and lo! I am of those who surrender (unto Thee)

ar: الحَمْدُلله رَبِّ العالَمين .. حَمْداً لِشُكْرهِ أداءاً و لِحَقِّهِ قَضاءاً .. وَ لِحُبِّهِ رَجاءاً وَ لِفَضْلِهِ نَماءاً.. وَ لِثَوْبِهِ عَطا
latin: Al Hamd Allah Rab Al Alameen. Hamdaan Lishukrahe Adaa Wa Lihaqhe Qadaa Wa Lihubihi Rajaa Wa Li Fadlihi Namaa Wa Li Thawubehi Atta
en: All praise be to Allah the lord of the world Gratification and thanks to his doings and we plead for his love and thank him for his virtues and all he has provided us with

ar: سُبْحانَك يا رَب..لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدَ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ، ولَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ العَلِيِّ الْعَظيِمِ، ربِّ اغْفِرلِي
