latin: Subhanaka Ya Rab Laa 'illaha 'illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulk wa lahul-hamd, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer Subhaanallah, walhamdu lillaah, wa laa 'ilaha 'illallah, wallaahu 'akbar, wa laa hawla wa laa Quwwata 'illaa billaahil-'Aliyyil-'Adheem, Rabbighfir lee
en: There is none worth of worship but Allah alone, Who has no partner, His is the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is able to do all things. Glory is to Allah. Praise is to Allah. There is none worth of worship but Allah. Allah is the Most Great. There is no might and no power except by Allah's leave, the Exalted, the Mighty. My Lord, forgive me.

ar: سُبْحانَ الله و بِحَمْدِهِ .. سُبْحانَ اللَّهُ العَظيم
latin: Subhan Allah Wa Bihamdeh Subhan Allah Al Atheem
en: Glory to my Lord the Exalted and All Mighty

ar: الحَمْدُلله رَبِّ العالَمين .. صاحِب العَظَمَة و الكِبْرِياء .. يَعْلَمُ ما في البَطْنِ وَ الأحْشاءِ .. فَرَّقَ بَيْن العُروق و الأَمْعاء .. فَسُبْحانَك يارَب الأرْضِ و السماءِ
latin: Al Hamd Allah Rab Al Alameen  Sahib Al Athamati Wal Kibriyaa Yaalemu Ma Fi Al Baten Wal Ahshaa Faraqa Bayna Al  Arrooqi Wal Amaa Fa Subhanaka Ya Rab Al Aredi Wal Sama
en: All praise be to Allah the lord of the world  the  Magnificent and Supreme . He knows what is beneath and inside everything and can distingush even what is hidenGlory to my Lord the Exalted and All Mighty the Creator of the Earth and the Sky

ar: الحَمْدُلله رَبِّ العالَمين .. يُحِب مَن دعاهُ خَفِيَّاً .. وَ يُجيبُ مَن ناداهُ نَجِيَّاً .. و يُزيدُ مَن كانَ حَيِيَّاً .. وَ يَكْرِم مَن كانَ لَهُ وَ فِيَّاً.. وَ يَهْدي مَن كانَ صادِق الوَعْد رَضِيَّاً
latin: Al Hamd Allah Rab Al Alameen   Yuhebu Men Daahu Khafeea Wa Yajeebu Men Nadahu Najeeya Wa Yozeedu Men Kana Hayaa Wa Yakremu Men Kaana Lahu Wafeeya Wa Yahdee Men Kaana Sadeqan Al Waadi Radeyaa
en: All praise be to Allah the lord of the world He loves the one who asks from Him and He Responds to those that plee to Him  and he will Honor and grant the ones that are Loyal to Him and He Guides the trustworth

ar: الحَمْدُلله رَبِّ العالَمين..رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
latin: Al Hamed Allahi Rab Al Aalameen Rabbi awziAAnee an ashkura niAAmataka allateean AAamta AAalayya waAAala walidayya waan aAAmala salihan tardah wa adkhilnee birahmatika fee Aaibadika assaliheen
en: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds. My Lord, arouse me to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and to do good that shall be pleasing unto Thee, and include me in (the number of) Thy righteous slaves

ar: الحَمْدُلله رَبِّ العالَمين.. الذي جَعَلَ لِكُلِّ شَئٍ قَدَراً.. وَجَعَلَ لِكُلِّ قَدَرِ أَجَلا.. وَ جَعَلَ لِكُلِّ أَجَلِ كِتاباً
latin: Al Hamed Allahi Rab Al Aalameen Allathi Jaala Lekuli Shayin Qadara Wa Jaala Likul Qadarin Ajalaa Wa Jaala Likul Ajalin Ketaba
en: All Praise to Allah (SWT) lord of the Worlds, He who made everything a destiny/fate and made every destiny/fate a term And He created everything to be written

ar: سُبْحانَ الله و الحَمْدُلله .. و لا اِلَهَ الا الله .. و اللهُ اَكْبَرَ.. و اللَّهُ اَكْبَرَ و لا حَوْلَ ولا قُوَّةَ اِلّا بالله العَلِيّ العَظيم
latin: Subhaanallaah walhamdul Ilaha Wa la Illah Illa Allah Wa Allahu Akbar Wa Allahu Akbar Wa La Hawlla Wa La Quwaat Illa Billah Al Allay Al Atheem
en: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him ad there is No god but Allah and Allah is the Greatest Allah is the Greatest Allah is the Greatest. There is No power or Strength other than Allah The Most High The Most Magnificent

ar: سُبُّوحٌ، قُدُوسٌ، رَبُّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
latin: Subboohun, Quddoosun, Rabbul-malaa'ikati warrooh
en: Glory (to You) , Most Holy (are You) , Lord of the angels and the Spirit.

ar: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ، وَالْمَلَكُوتِ، وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَالْعَظَمَةِ
latin: Subhaana thil-jabarooti, walmalakooti, walkibriyaa'i, wal'adhamah
en: Glory is to You, Master of power, of dominion, of majesty and greatness.

ar: الْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لَا كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلَا مُؤْويَ
latin: Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee 'at'amanaa wa saqaanaa, wa kafaanaa, wa 'aawaanaa, fakam mimman laa kaafiya lahu wa laa mu'wa
en: Praise is to Allah Who has provided us with food and with drink, sufficed us and gave us an abode for how many are there with no provision and no home.

ar: الْحَمْـدُ للهِ حَمْـداً كَثـيراً طَيِّـباً مُبـارَكاً فيه، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلا مُوَدَّعٍ وَلا مُسْتَغْـنىً عَنْـهُ رَبُّـنا
latin: Alhamdu lillahi hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubarakan feeh, ghayra makfiyyin wala muwaddaAAin, wala mustaghnan AAanhu rabbuna
en: Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise, a never-ending praise, a praise which we will never bid farewell to and an indispensable praise, He is our Lord.

ar: رَبِّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
latin: Rabbi Ainnie Ala Thikrika Wa Shukrika Wa Husen Ibaadatik
en: My Lord, help me to remember You, give thanks to You and worship You well

ar: اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ ، اللهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ
latin: Allahuma Aghfir Lah Allahuma Thabit
en: O'Allah Forgive him, O'Allah    stablise him

ar: اللهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِن عَذَابِ القَبْر
latin: Allahuma  A'ithhu min Aathab Al-kabir
en: O'Allah  protect him from the punishment of the grave

ar: اللهُمَّ اجْعَلهُ لَهُ فَرَطًا وسَلفًا وأجْرًا
latin: Allahum Ajilhu Lahu firtan Wa Salafan Wa Ajraan
en: O’ Allah Make him a preceding reward, a prepayment, and a recompense for us.

nama: Dua for placing the Deceased in the Grave
ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ وعَلَى سُنَّة رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَليهِ وَسَلَّم
latin: Bismallah Wa Aala Sunnati Rasooli Allah Salaa Allahu Alaihi Wa Salam
en: In the Name of Allah and Upon the Sunnah the Messenger of Allah

ar: إنَّ لِلَّه مَا أخَذَ ، وَلَهُ مَا أعْطَى ، وَكُلُّ شَيء عِندَهُ ِأجَل مُسَمَّى ، فلْتَصْبِر وَلْتَحْتَسِب
latin: Inna Lillahi Maa Akhath waa lahu maa a'ataa Wa Kulu Shayin Indahu Ajailon musama faltosbir Wal tahtesib
en: Definitely Allah has taken what belongs to him. He has given us what belongs to him. He has stipulated a time for everyone so have patience and hope for reward.

ar: أَعْظَمَ اللهُ أَجْرَك ،وَأحْسَنَ عَزَاءَك ، وَغَفَر لِمَيتكَ
latin: Atham Allahu Ajrak Wa Ahsana Azaak Wa Ghafara  Limay-yatik
en: May Allah magnify your reward, Make better your solace and forgive your deceased.

nama: Dua for Deceased at the Funeral
ar: اللهُمّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وارْحَمْهُ ، وَعَافِهِ واعْفُ عَنْهُ ، وَأكْرِمْ نُزُلَه ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدخَلهُ ، واغْسِلْهُ بالمَاءِ والثَّلْجِ والبَردِ ، ونَقِهِ مِنَ الخَطايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوبَ الأبْيضَ من الدَّنسِ ، وأَبْدِلْهُ دَارًا خَيْرًا مِن دَارِه ، وأهلًا خيرًا من أهلِهِ  وزَوْجًا خَيرًا مِن زَوْجِهِ ، وأَدْخِلْهُ الجَنَّةَ ، وأَعِذْهُ مِن عذابِ القَبْرِ   وَعَذابِ النَّار
latin: Allahuma aghfir lahu wa irhamh wa aafihi wa ifu anh wa akrem nozlah wa wasia madkhalh wa ighsilh  bil maai wal thalaji wal bard wa nakehi mina alkhataya kama nakayita al thoba al abyad min al dans wa abdlhu daaran khayran min darih wa ahlan kheiran min ahlh wa zojan kheiran min zojih wa idkhilhu aljannata wa aithhu min athab alkabari wa athab al naar
en: O’ Allah forgive and have mercy upon him excuse him and pardon him and make honourable his reception. Expand his entry and cleanse him with water, snow and ice and purify him of sin as a white robe is purified of filth. Exchange his home for a better home, and his family for a better family, and his spouse for a better spouse. Admit him into Jannah and protect him from the punishment of the grave and the torment of the hell fire.

ar: اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا ، وشَاهِدِنَا ، وغَائِبِنَا ، وصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا ، وذَكَرِنَا وأُنْثَانَا اللهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْييتَهُ مِنَّا فأحْيِهِ عَلَى الإِسْلامِ ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيتَه مِنَّا فَتَوفَّهُ على الإيمَانِ ، اللهُمَّ لا تَحْرِمْنَا أجْرَهُ ،ولَا تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَه .
latin: Allahuma aghfir li hayana   wa maitna wa shahedena wa ghaibna wa saghirana wa kabirana wa thakarana wa unthana. Allahuma man ahyytahu minaa fa ihyee ala al Islam Wa man twafaytuhu minaa ftwafahu alaa al iman . Allahum laa tahrimna ajrah wa la todilna badh
en: O' Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those  absent, our young and our old, our males and our females . O'Allah, whom amongst us You keep alive, then let such a life be upon Islam and whom amongst us  you take unto yourself, then let such a death be upon faith. O'Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not let us stray after him

ar: اللهُمَّ إنَّ فُلانَ بنَ فُلان فِي ذِمَّتِكَ ، وحَبْلِ جِوارِكَ ، فَقِه مِن فِتْنَةِ القَبْرِ وَعَذابِ النَّارِ ، وأنْتَ أهْلُ الوفاءِ والحقِّ ، فاغْفرْ لَهُ وارْحَمْهُ ، إنَّكَ أنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحِيْم
latin: Allahum inna flaan ibin Flaan (name person) fi thimatik, wa habil jiwarik, fakihi min fitnti al-kabir wa athaab al-naar, wa inta ahlu al-wafaawa alhaak, faghfir lahu wa arhamhu, innaka inta al-Ghafoor al -Rahim.
en: O’ Allah, So and so (name person) is under Your care and protection so protect him from the trial of the grave and torment of the Hell fire. Indeed you are faithful and truthful. Forgive and have Mercy upon him, Surely You are The Oft-Forgiving, The Most Merciful.

nama: Dua when Visiting Deceased at Grave
ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أهْل الدِّيار ، مِنَ المُؤْمِنِينَ والمُسْلِمينَ ، وإنَّا إنْ شَاءَ اللهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُون  ويَرحَمُ الله المُسْتقدِمينَ مِنَّا والمُسْتأخِرِي أسْألُ اللهَ لَنَا ولَكُمُ العَافِيَة
latin: Al- salam Alaykum Ahal Al- Diyaar min Al-mu’minin wa Al- Muslimeen Wa Inna inshallah bikum La hikoon Wa yarhamu allah al Mustakdemeen minna wa Al-musta’khirin As’aal Allah Lana Wa Lakum Al Aafiya.
en: Peace be upon you all, O’ inhabitants of the graves, amongst the believers and the Muslims. Verily we ask Allah for Well-being for us and for you.

nama: Dua when Visiting Deceased at Grave
ar: اللهُمَّ عَبْدُك وابنُ أَمَتِكَ ، احْتَاجَ إلى رَحْمَتِكَ ، وأنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ ، إنْ كَانَ مُحسنًا فَزِدْ فِي حَسناتِه ، وإنْ كَانَ مُسِيئًا فَتَجَاوزْ عَنْه
latin: Allahum abduk Wa ibin Amatak, ahtaaja ilaa rahmatika wa inta Ghani aan athaabih, Inn Kanna muhsinan fazed fi Hasanatih, Wa in Kanna musiaan fatajawaz Anh
en: O’ Allah, Your servant and the son of your servant is in need of Your Mercy and Your are without need of his punishment. If he was righteous then increase his reward and if he was wicked then look over his sins.

nama: Dua when closing the eyes of the Deceased
ar: اللهُمَّ اغْفِر لِفُلان (باسمه ) وارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهديينَ ، واخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِه فِي الْغابِرينَ ، واغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَاربَّ العَالمِينَ ، وافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ ، ونَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ
latin: Allahum Aghfir Li folan ( Name the person) wa Arfaa darajaathu fi Al-muhdi’een Wa Akhlifhu fi Aqibihii fi Al-ghaabireen, Wa Aghfir Lana wa Lahu Ya Raab Al-Alameen Wa Afsih Lahu fi Gabrihi Wa nauo’ir Lahu Fih
en: O’Allah, Forgive (Give name of Deceased) and raise his rank among the rightly guided, and be a successor to whom he left behind, and forgive us and him O’ Lord of the worlds, make his grave spacious and illuminated for him.

ar: أَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ. اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاواتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
latin: Allahu laaa ilaaha illaa huwal haiyul qai-yoom laa taakhuzuhoo sinatunw wa laa nawm; lahoo maa fissamaawaati wa maa fil ard man zallazee yashfa’u indahooo illaa be iznih ya’lamu maa baina aideehim wa maa khalfahum wa laa yuheetoona beshai ‘immin ‘ilmihee illa be maa sha  wasi’a kursiyyuhus samaa waati wal arda wa la ya’ooduho hifzuhumaa wa huwal aliyyul ‘azeem
en: Allah! There is no deity save Him, the Alive, the Eternal. Neither slumber nor sleep overtaketh Him. Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Who is he that intercedeth with Him save by His leave? He knoweth that which is in front of them and that which is behind them, while they encompass nothing of His knowledge save what He will. His throne includeth the heavens and the earth, and He is never weary of preserving them. He is the Sublime, the Tremendous

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ 1 ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ 2 لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ 3. وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَد 4
latin: Bismillah Al Rahman Al Raheem, Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad (1)Allahhu-Assamad(2) Lam Yalid Wa Lam Yoolad (3) Wa Lam YaKon Lahoo Kufuwan Ahad(4)
en: In the name of Allah, The Entirely Merciful, The especially Merciful, Say ‘He is Alla (who is) One (1) Alla The Eternal Refuge (2) He neither begets nor is born(3) Nor is there to Him any equivalent (4)

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ 1مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَق َ2 وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ3. وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ 4 وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ5
latin: Bismillah Al Rahman Al Raheem, Qul A’ootho Bi Rabbil Falaq(1) Min Sharri Ma Khalaq(2) Wa Min Sharri Ghaasiqin Itha Waqab(3) Wa Min Sharrin-Naffaathati Fil Uqad (4)Wa Min Sharri Haasidin Itha Hasad(5)
en: In the name of Allah, The Entirely Merciful, The Especially Merciful, Say I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak(1)From the evil of that which He created (2) And from the evil of darkness when it settles (3) And from the evil of blowers in knots (4)And from the evil of an envier when he envies(5)

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ. قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ1 مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ2 إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ3. مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ4 ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ5 مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ6
latin: Bismillah Al Rahman Al Raheen, Qul Autho Birab Al Nas(1) Malik Al Nas(2) Illahi Al Nas(3)Min Sharril Waswaasil Khannaas(4)Allathee Yuwaswisu Fee Sudoorin Naas(5) Mena Al Jinnati Wal Naas(6)
en: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, Say I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind(1)The Sovereign of mankind(2)The God of mankind(3)From the evil of the retreating whisperer(4)Who whispers (evil) into the breasts of mankind(5)From among the jinn and mankind(6)

ar: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ ۞ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
latin: 'Aamanar-Rasoolu bimaa 'unzila 'ilayhi mir-Rabbihi walmu'minoon, kullun 'aamana billaahi wa malaa'ikatihi wa Kutubihi wa Rusulihi, laa nufarriqu bayna 'ahadim-mir-Rusulihi, wa qaaloo sami'naa wa 'ata'naa ghufraanaka Rabbanaa wa 'ilaykal-maseer. Laa yukallifullaahu nafsan 'illaa wus'ahaa, lahaa maa kasabat wa 'alayhaa mak-tasabat, Rabbanaa laa tu'aakhithnaa 'in naseenaa 'aw 'akhta'naa, Rabbanaa wa laa tahmil 'alaynaa 'isran kamaa hamaltahu 'alal-latheena min qablinaa, Rabbanaa wa laa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bih, wa'fu 'annaa, waghfir lanaa warhamnaa, 'Anta Mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal-qawmil-kaafireen.
en: The Messenger believes in what has been send down to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. Each one believes in Allah, His Angels, His Books, and His Messengers. They say: "We make no distinction between any of His Messengers," and they say: "We hear, and we obey. (We seek) Your Forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the return." Allah burdens not a person beyond what he can bear. He gets reward for that (good) which he has earned, and he is punished for that (evil) which he has earned. Our Lord! Punish us not if we forget or fall into error. Our Lord! Lay not on us a burden like that which You did lay on those before us. Our Lord! Put not on us a burden greater than we have strength to bear. Pardon us and grant us forgiveness. Have mercy on us. You are our Protector, and help us against the disbelieving people.

ar: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
latin: Bismika Rabbee wadha'tu janbee , wa bika 'arfa'uhu, fa'in 'amsakta nafsee farhamhaa, wa 'in 'arsaltahaa fahfadhhaa, bimaa tahfadhu bihi 'ibaadakas-saaliheen.
en: With Your Name my Lord, I lay myself down ; and with Your Name I rise . And if my soul You take , have mercy on it , and if You send it back then protect it as You protect Your righteous slaves.

ar: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
latin: Allaahumma qinee 'athaabak yawma tab'athu 'ibaadak
en: O Allah, save me from Your punishment on the Day that You resurrect Your slaves.

ar: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
latin: Bismika Allaahumma 'amootu wa 'ahyaa
en: In Your Name , O Allah , I die and I live

ar: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، والْحَمْدُ للهِ، وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ
latin: Subhaanallaah Walhamdu lillaah Wallaahu 'Akbar
en: Glory is to Allah (thirty-three times in Arabic) , praise is to Allah (thirty-three times) , Allah is the Most Great (thirty-four times)

ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنجِيلِ، وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أّنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتهِ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
latin: Allaahumma Rabbas-samaawaatis-sab'i wa Rabbal-'Arshil-'Adheem, Rabbanaa wa Rabba kulli shayee, faaliqal-habbi wannawaa , wa munzilat-Tawraata wal-'Injeeli, wal-Furqaan, 'a'oothu bika min sharri kulli shay 'in 'Anta 'aakhithun binaasiyatih. Allaahumma 'Antal-'Awwalu falaysa qablaka shayee, wa 'Antal-'Aakhiru falaysa ba'daka shayee, wa 'Antadh-Dhaahiru falaysa fawqaka shayee, wa 'Antal-Baatin falaysa doonaka shayee, iqdhi 'annad-dayna wa 'aghninaa minal-faqr
en: O Allah! Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Magnificent Throne . Our Lord and the Lord of everything . Splitter of the grain and the date-stone , Revealer of the Torah and the Injeel and the Furqan (the Qur'an), I seek refuge in You from the evil of everything that You shall seize by the forelock. O Allah You are the First and nothing has come before you, and You are the Last, and nothing may come after You. You are the Most High, nothing is above You and You are the Most Near and nothing is nearer than You. Remove our debts from us and enrich us against poverty

ar: الْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لَا كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلَا مُؤْويَ
latin: Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee 'at'amanaa wa saqaanaa, wa kafaanaa, wa 'aawaanaa, fakam mimman laa kaafiya lahu wa laa mau'wa
en: Praise is to Allah Who has provided us with food and with drink , sufficed us and gave us an abode for how many are there with no provision and no home

ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاواتِ والْأَرْضَ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِكُهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
latin: Allaahumma 'Aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahaadah faatiras-samaawaati wal'ard, Rabba kulli shayin  wa maleekah, 'ash-hadu 'an laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Ant, 'a'oothu bika min sharri nafsee, wa min sharrish-shaytaani wa sharakih, wa 'an 'aqtarifa 'alaa nafsee soo 'an, 'aw 'ajurrahu 'ilaa Muslim
en: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the evident , Maker of the heavens and the earth , Lord of everything and its Master, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship but You . I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his helpers . (I seek refuge in You) from bringing evil upon my soul and from harming any Muslim.

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
latin: If you recites surah Mulk on a daily basis in this world, it protects you from the torment of the grave . Surah Mulk proves as a blessing in a difficult situation. Bismillah hir Rahman nir Raheem Tabaarakal lazee biyadihil mulku wa huwa ‘alaa kulli shai-in Qadeer
en: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent

ar: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وأَغْنِني بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
latin: Allāhumma ik-finī bi ḥalālika ‘an ḣarāmik wa gh-ninī bi faḋlika ‘amman siwāka
en: O Allah! Suffice me with what You have made lawful instead of what You have made unlawful, and make me independent of all others besides You.

ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ، تَوَكَّلْـتُ عَلى اللهِ وَلا حَوْلَ وَلا قُـوَّةَ إِلاّ بِالله
latin: Bismillāh tawakkaltu ‘ala Allāh wa lā ḣawla wa lā quwwata illā bi l-lāh
en: In the name of Allah, I have placed my trust in Allah, and there is no power or might except by Allah.

ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أُرِيْدُ الْعُمْرَةَ فَيَسِّرْهَا لِيْ وَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّيْ
latin: Allāhumma innī urīdu l-‘umrata fa yassirhā lī wa taqabbalhā minnī
en: O Allah, I intend to perform Umrah, so accept it from me and make it easy for me.

ar: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ
latin: Labbayka Allāhumma labbaik, labbaika lā sharīka laka labbaik, inna Al-ḣamda wa n-ni’mata laka wa l-mulk lāsharīka lak
en: I am present! O Allah I am present! There is no associate with You. I am present! All praise and grace is due to You, and the dominion. There is no associate with You

ar: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
latin: Allāhumma Iftaḣ lī abwāba rahmatik
en: O Allah! Open the doors of Your mercy for me.

ar: اللَّهُمَّ زِدْ هَذَا البَيْتَ تَشْريفًا وَتَعْظِيمًا وَتَكْرِيمًا وَمَهَابَةً، وَزِدْ مِن شَرَّفَهُ وكَرمَهُ مِمَّنْ حَجَّه أو اعْتَمَرَه تَشْرِيفًا وَتَكْرِيمًا وَتَعْظِيمًا وَبِرًّا
latin: Allāhumma zid hādha albayti tashrīfan wa ta’thiman wa takrīman wa mahāba, wa zid man sharrafahū wa karramahū mimman ḣajjahū awa’tamarahū tashrīfan wa ta’thiman wa takrīman wa birra
en: O Allah! Increase this House in honour and reverence and nobility and awe, and increase those who honour and revere it as pilgrims for Hajj and Umrah in nobility and goodness and status and righteousness

ar: اللَّهُمَّ أعِنَّيْ عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
latin: Allāhumma a’innī ‘alā dhikrika wa shukrika wa ḣusni ‘ibādatik
en: O Allah! Help me to remember You and thank You and help me to the best manner of worshipping You.

ar: اللّهُمّ إيْمَاناً بِكَ، وَتَصْدِيْقاً بِكِتَابِكَ وَسُنّةِ نَبِيِّكَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
latin: Allāhumma īmānan bika wa taṣdīqan bi kitābik wa sunnati nabiyyika ṣalla l-lāhu ‘alayhi wa sallam
en: O Allah! Out of faith in You, conviction in Your book and Your Prophet’s way.

nama: Dua Between Yemeni Corner & Black Stone
ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
latin: Rabbanā ātinā fi ddunyā ḣasanah wa fil ākhirati ḣasanah wa qinā ‘adhāba n-nāar
en: Our Lord! Grant us success in this life, and success in the next life, and protect us from the Fire

ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلً
latin: Allāhumma innī as’aluka ‘ilman nāfi’a wa rizqan ṭayyiba wa ‘amalan mutaqabbala
en: O Allah! I ask you for beneficial knowledge, and pure sustenance, and accepted actions.

ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
latin: Lā ilāha illa allāhu waḣdahū lā sharīka lah lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-ḣamdu Beyadehe Alkhair Yohyee Wa yemeetu wa huwa ‘alā kulli shay’in qadeer
en: There is no God but Allah alone, with no partner or associate, His is the dominion, to Him all praise is due, all goodness is in His hand, He grants life and death and He has power overall things.

ar: قَبِلَ اللهُ حَجَّكَ وَكَفَّرَ ذَنْبَكَ وَأَخْلَفَ نَفَقَتَكَ
latin: Qabila Allāhu ḣajjaka wa kaffara dhambek wa akhlafa nafaqatak
en: May Allah accept your Hajj, and erase your sins, and replenish your provisions.

ar: اَللهُمَّ هَذَا حَرَمُ نَبِيِّكَ فَاجْعَلْهُ وِقَايَةً لِيْ مِنَ النَّارِ وَآمِنَّا مِنْ الْعَذَابِ وَسُوْءِ الْحِسَابِ
latin: Allāhumma hādhā ḣaramu nabiyyik fa j-‘alhu wiqāyatan lī mina n-nāar wa āminnā mina l-‘adhābi wa sū’i l-ḣisāb
en: O Allah! This is the Sacred Precinct of Your Prophet, so make it a protection for me from the Fire and a security from punishment and a bad reckoning

ar: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
latin: Āyiboon tā’iboon ‘ābidoon li rabbinā ḣāmidoon
en: (We are those) who return, who repent, who worship our Lord, who praise.

ar: قَدَّرَ اللهُ وَما شـاءَ فَعَـل
latin: Qaddarallāhu wa mā shā'a fa`al
en: It is the Decree of Allah and He does whatever He wills

ar: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ اللهُمَّ أْجُرْنِيفِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
latin: Inna Lillah Wa Inna Ilayhi Rajioon, Allahuma Ajerney Fi Mosebati Wakhlef Lee Khairan Minha
en: indeed we belong to Allah, and to Him we shall return, O Allah, reward me for my distress and grant me something better in exchange

ar: لَآ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّيْ كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِيْنَ
latin: La Illaha Illa Anta Subhanak Inni Kunto Min Al Thalemeen
en: O Allah, there is none worthy of worship besides You. You are Pure, definitely I have oppressed my soul by sinning.

nama: When inflicted with pain and disaster
ar: اَنِّىْ مَسَّنِىَ الضُّرُّ وَاَنْتَ اَرْحَمُ الرّٰحِمِيْنَ (الأنبياء 83)
latin: Inna Masanee Al Dour Wa Anta Arham Al Rahemeen
en: Verily, pain and illness has seized me, and You are the Most Merciful of all those show mercy

nama: When seeing someone afflicted by misfortune
ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِـلّٰـهِ الَّذِيْ عَافَانِيْ مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ وَفَضَّلَنِيْ عَلٰى كَثِيْرٍ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيْلًا
latin: Alhamdulillah Allathee Aafanee Mema Ibtalaka Beh Wa Fadalanee Ala Katheerin Mema Khalaqa Taftheelan
en: Praise is to Allah Who has spared me what He has afflicted you with, and preferred me greatly above much of what He has created

ar: لَآ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ الْعَظِيْمُ الْحَلِيْمُ لَآ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ لَآ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيْمِ
latin: La Illaha Illa Allahu AlAtheem AlHaleem La Illaha Illa Allahu Rabu Al Arshe Al Atheem La Illaha Illa Allahu Rabu Al Samawati Wal Ared Wa Rabul Arsheel Altheem
en: There is none worthy of worship but Allah the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُوْا فَلَا تَكِلْنِيْ إِلٰى نَفْسِيْ طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَّأَصْلِحْ لِيْ شَأْنِيْ كُلَّهُۥ لَآ إِلٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنْتَ
latin: Allahuma Rahmatek Arjo Fala Takilnee Illa Nafsee Tafat Ayeen Wa Aslah Le Shaanee Koleh La Illaha Illa Ante
en: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy, do not leave me for even the duration of an eye blink (duration) and correct my total condition. Besides You there is none worthy of worship

nama: Feeling no one is able to Help
ar: حَسْبُنَا اللهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ
latin: Hasbuna Allah Wa Naaima AlWakeel
en: Allah is sufficient for us and He is the Best Guardian

nama: When needing Strength in Difficult Times
ar: لَاحَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
latin: La Hawla Wala Quwata Illa Billah
en: There is no strength except in Allah

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُۥ سَهْلًا وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزَنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
latin: Allahuma La Sahla Illa Ma Jaaltahu Sahlaa Wa Anta Tajal Al Huzna Itha Sheita Sahlaan
en: O Allah, there is no ease other than what You make easy. If You please You ease sorrow

nama: When something Happens to Displease You
ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِـلّٰـهِ عَلٰى كُلِّ حَالٍ
latin: Al Hamdulillah Ala Kuli Haal
en: Praise is to Allah in all circumstances

nama: For protection & help from Allah -Against Enemy
ar: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ اْلِكتَابِ ، سَرِيْعَ الْحِسَابِ ،اِهْزِمِ الإْحْزَابَ ،اللَّهُمَّ اِهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
latin: Allaahumma munzilal-kitaabi, saree'al-hisaabi, ihzimil-'ahzaaba, Allaahumma ihzimhum wa zalzilhum
en: Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift to account, defeat the groups (of disbelievers). O Allah, defeat them and shake them

ar: أَنَّ اللَّهَ مَوْلَاكُمْ ۚ نِعْمَ الْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ
latin: Anna Allaha mawlakum ni'mal mawla wa ni'man naseer
en: know that Allah is your Befriender - a Transcendent Patron, a Transcendent Helper

nama: When Afriad of someone to Harm You
ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اكْفِنِيْهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ
latin: Allāhumma-kfinīhim bimā shi’ta.
en: O Allah, suffice me from them, with what You choose

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِيْ نُحُوْرِهِمْ ، وَنَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُوْرِهِمْ
latin: Allāhumma innā najʿaluka fī nuḥūrihim, wa naʿūdhu bika min shurūrihim.
en: O Allah, we make You our shield against them and we seek refuge in You from their evil.

nama: When Feeling Afraid of a Ruler or powerful Person
ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمٰـوٰتِ السَّبْعِ ، وَرَبَّ العَرْشِ العَظِيْمِ ، كُنْ لِيْ جَارًا مِنْ فُلَانِ بْنِ فُلَانٍ ، وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلَائِقِكَ ؛ أنْ يَّفْرُطَ عَلَىَّ أحَدٌ مِنهُمْ أوْ يَطْغٰى ، عَزَّ جَارُكَ ، وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ ، وَلَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
latin: Allāhumma Rabb-as-samāwāti-s-sabiʿ, wa Rabba-l-ʿArshi-l-ʿaẓīm, kun lī jāran min fulāni-bni-fulān, wa aḥzābihi min khalāiqiqa; ay-yafruṭa ʿalayya aḥadun minhum aw yaṭgā, ʿazza jāruk, wa jalla thanā’uk, wa lā ilāha illā Ant.
en: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, be for me a support against [such and such a person] and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is Your patronage, and glorious are Your praises. There is none worthy of worship but You.

ar: اللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّى أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَدْمِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ التَّرَدِّى وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْغَرَقِ وَالْحَرَقِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ يَتَخَبَّطَنِى الشَّيْطَانُ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَمُوتَ فِى سَبِيلِكَ مُدْبِرًا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَمُوتَ لَدِيغًا
en: O Allah, I seek Your refuge from death by crushing, death by falling, death by burning and extreme old age. And I seek refuge from the fact that Satan will make me feel bad at the time of death. And I seek your refuge from turning my back on the field of Jihad and I seek refuge from the bite of wild animals.

nama: Dua for victory and freedom from oppression
ar: نَسَأَلُكَ بِأَنَّنا نَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ لا إِلهَ إلا أَنْتَ، الأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَد، أَنْ تَنْصُرَ الإِسْلامَ وَأَهْلَهُ فِي كُلِّ مَكَانٍ، اللهُمُّ اَنْصُرِ الإِسْلامَ وَأَهْلَهُ فِي كُلِّ مَكَانٍ، اللهُمَّ انْصُرِالإِسْلامَ وَأَهْلَهُ فِي كُلِّ مَكَانٍ
latin: Nas’aluka bi ananaa nash-hadu annaka antallah, la ilaha illa ant, al-ahadus-samadu-ladhdhi lam yalid wa lam yu-lad wa lam yakul-lahu kufuwan ahad. An tansural-Islama wa ahlahu fi kulli makaan. Allahumma-nsuril-Islama wa ahlahu fi kulli makaan. Allahumma-nsuril-Islama wa ahlahu fi kulli makaan
en: O Allah! Raise the standing of Islam and the Muslims. O Allah! Raise the standing and the Muslims, and degrade the standing of Kufr and the Kaafireen, and Shirk and the Mushrikeen. Destroy the enemies of the Deen, and protect the lands of Islam, O Lord of the Worlds

ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ ظُلْمِ الْمُلْكِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الْقَهَّارِ
latin: Allahumma inni a’udhu bika min dhulmil-mulk, wa min sharri al-qahhar
en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the injustice of rulers and from the evil of the One who exercises power

nama: Du’a for Comfort in the Face of Injustice
ar: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من جار الجبار، ومن ظلم العابد، ومن فتنة الدنيا وعذاب القبر
latin: Allahumma inni a’udhu bika min jari al-jabbar, wa min dhulm al-‘abid, wa min fitnatid-dunya wa ‘adhabil-qabr
en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the oppression of the tyrant, from the injustice of the worshipper, from the trials of the world, and the torment of the grave

ar: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيم
latin: Ḥasbiya Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa ʿalayhi tawakkaltu wa-huwa rabbu al-ʿarshi al-ʿaẓīm
en: Allah is enough for me. There is no true god but Him, in Him I put my trust, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne
